text_en: Now King David was old, and advanced in years: and when he was covered with clothes he was not warm.
text_la: Et rex David senuerat, habebatque ætatis plurimos dies : cumque operiretur vestibus, non calefiebat.
text_pt: Sendo, pois, o rei Davi já velho, e entrado em dias, cobriam-no de roupas, porém não se aquecia.
text_el: καὶ ὁ βασιλεὺς Δαυιδ πρεσβύτερος προβεβηκὼς ἡμέραις καὶ περιέβαλλον αὐτὸν ἱματίοις καὶ οὐκ ἐθερμαίνετο

text_en: His servants therefore, said to him: Let us seek for our Lord the king, a young virgin, and let her stand before the king, and cherish him, and sleep in his bosom and warm our lord the king.
text_la: Dixerunt ergo ei servi sui : Quæramus domino nostro regi adolescentulam virginem, et stet coram rege, et foveat eum, dormiatque in sinu suo, et calefaciat dominum nostrum regem.
text_pt: Então disseram-lhe os seus servos: Busquem para o rei meu senhor uma moça virgem, que esteja perante o rei, e tenha cuidado dele; e durma no seu seio, para que o rei meu senhor se aqueça.
text_el: καὶ εἶπον οἱ παῖδες αὐτοῦ ζητησάτωσαν τῷ κυρίῳ ἡμῶν τῷ βασιλεῖ παρθένον νεάνιδα καὶ παραστήσεται τῷ βασιλεῖ καὶ ἔσται αὐτὸν θάλπουσα καὶ κοιμηθήσεται μετ' αὐτοῦ καὶ θερμανθήσεται ὁ κύριος ἡμῶν ὁ βασιλεύς

text_en: So they sought a beautiful young woman , in all the coasts of Israel and they found Abisag, a Sunamitess, and brought her to the king.
text_la: Quæsierunt igitur adolescentulam speciosam in omnibus finibus Israël, et invenerunt Abisag Sunamitidem, et adduxerunt eam ad regem.
text_pt: E buscaram por todos os termos de Israel uma moça formosa, e acharam a Abisague, sunamita; e a trouxeram ao rei.
text_el: καὶ ἐζήτησαν νεάνιδα καλὴν ἐκ παντὸς ὁρίου Ισραηλ καὶ εὗρον τὴν Αβισακ τὴν Σωμανῖτιν καὶ ἤνεγκαν αὐτὴν πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα

text_en: And the damsel was exceedingly beautiful, and she slept with the king, and served him, but the king did not know her.
text_la: Erat autem puella pulchra nimis, dormiebatque cum rege, et ministrabat ei : rex vero non cognovit eam.
text_pt: E era a moça sobremaneira formosa; e tinha cuidado do rei, e o servia; porém o rei não a conheceu.
text_el: καὶ ἡ νεᾶνις καλὴ ἕως σφόδρα καὶ ἦν θάλπουσα τὸν βασιλέα καὶ ἐλειτούργει αὐτῷ καὶ ὁ βασιλεὺς οὐκ ἔγνω αὐτήν

text_en: And Adonias , the son of Haggith , exalted himself, saying: I will be king. And he made himself chariots and horsemen, and fifty men to run before him.
text_la: Adonias autem filius Haggith elevabatur, dicens : Ego regnabo. Fecitque sibi currus et equites, et quinquaginta viros qui currerent ante eum.
text_pt: Então Adonias, filho de Hagite, se levantou, dizendo: Eu reinarei. E preparou carros, e cavaleiros, e cinqüenta homens, que corressem adiante dele.
text_el: καὶ Αδωνιας υἱὸς Αγγιθ ἐπῄρετο λέγων ἐγὼ βασιλεύσω καὶ ἐποίησεν ἑαυτῷ ἅρματα καὶ ἱππεῖς καὶ πεντήκοντα ἄνδρας παρατρέχειν ἔμπροσθεν αὐτοῦ

text_en: Neither did his father rebuke him at any time, saying: Why have you done this? And he also was very beautiful, the next in birth after Absalom .
text_la: Nec corripuit eum pater suus aliquando, dicens : Quare hoc fecisti? Erat autem et ipse pulcher valde, secundus natu post Absalom.
text_pt: E nunca seu pai o tinha contrariado, dizendo: Por que fizeste assim? E era ele também muito formoso de parecer; e Hagite o tivera depois de Absalão.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἀπεκώλυσεν αὐτὸν ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ οὐδέποτε λέγων διὰ τί σὺ ἐποίησας καί γε αὐτὸς ὡραῖος τῇ ὄψει σφόδρα καὶ αὐτὸν ἔτεκεν ὀπίσω Αβεσσαλωμ

text_en: And he conferred with Joab, the son of Sarvia, and with Abiathar , the priest , who furthered Adonias' side.
text_la: Et sermo ei cum Joab filio Sarviæ, et cum Abiathar sacerdote, qui adjuvabant partes Adoniæ.
text_pt: E tinha entendimento com Joabe, filho de Zeruia, e com Abiatar o sacerdote; os quais o ajudavam, seguindo a Adonias.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένοντο οἱ λόγοι αὐτοῦ μετὰ Ιωαβ τοῦ υἱοῦ Σαρουιας καὶ μετὰ Αβιαθαρ τοῦ ἱερέως καὶ ἐβοήθουν ὀπίσω Αδωνιου

text_en: But Sadoc, the priest , and Banaias, the son of Joiada , and Nathan, the prophet , and Semei, and Rei, and the strength of David's army, was not with Adonias .
text_la: Sadoc vero sacerdos, et Banaias filius Jojadæ, et Nathan propheta, et Semei et Rei, et robur exercitus David, non erat cum Adonia.
text_pt: Porém Zadoque, o sacerdote, e Benaia, filho de Joiada, e Natã, o profeta, e Simei, e Rei, e os poderosos que Davi tinha, não estavam com Adonias.
text_el: καὶ Σαδωκ ὁ ἱερεὺς καὶ Βαναιας υἱὸς Ιωδαε καὶ Ναθαν ὁ προφήτης καὶ Σεμεϊ καὶ Ρηι καὶ οἱ δυνατοὶ τοῦ Δαυιδ οὐκ ἦσαν ὀπίσω Αδωνιου

text_en: And Adonias having slain rams and calves, and all fat cattle, by the stone of Zoheleth, which was near the fountain Rogel, invited all his brethren, the king's sons, and all the men of Juda , the king's servants:
text_la: Immolatis ergo Adonias arietibus et vitulis, et universis pinguibus, juxta lapidem Zoheleth, qui erat vicinus fonti Rogel, vocavit universos fratres suos filios regis, et omnes viros Juda servos regis.
text_pt: E matou Adonias ovelhas, e vacas, e animais cevados, junto à pedra de Zoelete, que está perto da fonte de Rogel; e convidou a todos os seus irmãos, os filhos do rei, e a todos os homens de Judá, servos do rei.
text_el: καὶ ἐθυσίασεν Αδωνιας πρόβατα καὶ μόσχους καὶ ἄρνας μετὰ λίθου τοῦ Ζωελεθ ὃς ἦν ἐχόμενα τῆς πηγῆς Ρωγηλ καὶ ἐκάλεσεν πάντας τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς αὐτοῦ καὶ πάντας τοὺς ἁδροὺς Ιουδα παῖδας τοῦ βασιλέως

text_en: But Nathan, the prophet , and Banaias , and all the valiant men , and Solomon , his brother, he invited not.
text_la: Nathan autem prophetam, et Banaiam, et robustos quosque, et Salomonem fratrem suum non vocavit.
text_pt: Porém a Natã, o profeta, e a Benaia, e aos poderosos, e a Salomão, seu irmão, não convidou.
text_el: καὶ τὸν Ναθαν τὸν προφήτην καὶ Βαναιαν καὶ τοὺς δυνατοὺς καὶ τὸν Σαλωμων ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἐκάλεσεν

text_en: And Nathan said to Bethsabee, the mother of Solomon : Have you not heard that Adonias , the son of Haggith , reigns, and our lord David knows it not?
text_la: Dixit itaque Nathan ad Bethsabee matrem Salomonis : Num audisti quod regnaverit Adonias filius Haggith, et dominus noster David hoc ignorat?
text_pt: Então falou Natã a Bate-Seba, mãe de Salomão, dizendo: Não ouviste que Adonias, filho de Hagite, reina? E que nosso senhor Davi não o sabe?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ναθαν πρὸς Βηρσαβεε μητέρα Σαλωμων λέγων οὐκ ἤκουσας ὅτι ἐβασίλευσεν Αδωνιας υἱὸς Αγγιθ καὶ ὁ κύριος ἡμῶν Δαυιδ οὐκ ἔγνω

text_en: Now then, come, take my counsel, and save your life, and the life of your son Solomon .
text_la: Nunc ergo veni, accipe consilium a me, et salva animam tuam, filiique tui Salomonis.
text_pt: Vem, pois, agora, e deixa-me dar-te um conselho, para que salves a tua vida, e a de Salomão teu filho.
text_el: καὶ νῦν δεῦρο συμβουλεύσω σοι δὴ συμβουλίαν καὶ ἐξελοῦ τὴν ψυχήν σου καὶ τὴν ψυχὴν τοῦ υἱοῦ σου Σαλωμων

text_en: Go, and get you in to King David , and say to him: Did not you, my lord, O king, swear to me, your handmaid, saying: Solomon , your son, shall reign after me, and he shall sit on my throne? Why then does Adonias reign?
text_la: Vade, et ingredere ad regem David, et dic ei : Nonne tu, domine mi rex, jurasti mihi ancillæ tuæ, dicens : Salomon filius tuus regnabit post me, et ipse sedebit in solio meo? quare ergo regnat Adonias?
text_pt: Vai, e chega ao rei Davi, e dize-lhe: Não juraste tu, rei senhor meu, à tua serva, dizendo: Certamente teu filho Salomão reinará depois de mim, e ele se assentará no meu trono? Por que, pois, reina Adonias?
text_el: δεῦρο εἴσελθε πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα Δαυιδ καὶ ἐρεῖς πρὸς αὐτὸν λέγουσα οὐχὶ σύ κύριέ μου βασιλεῦ ὤμοσας τῇ δούλῃ σου λέγων ὅτι Σαλωμων ὁ υἱός σου βασιλεύσει μετ' ἐμὲ καὶ αὐτὸς καθιεῖται ἐπὶ τοῦ θρόνου μου καὶ τί ὅτι ἐβασίλευσεν Αδωνιας

text_en: And while you are yet speaking there with the king, I will come in after you, and will fill up your words.
text_la: Et adhuc ibi te loquente cum rege, ego veniam post te, et complebo sermones tuos.
text_pt: Eis que, estando tu ainda aí falando com o rei, eu também entrarei depois de ti, e confirmarei as tuas palavras.
text_el: καὶ ἰδοὺ ἔτι λαλούσης σου ἐκεῖ μετὰ τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ ἐγὼ εἰσελεύσομαι ὀπίσω σου καὶ πληρώσω τοὺς λόγους σου

text_en: So Bethsabee went in to the king into the chamber. Now the king was very old, and Abisag, the Sunamitess, ministered to him.
text_la: Ingressa est itaque Bethsabee ad regem in cubiculum : rex autem senuerat nimis, et Abisag Sunamitis ministrabat ei.
text_pt: E foi Bate-Seba ao rei na sua câmara; e o rei era muito velho; e Abisague, a sunamita, servia ao rei.
text_el: καὶ εἰσῆλθεν Βηρσαβεε πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα εἰς τὸ ταμίειον καὶ ὁ βασιλεὺς πρεσβύτης σφόδρα καὶ Αβισακ ἡ Σωμανῖτις ἦν λειτουργοῦσα τῷ βασιλεῖ

text_en: Bethsabee bowed herself, and worshipped the king. And the king said to her: What is your will?
text_la: Inclinavit se Bethsabee, et adoravit regem. Ad quam rex : Quid tibi, inquit, vis?
text_pt: E Bate-Seba inclinou a cabeça, e se prostrou perante o rei; e disse o rei: Que tens?
text_el: καὶ ἔκυψεν Βηρσαβεε καὶ προσεκύνησεν τῷ βασιλεῖ καὶ εἶπεν ὁ βασιλεύς τί ἐστίν σοι

text_en: She answered, and said: My lord, you swore to your handmaid, by the Lord your God , saying: Solomon , your son, shall reign after me, and he shall sit on my throne.
text_la: Quæ respondens, ait : Domine mi, tu jurasti per Dominum Deum tuum ancillæ tuæ : Salomon filius tuus regnabit post me, et ipse sedebit in solio meo.
text_pt: E ela lhe disse: Senhor meu, tu juraste à tua serva pelo Senhor teu Deus, dizendo: Salomão, teu filho, reinará depois de mim, e ele se assentará no meu trono.
text_el: ἡ δὲ εἶπεν κύριέ μου βασιλεῦ σὺ ὤμοσας ἐν κυρίῳ τῷ θεῷ σου τῇ δούλῃ σου λέγων ὅτι Σαλωμων ὁ υἱός σου βασιλεύσει μετ' ἐμὲ καὶ αὐτὸς καθήσεται ἐπὶ τοῦ θρόνου μου

text_en: And behold, now Adonias reigns, and you, my lord the king, know nothing of it.
text_la: Et ecce nunc Adonias regnat, te, domine mi rex, ignorante.
text_pt: E agora eis que Adonias reina; e tu, ó rei meu senhor, não o sabes.
text_el: καὶ νῦν ἰδοὺ Αδωνιας ἐβασίλευσεν καὶ σύ κύριέ μου βασιλεῦ οὐκ ἔγνως

text_en: He has killed oxen, and all fat cattle, and many rams, and invited all the king's sons, and Abiathar , the priest , and Joab, the general of the army: but Solomon , your servant, he invited not.
text_la: Mactavit boves, et pinguia quæque, et arietes plurimos, et vocavit omnes filios regis, Abiathar quoque sacerdotem, et Joab principem militiæ : Salomonem autem servum tuum non vocavit.
text_pt: E matou vacas, e animais cevados, e ovelhas em abundância, e convidou a todos os filhos do rei, e a Abiatar, o sacerdote, e a Joabe, capitão do exército, mas a teu servo Salomão não convidou.
text_el: καὶ ἐθυσίασεν μόσχους καὶ ἄρνας καὶ πρόβατα εἰς πλῆθος καὶ ἐκάλεσεν πάντας τοὺς υἱοὺς τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ Αβιαθαρ τὸν ἱερέα καὶ Ιωαβ τὸν ἄρχοντα τῆς δυνάμεως καὶ τὸν Σαλωμων τὸν δοῦλόν σου οὐκ ἐκάλεσεν

text_en: And now, my lord, O king, the eyes of all Israel are upon you, that you should tell them, who shall sit on your throne, my lord the king, after you.
text_la: Verumtamen, domine mi rex, in te oculi respiciunt totius Israël, ut indices eis quis sedere debeat in solio tuo, domine mi rex, post te.
text_pt: Porém, ó rei meu senhor, os olhos de todo o Israel estão sobre ti, para que lhe declares quem se assentará sobre o trono do rei meu senhor, depois dele.
text_el: καὶ σύ κύριέ μου βασιλεῦ οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ παντὸς Ισραηλ πρὸς σὲ ἀπαγγεῖλαι αὐτοῖς τίς καθήσεται ἐπὶ τοῦ θρόνου τοῦ κυρίου μου τοῦ βασιλέως μετ' αὐτόν

text_en: Otherwise it shall come to pass, when my lord the king sleeps with his fathers, that I, and my son, Solomon , shall be accounted offenders.
text_la: Eritque, cum dormierit dominus meus rex cum patribus suis, erimus ego et filius meus Salomon peccatores.
text_pt: De outro modo sucederá que, quando o rei meu senhor dormir com seus pais, eu e Salomão meu filho seremos os culpados.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ὡς ἂν κοιμηθῇ ὁ κύριός μου ὁ βασιλεὺς μετὰ τῶν πατέρων αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔσομαι ἐγὼ καὶ ὁ υἱός μου Σαλωμων ἁμαρτωλοί

text_en: As she was yet speaking with the king, Nathan, the prophet , came.
text_la: Adhuc illa loquente cum rege, Nathan propheta venit.
text_pt: E, estando ela ainda falando com o rei, eis que entra o profeta Natã.
text_el: καὶ ἰδοὺ ἔτι αὐτῆς λαλούσης μετὰ τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ Ναθαν ὁ προφήτης ἦλθεν

text_en: And they told the king, saying: Nathan, the prophet , is here. And when he had come in before the king, and had worshipped, bowing down to the ground,
text_la: Et nuntiaverunt regi, dicentes : Adest Nathan propheta. Cumque introisset in conspectu regis, et adorasset eum pronus in terram,
text_pt: E o fizeram saber ao rei, dizendo: Eis aí está o profeta Natã. E entrou à presença do rei, e prostrou-se diante dele com o rosto em terra.
text_el: καὶ ἀνηγγέλη τῷ βασιλεῖ ἰδοὺ Ναθαν ὁ προφήτης καὶ εἰσῆλθεν κατὰ πρόσωπον τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ προσεκύνησεν τῷ βασιλεῖ κατὰ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν

text_en: Nathan said: My lord, O king, have you said: Let Adonias reign after me, and let him sit upon my throne?
text_la: dixit Nathan : Domine mi rex, tu dixisti : Adonias regnet post me, et ipse sedeat super thronum meum?
text_pt: E disse Natã: Ó rei meu senhor, disseste tu: Adonias reinará depois de mim, e ele se assentará sobre o meu trono?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ναθαν κύριέ μου βασιλεῦ σὺ εἶπας Αδωνιας βασιλεύσει ὀπίσω μου καὶ αὐτὸς καθήσεται ἐπὶ τοῦ θρόνου μου

text_en: Because he has gone down to day, and has killed oxen, and fatlings, and many rams, and invited all the king's sons, and the captains of the army, and Abiathar the priest : and they are eating and drinking before him, and saying: God save King Adonias :
text_la: Quia descendit hodie, et immolavit boves, et pinguia, et arietes plurimos, et vocavit universos filios regis et principes exercitus, Abiathar quoque sacerdotem, illisque vescentibus et bibentibus coram eo, et dicentibus : Vivat rex Adonias:
text_pt: Porque hoje desceu, e matou vacas, e animais cevados, e ovelhas em abundância, e convidou a todos os filhos do rei e aos capitães do exército, e a Abiatar, o sacerdote, e eis que estão comendo e bebendo perante ele; e dizem: Viva o rei Adonias.
text_el: ὅτι κατέβη σήμερον καὶ ἐθυσίασεν μόσχους καὶ ἄρνας καὶ πρόβατα εἰς πλῆθος καὶ ἐκάλεσεν πάντας τοὺς υἱοὺς τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ τοὺς ἄρχοντας τῆς δυνάμεως καὶ Αβιαθαρ τὸν ἱερέα καὶ ἰδού εἰσιν ἐσθίοντες καὶ πίνοντες ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ καὶ εἶπαν ζήτω ὁ βασιλεὺς Αδωνιας

text_en: But me, your servant, and Sadoc, the priest , and Banaias, the son of Joiada , and Solomon , your servant, he has not invited.
text_la: me servum tuum, et Sadoc sacerdotem, et Banaiam filium Jojadæ, et Salomonem famulum tuum non vocavit.
text_pt: Porém a mim, sendo eu teu servo, e a Zadoque, o sacerdote, e a Benaia, filho de Joiada, e a Salomão, teu servo, não convidou.
text_el: καὶ ἐμὲ αὐτὸν τὸν δοῦλόν σου καὶ Σαδωκ τὸν ἱερέα καὶ Βαναιαν υἱὸν Ιωδαε καὶ Σαλωμων τὸν δοῦλόν σου οὐκ ἐκάλεσεν

text_en: Is this word come out from my lord the king, and have you not told me, your servant, who should sit on the throne of my lord the king after him?
text_la: Numquid a domino meo rege exivit hoc verbum, et mihi non indicasti servo tuo quis sessurus esset super thronum domini mei regis post eum?
text_pt: Foi feito isto da parte do rei meu senhor? E não fizeste saber a teu servo quem se assentaria no trono do rei meu senhor depois dele?
text_el: εἰ διὰ τοῦ κυρίου μου τοῦ βασιλέως γέγονεν τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦτο καὶ οὐκ ἐγνώρισας τῷ δούλῳ σου τίς καθήσεται ἐπὶ τὸν θρόνον τοῦ κυρίου μου τοῦ βασιλέως μετ' αὐτόν

text_en: And King David answered, and said: Call to me Bethsabee. And when she had come in to the king, and stood before him,
text_la: Et respondit rex David, dicens : Vocate ad me Bethsabee. Quæ cum fuisset ingressa coram rege, et stetisset ante eum,
text_pt: E respondeu o rei Davi, e disse: Chamai-me a Bate-Seba. E ela entrou à presença do rei; e ficou em pé diante do rei.
text_el: καὶ ἀπεκρίθη Δαυιδ καὶ εἶπεν καλέσατέ μοι τὴν Βηρσαβεε καὶ εἰσῆλθεν ἐνώπιον τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ ἔστη ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ

text_en: the king swore , and said: As the Lord lives, who has delivered my soul out of all distress,
text_la: juravit rex, et ait : Vivit Dominus, qui eruit animam meam de omni angustia,
text_pt: Então jurou o rei e disse: Vive o Senhor, o qual remiu a minha alma de toda a angústia,
text_el: καὶ ὤμοσεν ὁ βασιλεὺς καὶ εἶπεν ζῇ κύριος ὃς ἐλυτρώσατο τὴν ψυχήν μου ἐκ πάσης θλίψεως

text_en: even as I swore to you, by the Lord , the God of Israel , saying: Solomon your son, shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne in my stead, so will I do this day.
text_la: quia sicut juravi tibi per Dominum Deum Israël, dicens : Salomon filius tuus regnabit post me, et ipse sedebit super solium meum pro me : sic faciam hodie.
text_pt: Que, como te jurei pelo Senhor Deus de Israel, dizendo: Certamente teu filho Salomão reinará depois de mim, e ele se assentará no meu trono, em meu lugar, assim o farei no dia de hoje.
text_el: ὅτι καθὼς ὤμοσά σοι ἐν κυρίῳ τῷ θεῷ Ισραηλ λέγων ὅτι Σαλωμων ὁ υἱός σου βασιλεύσει μετ' ἐμὲ καὶ αὐτὸς καθήσεται ἐπὶ τοῦ θρόνου μου ἀντ' ἐμοῦ ὅτι οὕτως ποιήσω τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ταύτῃ

text_en: And Bethsabee, bowing with her face to the earth, worshipped the king, saying: May my lord David live for ever.
text_la: Summissoque Bethsabee in terram vultu, adoravit regem, dicens : Vivat dominus meus David in æternum.
text_pt: Então Bate-Seba se inclinou com o rosto em terra e se prostrou diante do rei, e disse: Viva o rei Davi meu senhor para sempre.
text_el: καὶ ἔκυψεν Βηρσαβεε ἐπὶ πρόσωπον ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν καὶ προσεκύνησεν τῷ βασιλεῖ καὶ εἶπεν ζήτω ὁ κύριός μου ὁ βασιλεὺς Δαυιδ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα

text_en: King David also said: Call me Sadoc, the priest , and Nathan, the prophet , and Banaias, the son of Joiada . And when they had come in before the king,
text_la: Dixit quoque rex David : Vocate mihi Sadoc sacerdotem, et Nathan prophetam, et Banaiam filium Jojadæ. Qui cum ingressi fuissent coram rege,
text_pt: E disse o rei Davi: Chamai-me a Zadoque, o sacerdote, e a Natã, o profeta, e a Benaia, filho de Joiada. E eles entraram à presença do rei.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ βασιλεὺς Δαυιδ καλέσατέ μοι Σαδωκ τὸν ἱερέα καὶ Ναθαν τὸν προφήτην καὶ Βαναιαν υἱὸν Ιωδαε καὶ εἰσῆλθον ἐνώπιον τοῦ βασιλέως

text_en: he said to them: Take with you the servants of your lord, and set my son Solomon upon my mule: and bring him to Gihon:
text_la: dixit ad eos : Tollite vobiscum servos domini vestri, et imponite Salomonem filium meum super mulam meam, et ducite eum in Gihon.
text_pt: E o rei lhes disse: Tomai convosco os servos de vosso senhor, e fazei subir a meu filho Salomão na mula que é minha; e levai-o a Giom.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ βασιλεὺς αὐτοῖς λάβετε τοὺς δούλους τοῦ κυρίου ὑμῶν μεθ' ὑμῶν καὶ ἐπιβιβάσατε τὸν υἱόν μου Σαλωμων ἐπὶ τὴν ἡμίονον τὴν ἐμὴν καὶ καταγάγετε αὐτὸν εἰς τὸν Γιων

text_en: And let Sadoc, the priest , and Nathan, the prophet , anoint him there king over Israel : and you shall sound the trumpet, and shall say: God save King Solomon .
text_la: Et ungat eum ibi Sadoc sacerdos et Nathan propheta in regem super Israël : et canetis buccina, atque dicetis : Vivat rex Salomon.
text_pt: E Zadoque, o sacerdote, com Natã, o profeta, ali o ungirão rei sobre Israel; então tocareis a trombeta, e direis: Viva o rei Salomão!
text_el: καὶ χρισάτω αὐτὸν ἐκεῖ Σαδωκ ὁ ἱερεὺς καὶ Ναθαν ὁ προφήτης εἰς βασιλέα ἐπὶ Ισραηλ καὶ σαλπίσατε κερατίνῃ καὶ ἐρεῖτε ζήτω ὁ βασιλεὺς Σαλωμων

text_en: And you shall come up after him, and he shall come, and shall sit upon my throne, and he shall reign in my stead: and I will appoint him to be ruler over Israel , and over Juda .
text_la: Et ascendetis post eum, et veniet, et sedebit super solium meum, et ipse regnabit pro me : illique præcipiam ut sit dux super Israël et super Judam.
text_pt: Então subireis após ele, e virá e se assentará no meu trono, e ele reinará em meu lugar; porque tenho ordenado que ele seja guia sobre Israel e sobre Judá.
text_el: καὶ καθήσεται ἐπὶ τοῦ θρόνου μου καὶ αὐτὸς βασιλεύσει ἀντ' ἐμοῦ καὶ ἐγὼ ἐνετειλάμην τοῦ εἶναι εἰς ἡγούμενον ἐπὶ Ισραηλ καὶ Ιουδα

text_en: And Banaias, the son of Joiada , answered the king, saying: Amen : so say the Lord , the God of my lord the king.
text_la: Et respondit Banaias filius Jojadæ regi, dicens : Amen : sic loquatur Dominus Deus domini mei regis.
text_pt: Então Benaia, filho de Joiada, respondeu ao rei, e disse: Amém; assim o diga o SENHOR Deus do rei meu senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἀπεκρίθη Βαναιας υἱὸς Ιωδαε τῷ βασιλεῖ καὶ εἶπεν γένοιτο οὕτως πιστώσαι κύριος ὁ θεὸς τοῦ κυρίου μου τοῦ βασιλέως

text_en: As the Lord has been with my lord the king, so be he with Solomon , and make his throne higher than the throne of my lord King David .
text_la: Quomodo fuit Dominus cum domino meo rege, sic sit cum Salomone, et sublimius faciat solium ejus a solio domini mei regis David.
text_pt: Como o SENHOR foi com o rei meu senhor, assim o seja com Salomão, e faça que o seu trono seja maior do que o trono do rei Davi meu senhor.
text_el: καθὼς ἦν κύριος μετὰ τοῦ κυρίου μου τοῦ βασιλέως οὕτως εἴη μετὰ Σαλωμων καὶ μεγαλύναι τὸν θρόνον αὐτοῦ ὑπὲρ τὸν θρόνον τοῦ κυρίου μου τοῦ βασιλέως Δαυιδ

text_en: So Sadoc, the priest , and Nathan, the prophet , went down, and Banaias, the son of Joiada , and the Cerethi, and Phelethi: and they set Solomon upon the mule of King David , and brought him to Gihon.
text_la: Descendit ergo Sadoc sacerdos, et Nathan propheta, et Banaias filius Jojadæ, et Cerethi, et Phelethi : et imposuerunt Salomonem super mulam regis David, et adduxerunt eum in Gihon.
text_pt: Então desceu Zadoque, o sacerdote, e Natã, o profeta, e Benaia, filho de Joiada, e os quereteus, e os peleteus, e fizeram montar a Salomão na mula do rei Davi, e o levaram a Giom.
text_el: καὶ κατέβη Σαδωκ ὁ ἱερεὺς καὶ Ναθαν ὁ προφήτης καὶ Βαναιας υἱὸς Ιωδαε καὶ ὁ χερεθθι καὶ ὁ φελεθθι καὶ ἐπεκάθισαν τὸν Σαλωμων ἐπὶ τὴν ἡμίονον τοῦ βασιλέως Δαυιδ καὶ ἀπήγαγον αὐτὸν εἰς τὸν Γιων

text_en: And Sadoc, the priest , took a horn of oil out of the tabernacle , and anointed Solomon : and they sounded the trumpet, and all the people said: God save King Solomon .
text_la: Sumpsitque Sadoc sacerdos cornu olei de tabernaculo, et unxit Salomonem : et cecinerunt buccina, et dixit omnis populus : Vivat rex Salomon.
text_pt: E Zadoque, o sacerdote, tomou o chifre de azeite do tabernáculo, e ungiu a Salomão; e tocaram a trombeta, e todo o povo disse: Viva o rei Salomão!
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβεν Σαδωκ ὁ ἱερεὺς τὸ κέρας τοῦ ἐλαίου ἐκ τῆς σκηνῆς καὶ ἔχρισεν τὸν Σαλωμων καὶ ἐσάλπισεν τῇ κερατίνῃ καὶ εἶπεν πᾶς ὁ λαός ζήτω ὁ βασιλεὺς Σαλωμων

text_en: And all the multitude went up after him, and the people played with pipes, and rejoiced with a great joy , and the earth rang with the noise of their cry.
text_la: Et ascendit universa multitudo post eum, et populus canentium tibiis, et lætantium gaudio magno : et insonuit terra a clamore eorum.
text_pt: E todo o povo subiu após ele, e o povo tocava gaitas, e alegrava-se com grande alegria; de maneira que com o seu clamor a terra retiniu.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέβη πᾶς ὁ λαὸς ὀπίσω αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐχόρευον ἐν χοροῖς καὶ εὐφραινόμενοι εὐφροσύνην μεγάλην καὶ ἐρράγη ἡ γῆ ἐν τῇ φωνῇ αὐτῶν

text_en: And Adonias , and all that were invited by him, heard it, and now the feast was at an end. Joab also, hearing the sound of the trumpet, said: What means this noise of the city in an uproar?
text_la: Audivit autem Adonias, et omnes qui invitati fuerant ab eo : jamque convivium finitum erat : sed et Joab, audita voce tubæ, ait : Quid sibi vult clamor civitatis tumultuantis?
text_pt: E o ouviu Adonias, e todos os convidados que estavam com ele, que tinham acabado de comer; também Joabe ouviu o sonido das trombetas, e disse: Por que há tal ruído de cidade alvoroçada?
text_el: καὶ ἤκουσεν Αδωνιας καὶ πάντες οἱ κλητοὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ αὐτοὶ συνετέλεσαν φαγεῖν καὶ ἤκουσεν Ιωαβ τὴν φωνὴν τῆς κερατίνης καὶ εἶπεν τίς ἡ φωνὴ τῆς πόλεως ἠχούσης

text_en: While he yet spoke, Jonathan , the son of Abiathar , the priest , came: and Adonias said to him: Come in, because you are a valiant man , and bring good news.
text_la: Adhuc illo loquente, Jonathas filius Abiathar sacerdotis venit : cui dixit Adonias : Ingredere, quia vir fortis es, et bona nuntians.
text_pt: Estando ele ainda falando, eis que vem Jônatas, filho de Abiatar, o sacerdote, e disse Adonias: Entra, porque és homem valente, e trarás boas novas.
text_el: ἔτι αὐτοῦ λαλοῦντος καὶ ἰδοὺ Ιωναθαν υἱὸς Αβιαθαρ τοῦ ἱερέως ἦλθεν καὶ εἶπεν Αδωνιας εἴσελθε ὅτι ἀνὴρ δυνάμεως εἶ σύ καὶ ἀγαθὰ εὐαγγέλισαι

text_en: And Jonathan answered Adonias : Not so: for our lord, King David , has appointed Solomon king;
text_la: Responditque Jonathas Adoniæ : Nequaquam : dominus enim noster rex David regem constituit Salomonem:
text_pt: E respondeu Jônatas, e disse a Adonias: Certamente nosso senhor, rei Davi, constituiu rei a Salomão;
text_el: καὶ ἀπεκρίθη Ιωναθαν καὶ εἶπεν καὶ μάλα ὁ κύριος ἡμῶν ὁ βασιλεὺς Δαυιδ ἐβασίλευσεν τὸν Σαλωμων

text_en: and has sent with him Sadoc, the priest , and Nathan, the prophet , and Banaias, the son of Joiada , and the Cerethi, and the Phelethi, and they have set him upon the king's mule:
text_la: misitque cum eo Sadoc sacerdotem, et Nathan prophetam, et Banaiam filium Jojadæ, et Cerethi, et Phelethi, et imposuerunt eum super mulam regis.
text_pt: E o rei enviou com ele a Zadoque, o sacerdote, e a Natã, o profeta, e a Benaia, filho de Joiada, e aos quereteus e aos peleteus; e o fizeram montar na mula do rei.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν ὁ βασιλεὺς μετ' αὐτοῦ τὸν Σαδωκ τὸν ἱερέα καὶ Ναθαν τὸν προφήτην καὶ Βαναιαν υἱὸν Ιωδαε καὶ τὸν χερεθθι καὶ τὸν φελεθθι καὶ ἐπεκάθισαν αὐτὸν ἐπὶ τὴν ἡμίονον τοῦ βασιλέως

text_en: And Sadoc, the priest , and Nathan, the prophet , have anointed him king, in Gihon: and they have gone up from thence rejoicing, so that the city rang again: this is the noise that you have heard.
text_la: Unxeruntque eum Sadoc sacerdos et Nathan propheta regem in Gihon : et ascenderunt inde lætantes, et insonuit civitas : hæc est vox quam audistis.
text_pt: E Zadoque, o sacerdote, e Natã, o profeta, o ungiram rei em Giom, e dali subiram alegres, e a cidade está alvoroçada; este é o clamor que ouviste.
text_el: καὶ ἔχρισαν αὐτὸν Σαδωκ ὁ ἱερεὺς καὶ Ναθαν ὁ προφήτης εἰς βασιλέα ἐν τῷ Γιων καὶ ἀνέβησαν ἐκεῖθεν εὐφραινόμενοι καὶ ἤχησεν ἡ πόλις αὕτη ἡ φωνή ἣν ἠκούσατε

text_en: Moreover, Solomon sits upon the throne of the kingdom.
text_la: Sed et Salomon sedet super solium regni.
text_pt: E também Salomão está assentado no trono do reino.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάθισεν Σαλωμων ἐπὶ θρόνον τῆς βασιλείας

text_en: And the king's servants going in, have blessed our lord King David , saying: May God make the name of Solomon greater than your name , and make his throne greater than your throne. And the king adored in his bed:
text_la: Et ingressi servi regis benedixerunt domino nostro regi David, dicentes : Amplificet Deus nomen Salomonis super nomen tuum, et magnificet thronus ejus super thronum tuum. Et adoravit rex in lectulo suo:
text_pt: E também os servos do rei vieram abençoar a nosso senhor, o rei Davi, dizendo: Faça teu Deus que o nome de Salomão seja melhor do que o teu nome; e faça que o seu trono seja maior do que o teu trono. E o rei se inclinou no leito.
text_el: καὶ εἰσῆλθον οἱ δοῦλοι τοῦ βασιλέως εὐλογῆσαι τὸν κύριον ἡμῶν τὸν βασιλέα Δαυιδ λέγοντες ἀγαθύναι ὁ θεὸς τὸ ὄνομα Σαλωμων τοῦ υἱοῦ σου ὑπὲρ τὸ ὄνομά σου καὶ μεγαλύναι τὸν θρόνον αὐτοῦ ὑπὲρ τὸν θρόνον σου καὶ προσεκύνησεν ὁ βασιλεὺς ἐπὶ τὴν κοίτην αὐτοῦ

text_en: And he said: Blessed be the Lord , the God of Israel , who has given this day one to sit on my throne, my eyes seeing it.
text_la: et locutus est : Benedictus Dominus Deus Israël, qui dedit hodie sedentem in solio meo, videntibus oculis meis.
text_pt: E também disse o rei assim: Bendito o Senhor Deus de Israel, que hoje tem dado quem se assente no meu trono, e que os meus olhos o vissem.
text_el: καί γε οὕτως εἶπεν ὁ βασιλεύς εὐλογητὸς κύριος ὁ θεὸς Ισραηλ ὃς ἔδωκεν σήμερον ἐκ τοῦ σπέρματός μου καθήμενον ἐπὶ τοῦ θρόνου μου καὶ οἱ ὀφθαλμοί μου βλέπουσιν

text_en: Then all the guests of Adonias were afraid, and they all arose, and every man went his way.
text_la: Territi sunt ergo, et surrexerunt omnes qui invitati fuerant ab Adonia, et ivit unusquisque in viam suam.
text_pt: Então estremeceram e se levantaram todos os convidados que estavam com Adonias; e cada um se foi ao seu caminho.
text_el: καὶ ἐξέστησαν καὶ ἐξανέστησαν πάντες οἱ κλητοὶ τοῦ Αδωνιου καὶ ἀπῆλθον ἀνὴρ εἰς τὴν ὁδὸν αὐτοῦ

text_en: And Adonias fearing Solomon , arose and went, and took hold of the horn of the altar .
text_la: Adonias autem timens Salomonem, surrexit, et abiit, tenuitque cornu altaris.
text_pt: Porém Adonias temeu a Salomão; e levantou-se, e foi, e apegou-se às pontas do altar.
text_el: καὶ Αδωνιας ἐφοβήθη ἀπὸ προσώπου Σαλωμων καὶ ἀνέστη καὶ ἀπῆλθεν καὶ ἐπελάβετο τῶν κεράτων τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου

text_en: And they told Solomon , saying: Behold Adonias fearing King Solomon , has taken hold of the horn of the altar , saying: Let King Solomon swear to me this day, that he will not kill his servant with the sword.
text_la: Et nuntiaverunt Salomoni, dicentes : Ecce Adonias timens regem Salomonem, tenuit cornu altaris, dicens : Juret mihi rex Salomon hodie, quod non interficiat servum suum gladio.
text_pt: E fez-se saber a Salomão, dizendo: Eis que Adonias teme ao rei Salomão; porque eis que apegou-se às pontas do altar, dizendo: Jure-me hoje o rei Salomão que não matará o seu servo à espada.
text_el: καὶ ἀνηγγέλη τῷ Σαλωμων λέγοντες ἰδοὺ Αδωνιας ἐφοβήθη τὸν βασιλέα Σαλωμων καὶ κατέχει τῶν κεράτων τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου λέγων ὀμοσάτω μοι σήμερον ὁ βασιλεὺς Σαλωμων εἰ οὐ θανατώσει τὸν δοῦλον αὐτοῦ ἐν ῥομφαίᾳ

text_en: And Solomon said: If he be a good man , there shall not so much as one hair of his head fall to the ground: but if evil be found in him, he shall die.
text_la: Dixitque Salomon : Si fuerit vir bonus, non cadet ne unus quidem capillus ejus in terram : sin autem malum inventum fuerit in eo, morietur.
text_pt: E disse Salomão: Se for homem de bem, nem um de seus cabelos cairá em terra; se, porém, se achar nele maldade, morrerá.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Σαλωμων ἐὰν γένηται εἰς υἱὸν δυνάμεως εἰ πεσεῖται τῶν τριχῶν αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν καὶ ἐὰν κακία εὑρεθῇ ἐν αὐτῷ θανατωθήσεται

text_en: Then King Solomon sent, and brought him out from the altar : and going in, he worshipped King Solomon : and Solomon said to him: Go to your house.
text_la: Misit ergo rex Salomon, et eduxit eum ab altari : et ingressus adoravit regem Salomonem : dixitque ei Salomon : Vade in domum tuam.
text_pt: E mandou o rei Salomão, e o fizeram descer do altar; e veio, e prostrou-se perante o rei Salomão, e Salomão lhe disse: Vai para tua casa.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν ὁ βασιλεὺς Σαλωμων καὶ κατήνεγκεν αὐτὸν ἀπάνωθεν τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου καὶ εἰσῆλθεν καὶ προσεκύνησεν τῷ βασιλεῖ Σαλωμων καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Σαλωμων δεῦρο εἰς τὸν οἶκόν σου

text_en: And the days of David drew near that he should die, and he charged his son Solomon , saying:
text_la: Appropinquaverunt autem dies David ut moreretur : præcepitque Salomoni filio suo, dicens:
text_pt: E aproximaram-se os dias da morte de Davi; e deu ele ordem a Salomão, seu filho, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἤγγισαν αἱ ἡμέραι Δαυιδ ἀποθανεῖν αὐτόν καὶ ἐνετείλατο τῷ Σαλωμων υἱῷ αὐτοῦ λέγων

text_en: I am going the way of all flesh: take courage and show yourself a man .
text_la: Ego ingredior viam universæ terræ : confortare, et esto vir.
text_pt: Eu vou pelo caminho de toda a terra; esforça-te, pois, e sê homem.
text_el: ἐγώ εἰμι πορεύομαι ἐν ὁδῷ πάσης τῆς γῆς καὶ ἰσχύσεις καὶ ἔσῃ εἰς ἄνδρα

text_en: And keep the charge of the Lord your God , to walk in his ways, and observe his ceremonies , and his precepts, and judgments, and testimonies, as it is written in the law of Moses : that you may understand all you do, and wherever you shall turn yourself:
text_la: Et observa custodias Domini Dei tui, ut ambules in viis ejus : ut custodias cæremonias ejus, et præcepta ejus, et judicia, et testimonia, sicut scriptum est in lege Moysi : ut intelligas universa quæ facis, et quocumque te verteris:
text_pt: E guarda a ordenança do Senhor teu Deus, para andares nos seus caminhos, e para guardares os seus estatutos, e os seus mandamentos, e os seus juízos, e os seus testemunhos, como está escrito na lei de Moisés; para que prosperes em tudo quanto fizeres, e para onde quer que fores.
text_el: καὶ φυλάξεις τὴν φυλακὴν κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ σου τοῦ πορεύεσθαι ἐν ταῖς ὁδοῖς αὐτοῦ φυλάσσειν τὰς ἐντολὰς αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰ δικαιώματα καὶ τὰ κρίματα τὰ γεγραμμένα ἐν νόμῳ Μωυσέως ἵνα συνίῃς ἃ ποιήσεις κατὰ πάντα ὅσα ἂν ἐντείλωμαί σοι

text_en: That the Lord may confirm his words, which he has spoken of me, saying: If your children shall take heed to their ways, and shall walk before me in truth , with all their heart, and with all their soul , there shall not be taken away from you a man on the throne of Israel .
text_la: ut confirmet Dominus sermones suos quos locutus est de me, dicens : Si custodierint filii tui vias suas, et ambulaverint coram me in veritate, in omni corde suo et in omni anima sua, non auferetur tibi vir de solio Israël.
text_pt: Para que o Senhor confirme a palavra, que falou de mim, dizendo: Se teus filhos guardarem o seu caminho, para andarem perante a minha face fielmente, com todo o seu coração e com toda a sua alma, nunca, disse, te faltará sucessor ao trono de Israel.
text_el: ἵνα στήσῃ κύριος τὸν λόγον αὐτοῦ ὃν ἐλάλησεν λέγων ἐὰν φυλάξωσιν οἱ υἱοί σου τὴν ὁδὸν αὐτῶν πορεύεσθαι ἐνώπιον ἐμοῦ ἐν ἀληθείᾳ ἐν ὅλῃ καρδίᾳ αὐτῶν καὶ ἐν ὅλῃ ψυχῇ αὐτῶν λέγων οὐκ ἐξολεθρευθήσεταί σοι ἀνὴρ ἐπάνωθεν θρόνου Ισραηλ

text_en: You know also what Joab, the son of Sarvia, has done to me, what he did to the two captains of the army of Israel , to Abner , the son of Ner, and to Amasa, the son of Jether: whom he slew, and shed the blood of war in peace, and put the blood of war on his girdle that was about his loins, and in his shoes that were on his feet.
text_la: Tu quoque nosti quæ fecerit mihi Joab filius Sarviæ, quæ fecerit duobus principibus exercitus Israël, Abner filio Ner, et Amasæ filio Jether : quos occidit, et effudit sanguinem belli in pace, et posuit cruorem prælii in balteo suo qui erat circa lumbos ejus, et in calceamento suo quod erat in pedibus ejus.
text_pt: E também tu sabes o que me fez Joabe, filho de Zeruia, e o que fez aos dois capitães do exército de Israel, a Abner filho de Ner, e a Amasa, filho de Jeter, os quais matou, e em paz derramou o sangue de guerra, e pôs o sangue de guerra no cinto que tinha nos lombos, e nos sapatos que trazia nos pés.
text_el: καί γε σὺ ἔγνως ὅσα ἐποίησέν μοι Ιωαβ υἱὸς Σαρουιας ὅσα ἐποίησεν τοῖς δυσὶν ἄρχουσιν τῶν δυνάμεων Ισραηλ τῷ Αβεννηρ υἱῷ Νηρ καὶ τῷ Αμεσσαϊ υἱῷ Ιεθερ καὶ ἀπέκτεινεν αὐτοὺς καὶ ἔταξεν τὰ αἵματα πολέμου ἐν εἰρήνῃ καὶ ἔδωκεν αἷμα ἀθῷον ἐν τῇ ζώνῃ αὐτοῦ τῇ ἐν τῇ ὀσφύι αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐν τῷ ὑποδήματι αὐτοῦ τῷ ἐν τῷ ποδὶ αὐτοῦ

text_en: Do, therefore, according to your wisdom, and let not his hoary head go down to hell in peace.
text_la: Facies ergo juxta sapientiam tuam, et non deduces canitiem ejus pacifice ad inferos.
text_pt: Faze, pois, segundo a tua sabedoria, e não permitas que suas cãs desçam à sepultura em paz.
text_el: καὶ ποιήσεις κατὰ τὴν σοφίαν σου καὶ οὐ κατάξεις τὴν πολιὰν αὐτοῦ ἐν εἰρήνῃ εἰς ᾅδου

text_en: But show kindness to the sons of Berzellai, the Galaadite, and let them eat at your table: for they met me when I fled from the face of Absalom , your brother.
text_la: Sed et filiis Berzellai Galaaditis reddes gratiam, eruntque comedentes in mensa tua : occurrerunt enim mihi quando fugiebam a facie Absalom fratris tui.
text_pt: Porém com os filhos de Barzilai, o gileadita, usarás de beneficência, e estarão entre os que comem à tua mesa, porque assim se chegaram eles a mim, quando eu fugia por causa de teu irmão Absalão.
text_el: καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς Βερζελλι τοῦ Γαλααδίτου ποιήσεις ἔλεος καὶ ἔσονται ἐν τοῖς ἐσθίουσιν τὴν τράπεζάν σου ὅτι οὕτως ἤγγισάν μοι ἐν τῷ με ἀποδιδράσκειν ἀπὸ προσώπου Αβεσσαλωμ τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ σου

text_en: You have also with you Semei, the son of Gera, the son of Jemini, of Bahurim, who cursed me with a grievous curse , when I went to the camp: but because he came down to meet me when I passed over the Jordan , and I swore to him by the Lord , saying: I will not kill you with the sword:
text_la: Habes quoque apud te Semei filium Gera filii Jemini de Bahurim, qui maledixit mihi maledictione pessima quando ibam ad castra : sed quia descendit mihi in occursum cum transirem Jordanem, et juravi ei per Dominum, dicens : Non te interficiam gladio:
text_pt: E eis que também contigo está Simei, filho de Gera, filho de Benjamim, de Baurim, que me maldisse com maldição atroz, no dia em que ia a Maanaim; porém ele saiu a encontrar-se comigo junto ao Jordão, e eu pelo Senhor lhe jurei, dizendo que o não mataria à espada.
text_el: καὶ ἰδοὺ μετὰ σοῦ Σεμεϊ υἱὸς Γηρα υἱὸς τοῦ Ιεμενι ἐκ Βαουριμ καὶ αὐτὸς κατηράσατό με κατάραν ὀδυνηρὰν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ᾗ ἐπορευόμην εἰς παρεμβολάς καὶ αὐτὸς κατέβη εἰς ἀπαντήν μου εἰς τὸν Ιορδάνην καὶ ὤμοσα αὐτῷ ἐν κυρίῳ λέγων εἰ θανατώσω σε ἐν ῥομφαίᾳ

text_en: Do not hold him guiltless. But you are a wise man , and know what to do with him, and you shall bring down his grey hairs with blood to the grave.
text_la: tu noli pati eum esse innoxium. Vir autem sapiens es, ut scias quæ facies ei : deducesque canos ejus cum sanguine ad inferos.
text_pt: Mas agora não o tenhas por inculpável, pois és homem sábio, e bem saberás o que lhe hás de fazer para que faças com que as suas cãs desçam à sepultura com sangue.
text_el: καὶ οὐ μὴ ἀθῳώσῃς αὐτόν ὅτι ἀνὴρ σοφὸς εἶ σὺ καὶ γνώσῃ ἃ ποιήσεις αὐτῷ καὶ κατάξεις τὴν πολιὰν αὐτοῦ ἐν αἵματι εἰς ᾅδου

text_en: So David slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David.
text_la: Dormivit igitur David cum patribus suis, et sepultus est in civitate David.
text_pt: E Davi dormiu com seus pais, e foi sepultado na cidade de Davi.
text_el: καὶ ἐκοιμήθη Δαυιδ μετὰ τῶν πατέρων αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐτάφη ἐν πόλει Δαυιδ

text_en: And the days that David reigned in Israel , were forty years: in Hebron he reigned seven years, in Jerusalem thirty-three.
text_la: Dies autem quibus regnavit David super Israël, quadraginta anni sunt : in Hebron regnavit septem annis; in Jerusalem, triginta tribus.
text_pt: E foram os dias que Davi reinou sobre Israel quarenta anos: sete anos reinou em Hebrom, e em Jerusalém reinou trinta e três anos.
text_el: καὶ αἱ ἡμέραι ἃς ἐβασίλευσεν Δαυιδ ἐπὶ τὸν Ισραηλ τεσσαράκοντα ἔτη ἐν Χεβρων ἐβασίλευσεν ἔτη ἑπτὰ καὶ ἐν Ιερουσαλημ τριάκοντα τρία ἔτη

text_en: And Solomon sat upon the throne of his father David , and his kingdom was strengthened exceedingly.
text_la: Salomon autem sedit super thronum David patris sui, et firmatum est regnum ejus nimis.
text_pt: E Salomão se assentou no trono de Davi, seu pai, e o seu reino se fortificou sobremaneira.
text_el: καὶ Σαλωμων ἐκάθισεν ἐπὶ τοῦ θρόνου Δαυιδ τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ υἱὸς ἐτῶν δώδεκα καὶ ἡτοιμάσθη ἡ βασιλεία αὐτοῦ σφόδρα

text_en: And Adonias , the son of Haggith , came to Bethsabee the mother of Solomon . And she said to him: Is your coming peaceable? He answered: It is peaceable.
text_la: Et ingressus est Adonias filius Haggith ad Bethsabee matrem Salomonis. Quæ dixit ei : Pacificusne est ingressus tuus? Qui respondit : Pacificus.
text_pt: Então veio Adonias, filho de Hagite, a Bate-Seba, mãe de Salomão; e disse ela: De paz é a tua vinda? E ele disse: É de paz.
text_el: καὶ εἰσῆλθεν Αδωνιας υἱὸς Αγγιθ πρὸς Βηρσαβεε μητέρα Σαλωμων καὶ προσεκύνησεν αὐτῇ ἡ δὲ εἶπεν εἰρήνη ἡ εἴσοδός σου καὶ εἶπεν εἰρήνη

text_en: And he added: I have a word to speak with you. She said to him: Speak. And he said:
text_la: Addiditque : Sermo mihi est ad te. Cui ait : Loquere. Et ille:
text_pt: Então disse ele: Uma palavra tenho que dizer-te. E ela disse: Fala.
text_el: λόγος μοι πρὸς σέ καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ λάλησον

text_en: You know that the kingdom was mine, and all Israel had preferred me to be their king: but the kingdom is transferred, and has become my brother's: for it was appointed him by the Lord .
text_la: Tu, inquit, nosti, quia meum erat regnum, et me præposuerat omnis Israël sibi in regem : sed translatum est regnum, et factum est fratris mei : a Domino enim constitutum est ei.
text_pt: Disse, pois, ele: Bem sabes que o reino era meu, e todo o Israel tinha posto a vista em mim para que eu viesse a reinar, contudo o reino foi transferido e veio a ser de meu irmão, porque foi feito seu pelo Senhor.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῇ σὺ οἶδας ὅτι ἐμοὶ ἦν ἡ βασιλεία καὶ ἐπ' ἐμὲ ἔθετο πᾶς Ισραηλ τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ εἰς βασιλέα καὶ ἐστράφη ἡ βασιλεία καὶ ἐγενήθη τῷ ἀδελφῷ μου ὅτι παρὰ κυρίου ἐγένετο αὐτῷ

text_en: Now therefore, I ask one petition of you; turn not away my face. And she said to him: Say on.
text_la: Nunc ergo petitionem unam precor a te : ne confundas faciem meam. Quæ dixit ad eum : Loquere.
text_pt: Assim que agora uma só petição te faço; não ma rejeites. E ela lhe disse: Fala.
text_el: καὶ νῦν αἴτησιν μίαν ἐγὼ αἰτοῦμαι παρὰ σοῦ μὴ ἀποστρέψῃς τὸ πρόσωπόν σου καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Βηρσαβεε λάλει

text_en: And he said I pray you speak to King Solomon (for he cannot deny you anything) to give me Abisag, the Sunamitess, to wife.
text_la: Et ille ait: Precor ut dicas Salomoni regi (neque enim negare tibi quidquam potest) ut det mihi Abisag Sunamitidem uxorem.
text_pt: E ele disse: Peço-te que fales ao rei Salomão (porque ele não te rejeitará) que me dê por mulher a Abisague, a sunamita.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῇ εἰπὸν δὴ πρὸς Σαλωμων τὸν βασιλέα ὅτι οὐκ ἀποστρέψει τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ σοῦ καὶ δώσει μοι τὴν Αβισακ τὴν Σωμανῖτιν εἰς γυναῖκα

text_en: And Bethsabee said: Well, I will speak for you to the king.
text_la: Et ait Bethsabee : Bene : ego loquar pro te regi.
text_pt: E disse Bate-Seba: Bem, eu falarei por ti ao rei.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Βηρσαβεε καλῶς ἐγὼ λαλήσω περὶ σοῦ τῷ βασιλεῖ

text_en: Then Bethsabee came to King Solomon , to speak to him for Adonias : and the king arose to meet her, and bowed to her, and sat down upon his throne: and a throne was set for the king's mother, and she sat on his right hand.
text_la: Venit ergo Bethsabee ad regem Salomonem ut loqueretur ei pro Adonia : et surrexit rex in occursum ejus, adoravitque eam, et sedit super thronum suum : positusque est thronus matri regis, quæ sedit ad dexteram ejus.
text_pt: Assim foi Bate-Seba ao rei Salomão, a falar-lhe por Adonias; e o rei se levantou a encontrar-se com ela, e se inclinou diante dela; então se assentou no seu trono, e fez pôr uma cadeira para a sua mãe, e ela se assentou à sua direita.
text_el: καὶ εἰσῆλθεν Βηρσαβεε πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα Σαλωμων λαλῆσαι αὐτῷ περὶ Αδωνιου καὶ ἐξανέστη ὁ βασιλεὺς εἰς ἀπαντὴν αὐτῇ καὶ κατεφίλησεν αὐτὴν καὶ ἐκάθισεν ἐπὶ τοῦ θρόνου αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐτέθη θρόνος τῇ μητρὶ τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ ἐκάθισεν ἐκ δεξιῶν αὐτοῦ

text_en: And she said to him: I desire one small petition of you; do not put me to confusion. And the king said to her: My mother ask, for I must not turn away your face.
text_la: Dixitque ei : Petitionem unam parvulam ego deprecor a te : ne confundas faciem meam. Et dixit ei rex : Pete, mater mea : neque enim fas est ut avertam faciem tuam.
text_pt: Então disse ela: Só uma pequena petição te faço; não ma rejeites. E o rei lhe disse: Pede, minha mãe, porque não ta negarei.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ αἴτησιν μίαν μικρὰν ἐγὼ αἰτοῦμαι παρὰ σοῦ μὴ ἀποστρέψῃς τὸ πρόσωπόν σου καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῇ ὁ βασιλεύς αἴτησαι μῆτερ ἐμή ὅτι οὐκ ἀποστρέψω σε

text_en: And she said: Let Abisag, the Sunamitess, be given to Adonias , your brother, to wife.
text_la: Quæ ait: Detur Abisag Sunamitis Adoniæ fratri tuo uxor.
text_pt: E ela disse: Dê-se Abisague, a sunamita, a Adonias, teu irmão, por mulher.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν δοθήτω δὲ Αβισακ ἡ Σωμανῖτις τῷ Αδωνια τῷ ἀδελφῷ σου εἰς γυναῖκα

text_en: And King Solomon answered, and said to his mother: Why do you ask Abisag, the Sunamitess, for Adonias ? Ask for him also the kingdom; for he is my elder brother, and has Abiathar , the priest , and Joab, the son of Sarvia.
text_la: Responditque rex Salomon, et dixit matri suæ : Quare postulas Abisag Sunamitidem Adoniæ? postula ei et regnum : ipse est enim frater meus major me, et habet Abiathar sacerdotem, et Joab filium Sarviæ.
text_pt: Então respondeu o rei Salomão, e disse a sua mãe: E por que pedes a Abisague, a sunamita, para Adonias? Pede também para ele o reino (porque é meu irmão maior), para ele, digo, e também para Abiatar, sacerdote, e para Joabe, filho de Zeruia.
text_el: καὶ ἀπεκρίθη Σαλωμων ὁ βασιλεὺς καὶ εἶπεν τῇ μητρὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἵνα τί σὺ ᾔτησαι τὴν Αβισακ τῷ Αδωνια καὶ αἴτησαι αὐτῷ τὴν βασιλείαν ὅτι οὗτος ἀδελφός μου ὁ μέγας ὑπὲρ ἐμέ καὶ αὐτῷ Αβιαθαρ ὁ ἱερεὺς καὶ αὐτῷ Ιωαβ ὁ υἱὸς Σαρουιας ὁ ἀρχιστράτηγος ἑταῖρος

text_en: Then King Solomon swore by the Lord , saying: So and so may God do to me, and add more, if Adonias has not spoken this word against his own life.
text_la: Juravit itaque rex Salomon per Dominum, dicens : Hæc faciat mihi Deus, et hæc addat, quia contra animam suam locutus est Adonias verbum hoc.
text_pt: E jurou o rei Salomão pelo Senhor, dizendo: Assim Deus me faça, e outro tanto, se não falou Adonias esta palavra contra a sua vida.
text_el: καὶ ὤμοσεν ὁ βασιλεὺς Σαλωμων κατὰ τοῦ κυρίου λέγων τάδε ποιήσαι μοι ὁ θεὸς καὶ τάδε προσθείη ὅτι κατὰ τῆς ψυχῆς αὐτοῦ ἐλάλησεν Αδωνιας τὸν λόγον τοῦτον

text_en: And now, as the Lord lives, who has established me, and placed me upon the throne of David , my father, and who has made me a house, as he promised , Adonias shall be put to death this day.
text_la: Et nunc vivit Dominus, qui firmavit me, et collocavit me super solium David patris mei, et qui fecit mihi domum, sicut locutus est, quia hodie occidetur Adonias.
text_pt: Agora, pois, vive o Senhor, que me confirmou, e me fez assentar no trono de Davi, meu pai, e que me tem feito casa, como tinha falado, que hoje morrerá Adonias.
text_el: καὶ νῦν ζῇ κύριος ὃς ἡτοίμασέν με καὶ ἔθετό με ἐπὶ τὸν θρόνον Δαυιδ τοῦ πατρός μου καὶ αὐτὸς ἐποίησέν μοι οἶκον καθὼς ἐλάλησεν κύριος ὅτι σήμερον θανατωθήσεται Αδωνιας

text_en: And King Solomon sent by the hand of Banaias, the son of Joiada , who slew him, and he died.
text_la: Misitque rex Salomon per manum Banaiæ filii Jojadæ, qui interfecit eum, et mortuus est.
text_pt: E enviou o rei Salomão pela mão de Benaia, filho de Joiada, o qual arremeteu contra ele de modo que morreu.
text_el: καὶ ἐξαπέστειλεν Σαλωμων ὁ βασιλεὺς ἐν χειρὶ Βαναιου υἱοῦ Ιωδαε καὶ ἀνεῖλεν αὐτόν καὶ ἀπέθανεν Αδωνιας ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ

text_en: And the king said also to Abiathar , the priest : Go to Anathoth , to your lands, for indeed you are worthy of death: but I will not at this time put you to death, because you carried the ark of the Lord God before David , my father, and have endured trouble in all the troubles my father endured.
text_la: Abiathar quoque sacerdoti dixit rex : Vade in Anathoth ad agrum tuum : equidem vir mortis es : sed hodie te non interficiam, quia portasti arcam Domini Dei coram David patre meo, et sustinuisti laborem in omnibus in quibus laboravit pater meus.
text_pt: E a Abiatar, o sacerdote, disse o rei: Vai para Anatote, para os teus campos, porque és homem digno de morte; porém hoje não te matarei, porquanto levaste a arca do Senhor DEUS diante de Davi, meu pai, e porquanto foste aflito em tudo quanto meu pai foi aflito.
text_el: καὶ τῷ Αβιαθαρ τῷ ἱερεῖ εἶπεν ὁ βασιλεύς ἀπότρεχε σὺ εἰς Αναθωθ εἰς ἀγρόν σου ὅτι ἀνὴρ θανάτου εἶ σὺ ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ταύτῃ καὶ οὐ θανατώσω σε ὅτι ἦρας τὴν κιβωτὸν τῆς διαθήκης κυρίου ἐνώπιον τοῦ πατρός μου καὶ ὅτι ἐκακουχήθης ἐν ἅπασιν οἷς ἐκακουχήθη ὁ πατήρ μου

text_en: So Solomon cast out Abiathar from being the priest of the Lord , that the word of the Lord might be fulfilled, which he spoke concerning the house of Heli in Silo.
text_la: Ejecit ergo Salomon Abiathar ut non esset sacerdos Domini, ut impleretur sermo Domini quem locutus est super domum Heli in Silo.
text_pt: Lançou, pois, Salomão fora a Abiatar, para que não fosse sacerdote do Senhor, para cumprir a palavra do Senhor, que tinha falado sobre a casa de Eli em Siló.
text_el: καὶ ἐξέβαλεν Σαλωμων τὸν Αβιαθαρ τοῦ μὴ εἶναι ἱερέα τοῦ κυρίου πληρωθῆναι τὸ ῥῆμα κυρίου ὃ ἐλάλησεν ἐπὶ τὸν οἶκον Ηλι ἐν Σηλωμ

text_en: And the news came to Joab, because Joab had turned after Adonias , and had not turned after Solomon : and Joab fled into the tabernacle of the Lord , and took hold on the horn of the altar .
text_la: Venit autem nuntius ad Joab, quod Joab declinasset post Adoniam, et post Salomonem non declinasset : fugit ergo Joab in tabernaculum Domini, et apprehendit cornu altaris.
text_pt: E chegou a notícia até Joabe (porque Joabe tinha se desviado seguindo a Adonias, ainda que não tinha se desviado seguindo a Absalão), e Joabe fugiu para o tabernáculo do Senhor, e apegou-se às pontas do altar.
text_el: καὶ ἡ ἀκοὴ ἦλθεν ἕως Ιωαβ τοῦ υἱοῦ Σαρουιας ὅτι Ιωαβ ἦν κεκλικὼς ὀπίσω Αδωνιου καὶ ὀπίσω Σαλωμων οὐκ ἔκλινεν καὶ ἔφυγεν Ιωαβ εἰς τὸ σκήνωμα τοῦ κυρίου καὶ κατέσχεν τῶν κεράτων τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου

text_en: And it was told King Solomon , that Joab was fled into the tabernacle of the Lord , and was by the altar : and Solomon sent Banaias, the son of Joiada , saying. Go, kill him.
text_la: Nuntiatumque est regi Salomoni quod fugisset Joab in tabernaculum Domini, et esset juxta altare : misitque Salomon Banaiam filium Jojadæ, dicens : Vade, interfice eum.
text_pt: E disseram ao rei Salomão que Joabe tinha fugido para o tabernáculo do Senhor; e eis que está junto ao altar; então Salomão enviou Benaia, filho de Joiada, dizendo: Vai, arremete sobre ele.
text_el: καὶ ἀπηγγέλη τῷ Σαλωμων λέγοντες ὅτι ἔφυγεν Ιωαβ εἰς τὴν σκηνὴν τοῦ κυρίου καὶ ἰδοὺ κατέχει τῶν κεράτων τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου καὶ ἀπέστειλεν Σαλωμων πρὸς Ιωαβ λέγων τί γέγονέν σοι ὅτι πέφευγας εἰς τὸ θυσιαστήριον καὶ εἶπεν Ιωαβ ὅτι ἐφοβήθην ἀπὸ προσώπου σου καὶ ἔφυγον πρὸς κύριον καὶ ἀπέστειλεν Σαλωμων ὁ βασιλεὺς τὸν Βαναιου υἱὸν Ιωδαε λέγων πορεύου καὶ ἄνελε αὐτὸν καὶ θάψον αὐτόν

text_en: And Banaias came to the tabernacle of the Lord , and said to him: Thus says the king: Come forth. And he said: I will not come forth, but here I will die. Banaias brought word back to the king, saying: Thus says Joab, and thus he answered me.
text_la: Et venit Banaias ad tabernaculum Domini, et dixit ei : Hæc dicit rex : Egredere. Qui ait : Non egrediar, sed hic moriar. Renuntiavit Banaias regi sermonem, dicens : Hæc locutus est Joab, et hæc respondit mihi.
text_pt: E foi Benaia ao tabernáculo do Senhor, e lhe disse: Assim diz o rei: Sai daí. E disse ele: Não, porém aqui morrerei. E Benaia tornou com a resposta ao rei, dizendo: Assim falou Joabe, e assim me respondeu.
text_el: καὶ ἦλθεν Βαναιου υἱὸς Ιωδαε πρὸς Ιωαβ εἰς τὴν σκηνὴν τοῦ κυρίου καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ τάδε λέγει ὁ βασιλεύς ἔξελθε καὶ εἶπεν Ιωαβ οὐκ ἐκπορεύομαι ὅτι ὧδε ἀποθανοῦμαι καὶ ἀπέστρεψεν Βαναιας υἱὸς Ιωδαε καὶ εἶπεν τῷ βασιλεῖ λέγων τάδε λελάληκεν Ιωαβ καὶ τάδε ἀποκέκριταί μοι

text_en: And the king said to him: Do as he has said; and kill him, and bury him, and you shall remove the innocent blood which has been shed by Joab, from me, and from the house of my father:
text_la: Dixitque ei rex : Fac sicut locutus est, et interfice eum, et sepeli : et amovebis sanguinem innocentem qui effusus est a Joab, a me, et a domo patris mei.
text_pt: E disse-lhe o rei: Faze como ele disse, e arremete contra ele, e sepulta-o, para que tires de mim e da casa de meu pai o sangue que Joabe sem causa derramou.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὁ βασιλεύς πορεύου καὶ ποίησον αὐτῷ καθὼς εἴρηκεν καὶ ἄνελε αὐτὸν καὶ θάψεις αὐτὸν καὶ ἐξαρεῖς σήμερον τὸ αἷμα ὃ δωρεὰν ἐξέχεεν Ιωαβ ἀπ' ἐμοῦ καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ οἴκου τοῦ πατρός μου

text_en: And the Lord shall return his blood upon his own head; because he murdered two men , just and better than himself: and slew them with the sword, my father, David , not knowing it; Abner , the son of Ner, general of the army of Israel , and Amasa, the son of Jether general of the army of Juda ;
text_la: Et reddet Dominus sanguinem ejus super caput ejus, quia interfecit duos viros justos, melioresque se : et occidit eos gladio, patre meo David ignorante, Abner filium Ner principem militiæ Israël, et Amasam filium Jether principem exercitus Juda:
text_pt: Assim o Senhor fará recair o sangue dele sobre a sua cabeça, porque deu sobre dois homens mais justos e melhores do que ele, e os matou à espada, sem que meu pai Davi o soubesse, a saber: a Abner, filho de Ner, capitão do exército de Israel, e a Amasa, filho de Jeter, capitão do exército de Judá.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστρεψεν κύριος τὸ αἷμα τῆς ἀδικίας αὐτοῦ εἰς κεφαλὴν αὐτοῦ ὡς ἀπήντησεν τοῖς δυσὶν ἀνθρώποις τοῖς δικαίοις καὶ ἀγαθοῖς ὑπὲρ αὐτὸν καὶ ἀπέκτεινεν αὐτοὺς ἐν ῥομφαίᾳ καὶ ὁ πατήρ μου Δαυιδ οὐκ ἔγνω τὸ αἷμα αὐτῶν τὸν Αβεννηρ υἱὸν Νηρ ἀρχιστράτηγον Ισραηλ καὶ τὸν Αμεσσα υἱὸν Ιεθερ ἀρχιστράτηγον Ιουδα

text_en: and their blood shall return upon the head of Joab, and upon the head of his seed for ever. But to David and his seed, and his house, and to his throne, be peace for ever from the Lord .
text_la: et revertetur sanguis illorum in caput Joab, et in caput seminis ejus in sempiternum. David autem et semini ejus, et domui, et throno illius, sit pax usque in æternum a Domino.
text_pt: Assim recairá o sangue destes sobre a cabeça de Joabe e sobre a cabeça da sua descendência para sempre; mas a Davi, e à sua descendência, e à sua casa, e ao seu trono, dará o Senhor paz para todo o sempre.
text_el: καὶ ἐπεστράφη τὰ αἵματα αὐτῶν εἰς κεφαλὴν αὐτοῦ καὶ εἰς κεφαλὴν τοῦ σπέρματος αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα καὶ τῷ Δαυιδ καὶ τῷ σπέρματι αὐτοῦ καὶ τῷ οἴκῳ αὐτοῦ καὶ τῷ θρόνῳ αὐτοῦ γένοιτο εἰρήνη ἕως αἰῶνος παρὰ κυρίου

text_en: So Banaias, the son of Joiada , went up, and setting upon him slew him, and he was buried in his house in the desert .
text_la: Ascendit itaque Banaias filius Jojadæ, et aggressus eum interfecit : sepultusque est in domo sua in deserto.
text_pt: E subiu Benaia, filho de Joiada, e arremeteu contra ele, e o matou; e foi sepultado em sua casa, no deserto.
text_el: καὶ ἀπήντησεν Βαναιου υἱὸς Ιωδαε τῷ Ιωαβ καὶ ἐθανάτωσεν αὐτὸν καὶ ἔθαψεν αὐτὸν ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ αὐτοῦ ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ

text_en: And the king appointed Banaias, the son of Joiada in his room over the army; and Sadoc, the priest , he put in the place of Abiathar .
text_la: Et constituit rex Banaiam filium Jojadæ pro eo super exercitum, et Sadoc sacerdotem posuit pro Abiathar.
text_pt: E o rei pôs a Benaia, filho de Joiada, em seu lugar sobre o exército, e a Zadoque, o sacerdote, pôs o rei em lugar de Abiatar.
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκεν ὁ βασιλεὺς τὸν Βαναιου υἱὸν Ιωδαε ἀντ' αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὴν στρατηγίαν καὶ ἡ βασιλεία κατωρθοῦτο ἐν Ιερουσαλημ καὶ τὸν Σαδωκ τὸν ἱερέα ἔδωκεν ὁ βασιλεὺς εἰς ἱερέα πρῶτον ἀντὶ Αβιαθαρ

text_en: The king also sent, and called for Semei, and said to him: Build you a house in Jerusalem , and dwell there: and go not out from thence any where.
text_la: Misit quoque rex, et vocavit Semei : dixitque ei : Ædifica tibi domum in Jerusalem, et habita ibi : et non egredieris inde huc atque illuc.
text_pt: Depois mandou o rei, e chamou a Simei, e disse-lhe: Edifica-te uma casa em Jerusalém, e habita aí, e daí não saias, nem para uma nem para outra parte.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάλεσεν ὁ βασιλεὺς τὸν Σεμεϊ καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ οἰκοδόμησον σεαυτῷ οἶκον ἐν Ιερουσαλημ καὶ κάθου ἐκεῖ καὶ οὐκ ἐξελεύσῃ ἐκεῖθεν οὐδαμοῦ

text_en: For on what day soever you shall go out, and shall pass over the brook Cedron , know that you shall be put to death: your blood shall be upon your own head.
text_la: Quacumque autem die egressus fueris, et transieris torrentem Cedron, scito te interficiendum : sanguis tuus erit super caput tuum.
text_pt: Porque há de ser que no dia em que saíres e passares o ribeiro de Cedrom, de certo que sem dúvida morrerás; o teu sangue será sobre a tua cabeça.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῆς ἐξόδου σου καὶ διαβήσῃ τὸν χειμάρρουν Κεδρων γινώσκων γνώσῃ ὅτι θανάτῳ ἀποθανῇ τὸ αἷμά σου ἔσται ἐπὶ τὴν κεφαλήν σου καὶ ὥρκισεν αὐτὸν ὁ βασιλεὺς ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ

text_en: And Semei said to the king: The saying is good : as my lord the king has said, so will your servant do. And Semei dwelt in Jerusalem many days.
text_la: Dixitque Semei regi : Bonus sermo : sicut locutus est dominus meus rex, sic faciet servus tuus. Habitavit itaque Semei in Jerusalem diebus multis.
text_pt: E Simei disse ao rei: Boa é essa palavra; como tem falado o rei meu senhor, assim fará o teu servo. E Simei habitou em Jerusalém muitos dias.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Σεμεϊ πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα ἀγαθὸν τὸ ῥῆμα ὃ ἐλάλησας κύριέ μου βασιλεῦ οὕτω ποιήσει ὁ δοῦλός σου καὶ ἐκάθισεν Σεμεϊ ἐν Ιερουσαλημ τρία ἔτη

text_en: And it came to pass after three years, that the servants of Semei ran away to Achis, the son of Maacha, the king of Geth: and it was told Semei that his servants had gone to Geth.
text_la: Factum est autem post annos tres ut fugerent servi Semei ad Achis filium Maacha regem Geth: nuntiatumque est Semei quod servi ejus issent in Geth.
text_pt: Sucedeu, porém, que, ao cabo de três anos, dois servos de Simei fugiram para Aquis, filho de Maaca, rei de Gate; e deram parte a Simei, dizendo: Eis que teus servos estão em Gate.
text_el: καὶ ἐγενήθη μετὰ τρία ἔτη καὶ ἀπέδρασαν δύο δοῦλοι τοῦ Σεμεϊ πρὸς Αγχους υἱὸν Μααχα βασιλέα Γεθ καὶ ἀπηγγέλη τῷ Σεμεϊ λέγοντες ἰδοὺ οἱ δοῦλοί σου ἐν Γεθ

text_en: And Semei arose, and saddled his ass, and went to Achis, to Geth, to seek his servants, and he brought them out of Geth.
text_la: Et surrexit Semei, et stravit asinum suum, ivitque ad Achis in Geth ad requirendum servos suos, et adduxit eos de Geth.
text_pt: Então Simei se levantou, e albardou o seu jumento, e foi a Gate, ter com Aquis, em busca de seus servos; assim foi Simei, e trouxe os seus servos de Gate.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέστη Σεμεϊ καὶ ἐπέσαξε τὴν ὄνον αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπορεύθη εἰς Γεθ πρὸς Αγχους τοῦ ἐκζητῆσαι τοὺς δούλους αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπορεύθη Σεμεϊ καὶ ἤγαγεν τοὺς δούλους αὐτοῦ ἐκ Γεθ

text_en: And it was told Solomon , that Semei had gone from Jerusalem to Geth, and had come back.
text_la: Nuntiatum est autem Salomoni quod isset Semei in Geth de Jerusalem, et rediisset.
text_pt: E disseram a Salomão como Simei fora de Jerusalém a Gate, e já tinha voltado.
text_el: καὶ ἀπηγγέλη τῷ Σαλωμων λέγοντες ὅτι ἐπορεύθη Σεμεϊ ἐξ Ιερουσαλημ εἰς Γεθ καὶ ἀπέστρεψεν τοὺς δούλους αὐτοῦ

text_en: And sending he called for him, and said to him: Did I not protest to you by the Lord , and tell you before: On what day soever you shall go out and walk abroad any where, know that you shall die? And you answered me: The word that I have heard is good .
text_la: Et mittens vocavit eum, dixitque illi : Nonne testificatus sum tibi per Dominum, et prædixi tibi : Quacumque die egressus ieris huc et illuc, scito te esse moriturum : et respondisti mihi : Bonus sermo, quem audivi?
text_pt: Então o rei mandou chamar a Simei, e disse-lhe: Não te conjurei eu pelo Senhor, e protestei contra ti, dizendo: No dia em que saíres para uma ou outra parte, sabe de certo que, sem dúvida, morrerás? E tu me disseste: Boa é essa palavra que ouvi.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν ὁ βασιλεὺς καὶ ἐκάλεσεν τὸν Σεμεϊ καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτόν οὐχὶ ὥρκισά σε κατὰ τοῦ κυρίου καὶ ἐπεμαρτυράμην σοι λέγων ἐν ᾗ ἂν ἡμέρᾳ ἐξέλθῃς ἐξ Ιερουσαλημ καὶ πορευθῇς εἰς δεξιὰ ἢ εἰς ἀριστερά γινώσκων γνώσῃ ὅτι θανάτῳ ἀποθανῇ

text_en: Why then have you not kept the oath of the Lord , and the commandment that I laid upon you?
text_la: quare ergo non custodisti jusjurandum Domini, et præceptum quod præceperam tibi?
text_pt: Por que, pois, não guardaste o juramento do Senhor, nem a ordem que te dei?
text_el: καὶ τί ὅτι οὐκ ἐφύλαξας τὸν ὅρκον κυρίου καὶ τὴν ἐντολήν ἣν ἐνετειλάμην κατὰ σοῦ

text_en: And the king said to Semei: You know all the evil , of which your heart is conscious, which you did to David , my father: the Lord has returned your wickedness upon your own head.
text_la: Dixitque rex ad Semei : Tu nosti omne malum cujus tibi conscium est cor tuum, quod fecisti David patri meo : reddidit Dominus malitiam tuam in caput tuum:
text_pt: Disse mais o rei a Simei: Bem sabes tu toda a maldade que o teu coração reconhece, que fizeste a Davi, meu pai; pelo que o Senhor fez recair a tua maldade sobre a tua cabeça.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ βασιλεὺς πρὸς Σεμεϊ σὺ οἶδας πᾶσαν τὴν κακίαν σου ἣν ἔγνω ἡ καρδία σου ἃ ἐποίησας τῷ Δαυιδ τῷ πατρί μου καὶ ἀνταπέδωκεν κύριος τὴν κακίαν σου εἰς κεφαλήν σου

text_en: And King Solomon shall be blessed , and the throne of David shall be established before the Lord for ever.
text_la: et rex Salomon benedictus, et thronus David erit stabilis coram Domino usque in sempiternum.
text_pt: Mas o rei Salomão será abençoado, e o trono de Davi será confirmado perante o Senhor para sempre.
text_el: καὶ ὁ βασιλεὺς Σαλωμων ηὐλογημένος καὶ ὁ θρόνος Δαυιδ ἔσται ἕτοιμος ἐνώπιον κυρίου εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα

text_en: So the king commanded Banaias, the son of Joiada : and he went out and struck him; and he died.
text_la: Jussit itaque rex Banaiæ filio Jojadæ, qui egressus, percussit eum, et mortuus est.
text_pt: E o rei mandou a Benaia, filho de Joiada, o qual saiu, e arremeteu contra ele, de modo que morreu; assim foi confirmado o reino na mão de Salomão.
text_el: καὶ ἐνετείλατο ὁ βασιλεὺς Σαλωμων τῷ Βαναια υἱῷ Ιωδαε καὶ ἐξῆλθεν καὶ ἀνεῖλεν αὐτόν καὶ ἀπέθανεν

text_en: And the kingdom was established in the hand of Solomon , and he made affinity with Pharao , the king of Egypt : for he took his daughter, and brought her into the city of David: until he had made an end of building his own house, and the house of the Lord , and the wall of Jerusalem round about.
text_la: Confirmatum est igitur regnum in manu Salomonis, et affinitate conjunctus est Pharaoni regi Ægypti : accepit namque filiam ejus, et adduxit in civitatem David, donec compleret ædificans domum suam, et domum Domini, et murum Jerusalem per circuitum.
text_pt: E Salomão se aparentou com Faraó, rei do Egito; e tomou a filha de Faraó, e a trouxe à cidade de Davi, até que acabasse de edificar a sua casa, e a casa do SENHOR, e a muralha de Jerusalém em redor.

text_en: But yet the people sacrificed in the high places: for there was no temple built to the name of the Lord until that day.
text_la: Attamen populus immolabat in excelsis : non enim ædificatum erat templum nomini Domini usque in diem illum.
text_pt: Entretanto, o povo sacrificava sobre os altos; porque até àqueles dias ainda não se havia edificado casa ao nome do Senhor.
text_el: πλὴν ὁ λαὸς ἦσαν θυμιῶντες ἐπὶ τοῖς ὑψηλοῖς ὅτι οὐκ ᾠκοδομήθη οἶκος τῷ ὀνόματι κυρίου ἕως νῦν

text_en: And Solomon loved the Lord , walking in the precepts of David , his father; only he sacrificed in the high places, and burnt incense .
text_la: Dilexit autem Salomon Dominum, ambulans in præceptis David patris sui, excepto quod in excelsis immolabat, et accendebat thymiama.
text_pt: E Salomão amava ao Senhor, andando nos estatutos de Davi seu pai; somente que nos altos sacrificava, e queimava incenso.
text_el: καὶ ἠγάπησεν Σαλωμων τὸν κύριον πορεύεσθαι ἐν τοῖς προστάγμασιν Δαυιδ τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ πλὴν ἐν τοῖς ὑψηλοῖς ἔθυεν καὶ ἐθυμία

text_en: He went therefore to Gabaon, to sacrifice there: for that was the great high place: a thousand victims for holocausts , did Solomon offer upon that altar , in Gabaon.
text_la: Abiit itaque in Gabaon, ut immolaret ibi : illud quippe erat excelsum maximum : mille hostias in holocaustum obtulit Salomon super altare illud in Gabaon.
text_pt: E foi o rei a Gibeom para lá sacrificar, porque aquele era o alto maior; mil holocaustos sacrificou Salomão naquele altar.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέστη καὶ ἐπορεύθη εἰς Γαβαων θῦσαι ἐκεῖ ὅτι αὐτὴ ὑψηλοτάτη καὶ μεγάλη χιλίαν ὁλοκαύτωσιν ἀνήνεγκεν Σαλωμων ἐπὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον ἐν Γαβαων

text_en: And the Lord appeared to Solomon in a dream by night, saying: Ask what you will that I should give you.
text_la: Apparuit autem Dominus Salomoni per somnium nocte, dicens : Postula quod vis ut dem tibi.
text_pt: E em Gibeom apareceu o Senhor a Salomão de noite em sonhos; e disse-lhe Deus: Pede o que queres que eu te dê.
text_el: καὶ ὤφθη κύριος τῷ Σαλωμων ἐν ὕπνῳ τὴν νύκτα καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς Σαλωμων αἴτησαί τι αἴτημα σαυτῷ

text_en: And Solomon said: You have showed great mercy to your servant David , my father, even as he walked before you in truth , and justice , and an upright heart with you: and you have kept your great mercy for him, and have given him a son to sit on his throne, as it is this day.
text_la: Et ait Salomon : Tu fecisti cum servo tuo David patre meo misericordiam magnam, sicut ambulavit in conspectu tuo in veritate et justitia, et recto corde tecum : custodisti ei misericordiam tuam grandem, et dedisti ei filium sedentem super thronum ejus, sicut est hodie.
text_pt: E disse Salomão: De grande beneficência usaste tu com teu servo Davi, meu pai, como também ele andou contigo em verdade, e em justiça, e em retidão de coração, perante a tua face; e guardaste-lhe esta grande beneficência, e lhe deste um filho que se assentasse no seu trono, como se vê neste dia.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Σαλωμων σὺ ἐποίησας μετὰ τοῦ δούλου σου Δαυιδ τοῦ πατρός μου ἔλεος μέγα καθὼς διῆλθεν ἐνώπιόν σου ἐν ἀληθείᾳ καὶ ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ καὶ ἐν εὐθύτητι καρδίας μετὰ σοῦ καὶ ἐφύλαξας αὐτῷ τὸ ἔλεος τὸ μέγα τοῦτο δοῦναι τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τοῦ θρόνου αὐτοῦ ὡς ἡ ἡμέρα αὕτη

text_en: And now, O Lord God , you have made your servant king instead of David , my father: and I am but a child, and know not how to go out and come in;
text_la: Et nunc Domine Deus, tu regnare fecisti servum tuum pro David patre meo : ego autem sum puer parvulus, et ignorans egressum et introitum meum.
text_pt: Agora, pois, ó Senhor meu Deus, tu fizeste reinar a teu servo em lugar de Davi meu pai; e sou apenas um menino pequeno; não sei como sair, nem como entrar.
text_el: καὶ νῦν κύριε ὁ θεός μου σὺ ἔδωκας τὸν δοῦλόν σου ἀντὶ Δαυιδ τοῦ πατρός μου καὶ ἐγώ εἰμι παιδάριον μικρὸν καὶ οὐκ οἶδα τὴν ἔξοδόν μου καὶ τὴν εἴσοδόν μου

text_en: and your servant is in the midst of the people which you have chosen, an immense people, which cannot be numbered nor counted for multitude.
text_la: Et servus tuus in medio est populi quem elegisti, populi infiniti, qui numerari et supputari non potest præ multitudine.
text_pt: E teu servo está no meio do teu povo que elegeste; povo grande, que nem se pode contar, nem numerar, pela sua multidão.
text_el: ὁ δὲ δοῦλός σου ἐν μέσῳ τοῦ λαοῦ σου ὃν ἐξελέξω λαὸν πολύν ὃς οὐκ ἀριθμηθήσεται

text_en: Give therefore to your servant an understanding heart, to judge your people, and discern between good and evil . For who shall be able to judge this people, your people, which is so numerous?
text_la: Dabis ergo servo tuo cor docile, ut populum tuum judicare possit, et discernere inter bonum et malum. Quis enim poterit judicare populum istum, populum tuum hunc multum?
text_pt: A teu servo, pois, dá um coração entendido para julgar a teu povo, para que prudentemente discirna entre o bem e o mal; porque quem poderia julgar a este teu tão grande povo?
text_el: καὶ δώσεις τῷ δούλῳ σου καρδίαν ἀκούειν καὶ διακρίνειν τὸν λαόν σου ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ τοῦ συνίειν ἀνὰ μέσον ἀγαθοῦ καὶ κακοῦ ὅτι τίς δυνήσεται κρίνειν τὸν λαόν σου τὸν βαρὺν τοῦτον

text_en: And the word was pleasing to the Lord , that Solomon had asked such a thing.
text_la: Placuit ergo sermo coram Domino, quod Salomon postulasset hujuscemodi rem.
text_pt: E esta palavra pareceu boa aos olhos do Senhor, de que Salomão pedisse isso.
text_el: καὶ ἤρεσεν ἐνώπιον κυρίου ὅτι ᾐτήσατο Σαλωμων τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦτο

text_en: And the Lord said to Solomon : Because you have asked this thing, and have not asked for yourself long life nor riches, nor the lives of your enemies, but have asked for yourself wisdom to discern judgment;
text_la: Et dixit Dominus Salomoni : Quia postulasti verbum hoc, et non petisti tibi dies multos, nec divitias, aut animas inimicorum tuorum, sed postulasti tibi sapientiam ad discernendum judicium:
text_pt: E disse-lhe Deus: Porquanto pediste isso, e não pediste para ti muitos dias, nem pediste para ti riquezas, nem pediste a vida de teus inimigos; mas pediste para ti entendimento, para discernires o que é justo;
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς αὐτόν ἀνθ' ὧν ᾐτήσω παρ' ἐμοῦ τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦτο καὶ οὐκ ᾐτήσω σαυτῷ ἡμέρας πολλὰς καὶ οὐκ ᾐτήσω πλοῦτον οὐδὲ ᾐτήσω ψυχὰς ἐχθρῶν σου ἀλλ' ᾐτήσω σαυτῷ σύνεσιν τοῦ εἰσακούειν κρίμα

text_en: behold I have done for you according to your words, and have given you a wise and understanding heart, in so much that there has been no one like you before you, nor shall arise after you.
text_la: ecce feci tibi secundum sermones tuos, et dedi tibi cor sapiens et intelligens, in tantum ut nullus ante te similis tui fuerit, nec post te surrecturus sit.
text_pt: Eis que fiz segundo as tuas palavras; eis que te dei um coração tão sábio e entendido, que antes de ti igual não houve, e depois de ti igual não se levantará.
text_el: ἰδοὺ πεποίηκα κατὰ τὸ ῥῆμά σου ἰδοὺ δέδωκά σοι καρδίαν φρονίμην καὶ σοφήν ὡς σὺ οὐ γέγονεν ἔμπροσθέν σου καὶ μετὰ σὲ οὐκ ἀναστήσεται ὅμοιός σοι

text_en: Yea, and the things also which you did not ask, I have given you; to wit, riches and glory : so that no one has been like you among the kings in all days heretofore.
text_la: Sed et hæc quæ non postulasti, dedi tibi : divitias scilicet, et gloriam, ut nemo fuerit similis tui in regibus cunctis retro diebus.
text_pt: E também até o que não pediste te dei, assim riquezas como glória; de modo que não haverá um igual entre os reis, por todos os teus dias.
text_el: καὶ ἃ οὐκ ᾐτήσω δέδωκά σοι καὶ πλοῦτον καὶ δόξαν ὡς οὐ γέγονεν ἀνὴρ ὅμοιός σοι ἐν βασιλεῦσιν

text_en: And if you will walk in my ways, and keep my precepts and my commandments, as your father walked, I will lengthen your days.
text_la: Si autem ambulaveris in viis meis, et custodieris præcepta mea et mandata mea, sicut ambulavit pater tuus, longos faciam dies tuos.
text_pt: E, se andares nos meus caminhos, guardando os meus estatutos, e os meus mandamentos, como andou Davi teu pai, também prolongarei os teus dias.
text_el: καὶ ἐὰν πορευθῇς ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ μου φυλάσσειν τὰς ἐντολάς μου καὶ τὰ προστάγματά μου ὡς ἐπορεύθη Δαυιδ ὁ πατήρ σου καὶ πληθυνῶ τὰς ἡμέρας σου

text_en: And Solomon awaked, and perceived that it was a dream: and when he had come to Jerusalem , he stood before the ark of the covenant of the Lord , and offered holocausts , and sacrificed victims of peace offerings , and made a great feast for all his servants.
text_la: Igitur evigilavit Salomon, et intellexit quod esset somnium : cumque venisset Jerusalem, stetit coram arca fœderis Domini, et obtulit holocausta, et fecit victimas pacificas, et grande convivium universis famulis suis.
text_pt: E acordou Salomão, e eis que era sonho. E indo a Jerusalém, pôs-se perante a arca da aliança do Senhor, e sacrificou holocausto, e preparou sacrifícios pacíficos, e fez um banquete a todos os seus servos.
text_el: καὶ ἐξυπνίσθη Σαλωμων καὶ ἰδοὺ ἐνύπνιον καὶ ἀνέστη καὶ παραγίνεται εἰς Ιερουσαλημ καὶ ἔστη κατὰ πρόσωπον τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου τοῦ κατὰ πρόσωπον κιβωτοῦ διαθήκης κυρίου ἐν Σιων καὶ ἀνήγαγεν ὁλοκαυτώσεις καὶ ἐποίησεν εἰρηνικὰς καὶ ἐποίησεν πότον μέγαν ἑαυτῷ καὶ πᾶσιν τοῖς παισὶν αὐτοῦ

text_en: Then there came two women that were harlots, to the king, and stood before him.
text_la: Tunc venerunt duæ mulieres meretrices ad regem, steteruntque coram eo:
text_pt: Então vieram duas mulheres prostitutas ao rei, e se puseram perante ele.
text_el: τότε ὤφθησαν δύο γυναῖκες πόρναι τῷ βασιλεῖ καὶ ἔστησαν ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ

text_en: And one of them said: I beseech you, my lord, I and this woman dwelt in one house, and I was delivered of a child with her in the chamber.
text_la: quarum una ait : Obsecro, mi domine : ego et mulier hæc habitabamus in domo una, et peperi apud eam in cubiculo.
text_pt: E disse-lhe uma das mulheres: Ah! senhor meu, eu e esta mulher moramos numa casa; e tive um filho, estando com ela naquela casa.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ἡ γυνὴ ἡ μία ἐν ἐμοί κύριε ἐγὼ καὶ ἡ γυνὴ αὕτη οἰκοῦμεν ἐν οἴκῳ ἑνὶ καὶ ἐτέκομεν ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ

text_en: And the third day after I was delivered, she also was delivered; and we were together, and no other person with us in the house; only we two.
text_la: Tertia autem die postquam ego peperi, peperit et hæc : et eramus simul, nullusque alius nobiscum in domo, exceptis nobis duabus.
text_pt: E sucedeu que, ao terceiro dia, depois do meu parto, teve um filho também esta mulher; estávamos juntas; nenhum estranho estava conosco na casa; somente nós duas naquela casa.
text_el: καὶ ἐγενήθη ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ τρίτῃ τεκούσης μου καὶ ἔτεκεν καὶ ἡ γυνὴ αὕτη καὶ ἡμεῖς κατὰ τὸ αὐτό καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν οὐθεὶς μεθ' ἡμῶν πάρεξ ἀμφοτέρων ἡμῶν ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ

text_en: And this woman's child died in the night: for in her sleep she overlaid him.
text_la: Mortuus est autem filius mulieris hujus nocte : dormiens quippe oppressit eum.
text_pt: E de noite morreu o filho desta mulher, porquanto se deitara sobre ele.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέθανεν ὁ υἱὸς τῆς γυναικὸς ταύτης τὴν νύκτα ὡς ἐπεκοιμήθη ἐπ' αὐτόν

text_en: And rising in the dead time of the night, she took my child from my side, while I, your handmaid, was asleep, and laid it in her bosom: and laid her dead child in my bosom.
text_la: Et consurgens intempestæ noctis silentio, tulit filium meum de latere meo, ancillæ tuæ dormientis, et collocavit in sinu suo : suum autem filium, qui erat mortuus, posuit in sinu meo.
text_pt: E levantou-se à meia-noite, e tirou o meu filho do meu lado, enquanto dormia a tua serva, e o deitou no seu seio; e a seu filho morto deitou no meu seio.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέστη μέσης τῆς νυκτὸς καὶ ἔλαβεν τὸν υἱόν μου ἐκ τῶν ἀγκαλῶν μου καὶ ἐκοίμισεν αὐτὸν ἐν τῷ κόλπῳ αὐτῆς καὶ τὸν υἱὸν αὐτῆς τὸν τεθνηκότα ἐκοίμισεν ἐν τῷ κόλπῳ μου

text_en: And when I arose in the morning, to give my child suck, behold it was dead: but considering him more diligently, when it was clear day, I found that it was not mine which I bore.
text_la: Cumque surrexissem mane ut darem lac filio meo, apparuit mortuus : quem diligentius intuens clara luce, deprehendi non esse meum quem genueram.
text_pt: E, levantando-me eu pela manhã, para dar de mamar a meu filho, eis que estava morto; mas, atentando pela manhã para ele, eis que não era meu filho, que eu havia tido.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέστην τὸ πρωὶ θηλάσαι τὸν υἱόν μου καὶ ἐκεῖνος ἦν τεθνηκώς καὶ ἰδοὺ κατενόησα αὐτὸν πρωί καὶ ἰδοὺ οὐκ ἦν ὁ υἱός μου ὃν ἔτεκον

text_en: And the other woman answered: It is not so as you say, but your child is dead, and mine is alive. On the contrary, she said; You lie: for my child lives, and your child is dead. And in this manner they strove before the king.
text_la: Responditque altera mulier : Non est ita ut dicis, sed filius tuus mortuus est, meus autem vivit. E contrario illa dicebat : Mentiris : filius quippe meus vivit, et filius tuus mortuus est. Atque in hunc modum contendebant coram rege.
text_pt: Então disse a outra mulher: Não, mas o vivo é meu filho, e teu filho o morto. Porém esta disse: Não, por certo, o morto é teu filho, e meu filho o vivo. Assim falaram perante o rei.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ἡ γυνὴ ἡ ἑτέρα οὐχί ἀλλὰ ὁ υἱός μου ὁ ζῶν ὁ δὲ υἱός σου ὁ τεθνηκώς καὶ ἐλάλησαν ἐνώπιον τοῦ βασιλέως

text_en: Then said the king: The one says, My child is alive, and your child is dead. And the other answers: Nay; but your child is dead, and mine lives.
text_la: Tunc rex ait : Hæc dicit : Filius meus vivit, et filius tuus mortuus est : et ista respondit : Non, sed filius tuus mortuus est, meus autem vivit.
text_pt: Então disse o rei: Esta diz: Este que vive é meu filho, e teu filho o morto; e esta outra diz: Não, por certo, o morto é teu filho e meu filho o vivo.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ βασιλεὺς αὐταῖς σὺ λέγεις οὗτος ὁ υἱός μου ὁ ζῶν καὶ ὁ υἱὸς ταύτης ὁ τεθνηκώς καὶ σὺ λέγεις οὐχί ἀλλὰ ὁ υἱός μου ὁ ζῶν καὶ ὁ υἱός σου ὁ τεθνηκώς

text_en: The king therefore said: Bring me a sword. And when they had brought a sword before the king,
text_la: Dixit ergo rex : Afferte mihi gladium. Cumque attulissent gladium coram rege,
text_pt: Disse mais o rei: Trazei-me uma espada. E trouxeram uma espada diante do rei.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ βασιλεύς λάβετέ μοι μάχαιραν καὶ προσήνεγκαν τὴν μάχαιραν ἐνώπιον τοῦ βασιλέως

text_en: divide, said he, the living child in two, and give half to the one and half to the other.
text_la: Dividite, inquit, infantem vivum in duas partes, et date dimidiam partem uni, et dimidiam partem alteri.
text_pt: E disse o rei: Dividi em duas partes o menino vivo; e dai metade a uma, e metade a outra.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ βασιλεύς διέλετε τὸ παιδίον τὸ θηλάζον τὸ ζῶν εἰς δύο καὶ δότε τὸ ἥμισυ αὐτοῦ ταύτῃ καὶ τὸ ἥμισυ αὐτοῦ ταύτῃ

text_en: But the woman , whose child was alive, said to the king; (for her bowels were moved upon her child) I beseech you, my lord, give her the child alive, and do not kill it. But the other said: Let it be neither mine nor yours; but divide it.
text_la: Dixit autem mulier, cujus filius erat vivus, ad regem (commota sunt quippe viscera ejus super filio suo) : Obsecro, domine, date illi infantem vivum, et nolite interficere eum. E contrario illa dicebat : Nec mihi nec tibi sit, sed dividatur.
text_pt: Mas a mulher, cujo filho era o vivo, falou ao rei (porque as suas entranhas se lhe enterneceram por seu filho), e disse: Ah! senhor meu, dai-lhe o menino vivo, e de modo nenhum o mateis. Porém a outra dizia: Nem teu nem meu seja; dividi-o.
text_el: καὶ ἀπεκρίθη ἡ γυνή ἧς ἦν ὁ υἱὸς ὁ ζῶν καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα ὅτι ἐταράχθη ἡ μήτρα αὐτῆς ἐπὶ τῷ υἱῷ αὐτῆς καὶ εἶπεν ἐν ἐμοί κύριε δότε αὐτῇ τὸ παιδίον καὶ θανάτῳ μὴ θανατώσητε αὐτόν καὶ αὕτη εἶπεν μήτε ἐμοὶ μήτε αὐτῇ ἔστω διέλετε

text_en: The king answered, and said: Give the living child to this woman , and let it not be killed; for she is the mother thereof.
text_la: Respondit rex, et ait : Date huic infantem vivum, et non occidatur : hæc est enim mater ejus.
text_pt: Então respondeu o rei, e disse: Dai a esta o menino vivo, e de maneira nenhuma o mateis, porque esta é sua mãe.
text_el: καὶ ἀπεκρίθη ὁ βασιλεὺς καὶ εἶπεν δότε τὸ παιδίον τῇ εἰπούσῃ δότε αὐτῇ αὐτὸ καὶ θανάτῳ μὴ θανατώσητε αὐτόν αὐτὴ ἡ μήτηρ αὐτοῦ

text_en: And all Israel heard the judgment which the king had judged, and they feared the king, seeing that the wisdom of God was in him to do judgment.
text_la: Audivit itaque omnis Israël judicium quod judicasset rex, et timuerunt regem, videntes sapientiam Dei esse in eo ad faciendum judicium.
text_pt: E todo o Israel ouviu o juízo que havia dado o rei, e temeu ao rei; porque viram que havia nele a sabedoria de Deus, para fazer justiça.
text_el: καὶ ἤκουσαν πᾶς Ισραηλ τὸ κρίμα τοῦτο ὃ ἔκρινεν ὁ βασιλεύς καὶ ἐφοβήθησαν ἀπὸ προσώπου τοῦ βασιλέως ὅτι εἶδον ὅτι φρόνησις θεοῦ ἐν αὐτῷ τοῦ ποιεῖν δικαίωμα

text_en: And King Solomon reigned over all Israel :
text_la: Erat autem rex Salomon regnans super omnem Israël:
text_pt: Assim foi Salomão rei sobre todo o Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἦν ὁ βασιλεὺς Σαλωμων βασιλεύων ἐπὶ Ισραηλ

text_en: And these were the princes which he had: Azarias, the son of Sadoc, the priest :
text_la: et hi principes quos habebat: Azarias filius Sadoc sacerdotis:
text_pt: E estes eram os príncipes que tinha: Azarias, filho de Zadoque, sacerdote;
text_el: καὶ οὗτοι οἱ ἄρχοντες οἳ ἦσαν αὐτοῦ Αζαριου υἱὸς Σαδωκ

text_en: Elihoreph, and Ahia, the sons of Sisa, scribes: Josaphat, the son of Ahilud, recorder:
text_la: Elihoreph et Ahia filii Sisa scribæ: Josaphat filius Ahilud a commentariis:
text_pt: Eliorefe e Aías, filhos de Sisa, secretários; Jeosafá, filho de Ailude, cronista;
text_el: καὶ Ελιαρεφ καὶ Αχια υἱὸς Σαβα γραμματεῖς καὶ Ιωσαφατ υἱὸς Αχιλιδ ὑπομιμνῄσκων

text_en: Banaias, the son of Joiada , over the army: and Sadoc, and Abiathar , priests .
text_la: Banaias filius Jojadæ super exercitum: Sadoc autem et Abiathar sacerdotes:
