text_pt: Benaia, filho de Joiada, sobre o exército; e Zadoque e Abiatar eram sacerdotes;
text_el: καὶ Σαδουχ καὶ Αβιαθαρ ἱερεῖς

text_en: Azarias, the son of Nathan , over them that were about the king: Zabud, the son of Nathan , the priest , the king's friend:
text_la: Azarias filius Nathan super eos qui assistebant regi : Zabud filius Nathan sacerdos, amicus regis:
text_pt: E Azarias, filho de Natã, sobre os provedores; e Zabude, filho de Natã, oficial-mor, amigo do rei;
text_el: καὶ Ορνια υἱὸς Ναθαν ἐπὶ τῶν καθεσταμένων καὶ Ζαβουθ υἱὸς Ναθαν ἑταῖρος τοῦ βασιλέως

text_en: And Ahisar, governor of the house: and Adoniram, the son of Abda, over the tribute.
text_la: et Ahisar præpositus domus: et Adoniram filius Abda super tributa.
text_pt: E Aisar, mordomo; Adonirão, filho de Abda, sobre o tributo.
text_el: καὶ Αχιηλ οἰκονόμος καὶ Ελιαβ υἱὸς Σαφ ἐπὶ τῆς πατριᾶς καὶ Αδωνιραμ υἱὸς Εφρα ἐπὶ τῶν φόρων

text_en: And Solomon had twelve governors over all Israel , who provided victuals for the king and for his house hold: for every one provided necessaries, each man his month in the year.
text_la: Habebat autem Salomon duodecim præfectos super omnem Israël, qui præbebant annonam regi et domui ejus : per singulos enim menses in anno, singuli necessaria ministrabant.
text_pt: E tinha Salomão doze oficiais sobre todo o Israel, que proviam ao rei e à sua casa; e cada um tinha que abastecê-lo por um mês no ano.
text_el: καὶ τῷ Σαλωμων δώδεκα καθεσταμένοι ἐπὶ πάντα Ισραηλ χορηγεῖν τῷ βασιλεῖ καὶ τῷ οἴκῳ αὐτοῦ μῆνα ἐν τῷ ἐνιαυτῷ ἐγίνετο ἐπὶ τὸν ἕνα χορηγεῖν

text_en: And these are their names : Benhur, in mount Ephraim.
text_la: Et hæc nomina eorum: Benhur in monte Ephraim.
text_pt: E estes são os seus nomes: Ben-Hur, nas montanhas de Efraim;
text_el: καὶ ταῦτα τὰ ὀνόματα αὐτῶν Βενωρ ἐν ὄρει Εφραιμ εἷς

text_en: Bendecar, in Macces, and in Salebim, and in Bethsames, and in Elon, and in Bethanan.
text_la: Bendecar in Macces, et in Salebim, et in Bethsames, et in Elon, et in Bethanan.
text_pt: Ben-Dequer em Macaz, e em Saalbim, e em Bete-Semes, e em Elom, e em Bete-Hanã;
text_el: υἱὸς Ρηχαβ ἐν Μαχεμας καὶ Βηθαλαμιν καὶ Βαιθσαμυς καὶ Αιλων ἕως Βαιθαναν εἷς

text_en: Benhesed, in Aruboth: his was Socho, and all the land of Epher.
text_la: Benhesed in Aruboth : ipsius erat Socho, et omnis terra Epher.
text_pt: Ben-Hesede em Arubote; também este tinha a Socó e a toda a terra de Hefer;
text_el: υἱὸς Εσωθ Βηρβηθνεμα Λουσαμηνχα καὶ Ρησφαρα

text_en: Benabinadab, to whom belonged all Nephath-Dor: he had Tapheth, the daughter of Solomon , to wife.
text_la: Benabinadab, cujus omnis Nephath Dor : Tapheth filiam Salomonis habebat uxorem.
text_pt: Ben-Abinadabe em todo o termo de Dor; tinha este a Tafate, filha de Salomão, por mulher;
text_el: Χιναναδαβ καὶ Αναφαθι ἀνὴρ Ταβληθ θυγάτηρ Σαλωμων ἦν αὐτῷ εἰς γυναῖκα εἷς

text_en: Bana, the son of Ahilud, who governed Thanac, and Mageddo , and all Bethsan , which is by Sarthana, beneath Jezrael, from Bethsan unto Abelmehula , over against Jecmaan.
text_la: Bana filius Ahilud regebat Thanac et Mageddo, et universam Bethsan, quæ est juxta Sarthana subter Jezrahel, a Bethsan usque Abelmehula e regione Jecmaan.
text_pt: Baana, filho de Ailude, tinha a Taanaque, e a Megido, e a toda a Bete-Seã, que está junto a Zaretã, abaixo de Jizreel, desde Bete-Seã até Abel-Meolá, para além de Jocmeão;
text_el: Βακχα υἱὸς Αχιλιδ Θααναχ καὶ Μεκεδω καὶ πᾶς ὁ οἶκος Σαν ὁ παρὰ Σεσαθαν ὑποκάτω τοῦ Εσραε καὶ ἐκ Βαισαφουδ Εβελμαωλα ἕως Μαεβερ Λουκαμ εἷς

text_en: Bengaber, in Ramoth Galaad: he had the town of Jair, the son of Manasses , in Galaad: he was chief in all the country of Argob, which is in Basan, threescore great cities with walls, and brazen bolts.
text_la: Bengaber in Ramoth Galaad : habebat Avothjair filii Manasse in Galaad : ipse præerat in omni regione Argob, quæ est in Basan, sexaginta civitatibus magnis atque muratis quæ habebant seras æreas.
text_pt: O filho de Geber, em Ramote de Gileade; tinha este as aldeias de Jair, filho de Manassés, as quais estão em Gileade; também tinha o termo de Argobe, o qual está em Basã, sessenta grandes cidades, com muros e ferrolhos de cobre;
text_el: υἱὸς Γαβερ ἐν Ρεμαθ Γαλααδ τούτῳ σχοίνισμα Ερεγαβα ἣ ἐν τῇ Βασαν ἑξήκοντα πόλεις μεγάλαι τειχήρεις καὶ μοχλοὶ χαλκοῖ εἷς

text_en: Ahinadab, the son of Addo, was chief in Manaim.
text_la: Ahinadab filius Addo præerat in Manaim.
text_pt: Ainadabe, filho de Ido, em Maanaim.
text_el: Αχιναδαβ υἱὸς Αχελ Μααναιν εἷς

text_en: Achimaas , in Nephthali : he also had Basemath, the daughter of Solomon , to wife.
text_la: Achimaas in Nephthali: sed et ipse habebat Basemath filiam Salomonis in conjugio.
text_pt: Aimaás em Naftali; também este tomou a Basemate, filha de Salomão, por mulher;
text_el: Αχιμαας ἐν Νεφθαλι καὶ οὗτος ἔλαβεν τὴν Βασεμμαθ θυγατέρα Σαλωμων εἰς γυναῖκα εἷς

text_en: Baana, the son of Husi, in Aser , and in Baloth.
text_la: Baana filius Husi in Aser, et in Baloth.
text_pt: Baaná, filho de Husai, em Aser e em Alote;
text_el: Βαανα υἱὸς Χουσι ἐν τῇ Μααλαθ εἷς

text_en: Josaphat, the son of Pharue, in Issachar .
text_la: Josaphat filius Pharue in Issachar.
text_pt: Jeosafá, filho de Parua, em Issacar;

text_en: Semei, the son of Ela, in Benjamin .
text_la: Semei filius Ela in Benjamin.
text_pt: Simei, filho de Elá, em Benjamim:
text_el: Σαμαα υἱὸς Ηλα ἐν τῷ Βενιαμιν

text_en: Gaber, the son of Uri, in the land of Galaad, in the land of Sehon, the king of the Amorrhites , and of Og, the king of Basan, over all that were in that land.
text_la: Gaber filius Uri in terra Galaad, in terra Sehon regis Amorrhæi et Og regis Basan, super omnia quæ erant in illa terra.
text_pt: Geber, filho de Uri, na terra de Gileade, a terra de Siom, rei dos amorreus, e de Ogue, rei de Basã; e só uma guarnição havia naquela terra.
text_el: Γαβερ υἱὸς Αδαι ἐν τῇ γῇ Γαδ γῇ Σηων βασιλέως τοῦ Εσεβων καὶ Ωγ βασιλέως τοῦ Βασαν καὶ νασιφ εἷς ἐν γῇ Ιουδα

text_en: Juda and Israel were innumerable, as the sand of the sea in multitude; eating and drinking, and rejoicing.
text_la: Juda et Israël innumerabiles, sicut arena maris in multitudine : comedentes, et bibentes, atque lætantes.
text_pt: Eram, pois, os de Judá e Israel muitos, como a areia que está junto ao mar em multidão, comendo, e bebendo, e alegrando-se.
text_el: Ιωσαφατ υἱὸς Φουασουδ ἐν Ισσαχαρ

text_en: And Solomon had under him all the kingdoms, from the river to the land of the Philistines , even to the border of Egypt : and they brought him presents, and served him all the days of his life.
text_la: Salomon autem erat in ditione sua, habens omnia regna a flumine terræ Philisthiim usque ad terminum Ægypti : offerentium sibi munera, et servientium ei cunctis diebus vitæ ejus.
text_pt: E dominava Salomão sobre todos os reinos desde o rio até à terra dos filisteus, e até ao termo do Egito; os quais traziam presentes, e serviram a Salomão todos os dias da sua vida.
text_el: καὶ ἐχορήγουν οἱ καθεσταμένοι οὕτως τῷ βασιλεῖ Σαλωμων καὶ πάντα τὰ διαγγέλματα ἐπὶ τὴν τράπεζαν τοῦ βασιλέως ἕκαστος μῆνα αὐτοῦ οὐ παραλλάσσουσιν λόγον καὶ τὰς κριθὰς καὶ τὸ ἄχυρον τοῖς ἵπποις καὶ τοῖς ἅρμασιν ᾖρον εἰς τὸν τόπον οὗ ἂν ᾖ ὁ βασιλεύς ἕκαστος κατὰ τὴν σύνταξιν αὐτοῦ

text_en: And the provision of Solomon , for each day, was thirty measures of fine flour, and threescore measures of meal;
text_la: Erat autem cibus Salomonis per dies singulos triginta cori similæ, et sexaginta cori farinæ,
text_pt: Era, pois, o provimento de Salomão cada dia, trinta coros de flor de farinha, e sessenta coros de farinha;
text_el: καὶ ταῦτα τὰ δέοντα τῷ Σαλωμων ἐν ἡμέρᾳ μιᾷ τριάκοντα κόροι σεμιδάλεως καὶ ἑξήκοντα κόροι ἀλεύρου κεκοπανισμένου

text_en: ten fat oxen, and twenty out of the pastures, and a hundred rams; besides venison of harts, roes, and buffles, and fatted fowls.
text_la: decem boves pingues, et viginti boves pascuales, et centum arietes, excepta venatione cervorum, caprearum, atque bubalorum, et avium altilium.
text_pt: Dez bois cevados, e vinte bois de pasto, e cem carneiros; afora os veados e as cabras montesas, e os corços, e aves cevadas.
text_el: καὶ δέκα μόσχοι ἐκλεκτοὶ καὶ εἴκοσι βόες νομάδες καὶ ἑκατὸν πρόβατα ἐκτὸς ἐλάφων καὶ δορκάδων καὶ ὀρνίθων ἐκλεκτῶν σιτευτά

text_en: For he had all the country which was beyond the river, from Thaphsa to Gazan, and all the kings of those countries: and he had peace on every side round about.
text_la: Ipse enim obtinebat omnem regionem quæ erat trans flumen, a Thaphsa usque ad Gazan, et cunctos reges illarum regionum : et habebat pacem ex omni parte in circuitu.
text_pt: Porque dominava sobre tudo quanto havia do lado de cá do rio, Tifsa até Gaza, sobre todos os reis do lado de cá do rio; e tinha paz de todos os lados em redor dele.
text_el: ὅτι ἦν ἄρχων πέραν τοῦ ποταμοῦ καὶ ἦν αὐτῷ εἰρήνη ἐκ πάντων τῶν μερῶν κυκλόθεν

text_en: And Juda , and Israel , dwelt without any fear, every one under his vine, and under his fig tree, from Dan to Bersabee , all the days of Solomon .
text_la: Habitabatque Juda et Israël absque timore ullo, unusquisque sub vite sua et sub ficu sua, a Dan usque Bersabee, cunctis diebus Salomonis.
text_pt: E Judá e Israel habitavam seguros, cada um debaixo da sua videira, e debaixo da sua figueira, desde Dã até Berseba, todos os dias de Salomão.

text_en: And Solomon had forty thousand stalls of chariot horses, and twelve thousand for the saddle.
text_la: Et habebat Salomon quadraginta millia præsepia equorum currilium, et duodecim millia equestrium.
text_pt: Tinha também Salomão quarenta mil estrebarias de cavalos para os seus carros, e doze mil cavaleiros.

text_en: And the foresaid governors of the king fed them; and they furnished the necessaries also for King Solomon's table, with great care, in their time.
text_la: Nutriebantque eos supradicti regis præfecti: sed et necessaria mensæ regis Salomonis cum ingenti cura præbebant in tempore suo.
text_pt: Proviam, pois, estes provedores, cada um no seu mês, ao rei Salomão e a todos quantos se chegaram à mesa do rei Salomão; coisa nenhuma deixavam faltar.

text_en: They brought barley also, and straw for the horses and beasts, to the place where the king was, according as it was appointed them.
text_la: Hordeum quoque, et paleas equorum et jumentorum, deferebant in locum ubi erat rex, juxta constitutum sibi.
text_pt: E traziam a cevada e a palha para os cavalos e para os ginetes, para o lugar onde estava, cada um segundo o seu cargo.

text_en: And God gave to Solomon wisdom, and understanding exceeding much, and largeness of heart, as the sand that is on the sea shore.
text_la: Dedit quoque Deus sapientiam Salomoni, et prudentiam multam nimis, et latitudinem cordis quasi arenam quæ est in littore maris.
text_pt: E deu Deus a Salomão sabedoria, e muitíssimo entendimento, e largueza de coração, como a areia que está na praia do mar.
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκεν κύριος φρόνησιν τῷ Σαλωμων καὶ σοφίαν πολλὴν σφόδρα καὶ χύμα καρδίας ὡς ἡ ἄμμος ἡ παρὰ τὴν θάλασσαν

text_en: And the wisdom of Solomon surpassed the wisdom of all the Orientals, and of the Egyptians ;
text_la: Et præcedebat sapientia Salomonis sapientiam omnium Orientalium et Ægyptiorum,
text_pt: E era a sabedoria de Salomão maior do que a sabedoria de todos os do oriente e do que toda a sabedoria dos egípcios.
text_el: καὶ ἐπληθύνθη Σαλωμων σφόδρα ὑπὲρ τὴν φρόνησιν πάντων ἀρχαίων ἀνθρώπων καὶ ὑπὲρ πάντας φρονίμους Αἰγύπτου

text_en: and he was wiser than all men : wiser than Ethan, the Ezrahite, and Heman, and Chalcol, and Dorda, the sons of Mahol, and he was renowned in all nations round about.
text_la: et erat sapientior cunctis hominibus : sapientior Ethan Ezrahita, et Heman, et Chalcol, et Dorda filiis Mahol : et erat nominatus in universis gentibus per circuitum.
text_pt: E era ele ainda mais sábio do que todos os homens, e do que Etã, ezraíta, e Hemã, e Calcol, e Darda, filhos de Maol; e correu o seu nome por todas as nações em redor.
text_el: καὶ ἐσοφίσατο ὑπὲρ πάντας τοὺς ἀνθρώπους καὶ ἐσοφίσατο ὑπὲρ Γαιθαν τὸν Εζραΐτην καὶ τὸν Αιμαν καὶ τὸν Χαλκαλ καὶ Δαρδα υἱοὺς Μαλ

text_en: Solomon also spoke three thousand parables : and his poems were a thousand and five.
text_la: Locutus est quoque Salomon tria millia parabolas : et fuerunt carmina ejus quinque et mille.
text_pt: E disse três mil provérbios, e foram os seus cânticos mil e cinco.
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν Σαλωμων τρισχιλίας παραβολάς καὶ ἦσαν ᾠδαὶ αὐτοῦ πεντακισχίλιαι

text_en: And he treated about trees, from the cedar that is in Libanus, unto the hyssop that comes out of the wall: and he discoursed of beasts, and of fowls, and of creeping things, and of fishes.
text_la: Et disputavit super lignis a cedro quæ est in Libano, usque ad hyssopum quæ egreditur de pariete : et disseruit de jumentis, et volucribus, et reptilibus, et piscibus.
text_pt: Também falou das árvores, desde o cedro que está no Líbano até ao hissopo que nasce na parede; também falou dos animais e das aves, e dos répteis e dos peixes.
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν περὶ τῶν ξύλων ἀπὸ τῆς κέδρου τῆς ἐν τῷ Λιβάνῳ καὶ ἕως τῆς ὑσσώπου τῆς ἐκπορευομένης διὰ τοῦ τοίχου καὶ ἐλάλησεν περὶ τῶν κτηνῶν καὶ περὶ τῶν πετεινῶν καὶ περὶ τῶν ἑρπετῶν καὶ περὶ τῶν ἰχθύων

text_en: And they came from all nations to hear the wisdom of Solomon , and from all the kings of the earth, who heard of his wisdom.
text_la: Et veniebant de cunctis populis ad audiendam sapientiam Salomonis, et ab universis regibus terræ qui audiebant sapientiam ejus.
text_pt: E vinham de todos os povos a ouvir a sabedoria de Salomão, e de todos os reis da terra que tinham ouvido da sua sabedoria.
text_el: καὶ παρεγίνοντο πάντες οἱ λαοὶ ἀκοῦσαι τῆς σοφίας Σαλωμων καὶ ἐλάμβανεν δῶρα παρὰ πάντων τῶν βασιλέων τῆς γῆς ὅσοι ἤκουον τῆς σοφίας αὐτοῦ

text_en: And Hiram, king of Tyre , sent his servants to Solomon : for he heard that they had anointed him king in the room of his father: for Hiram had always been David's friend.
text_la: Misit quoque Hiram rex Tyri servos suos ad Salomonem : audivit enim quod ipsum unxissent regem pro patre ejus : quia amicus fuerat Hiram David omni tempore.
text_pt: E enviou Hirão, rei de Tiro, os seus servos a Salomão (porque ouvira que ungiram a Salomão rei em lugar de seu pai), porquanto Hirão sempre tinha amado a Davi.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν Χιραμ βασιλεὺς Τύρου τοὺς παῖδας αὐτοῦ χρῖσαι τὸν Σαλωμων ἀντὶ Δαυιδ τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ ὅτι ἀγαπῶν ἦν Χιραμ τὸν Δαυιδ πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας

text_en: Solomon sent to Hiram, saying:
text_la: Misit autem Salomon ad Hiram, dicens:
text_pt: Então Salomão mandou dizer a Hirão:
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν Σαλωμων πρὸς Χιραμ λέγων

text_en: You know the will of David , my father, and that he could not build a house to the name of the Lord his God , because of the wars that were round about him, until the Lord put them under the soles of his feet.
text_la: Tu scis voluntatem David patris mei, et quia non potuerit ædificare domum nomini Domini Dei sui propter bella imminentia per circuitum, donec daret Dominus eos sub vestigio pedum ejus.
text_pt: Bem sabes tu que Davi, meu pai, não pôde edificar uma casa ao nome do Senhor seu Deus, por causa da guerra com que o cercaram, até que o Senhor pôs seus inimigos debaixo das plantas dos seus pés.
text_el: σὺ οἶδας Δαυιδ τὸν πατέρα μου ὅτι οὐκ ἐδύνατο οἰκοδομῆσαι οἶκον τῷ ὀνόματι κυρίου θεοῦ μου ἀπὸ προσώπου τῶν πολέμων τῶν κυκλωσάντων αὐτὸν ἕως τοῦ δοῦναι κύριον αὐτοὺς ὑπὸ τὰ ἴχνη τῶν ποδῶν αὐτοῦ

text_en: But now the Lord my God has given me rest round about; and there is no adversary nor evil occurrence.
text_la: Nunc autem requiem dedit Dominus Deus meus mihi per circuitum, et non est satan, neque occursus malus.
text_pt: Porém agora o Senhor meu Deus me tem dado descanso de todos os lados; adversário não há, nem algum mau encontro.
text_el: καὶ νῦν ἀνέπαυσε κύριος ὁ θεός μου ἐμοὶ κυκλόθεν οὐκ ἔστιν ἐπίβουλος καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ἀπάντημα πονηρόν

text_en: Wherefore I purpose to build a temple to the name of the Lord my God , as the Lord spoke to David my father, saying: Your son, whom I will set upon the throne, in your place, he shall build a house to my name .
text_la: Quam ob rem cogito ædificare templum nomini Domini Dei mei, sicut locutus est Dominus David patri meo, dicens : Filius tuus, quem dabo pro te super solium tuum, ipse ædificabit domum nomini meo.
text_pt: E eis que eu intento edificar uma casa ao nome do Senhor meu Deus, como falou o Senhor a Davi, meu pai, dizendo: Teu filho, que porei em teu lugar no teu trono, ele edificará uma casa ao meu nome.
text_el: καὶ ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ λέγω οἰκοδομῆσαι οἶκον τῷ ὀνόματι κυρίου θεοῦ μου καθὼς ἐλάλησεν κύριος ὁ θεὸς πρὸς Δαυιδ τὸν πατέρα μου λέγων ὁ υἱός σου ὃν δώσω ἀντὶ σοῦ ἐπὶ τὸν θρόνον σου οὗτος οἰκοδομήσει τὸν οἶκον τῷ ὀνόματί μου

text_en: Give orders, therefore, that your servants cut me down cedar trees , out of Libanus, and let my servants be with your servants: and I will give you the hire of your servants whatsoever you will ask: for you know how there is not among my people a man that has skill to hew wood like to the Sidonians .
text_la: Præcipe igitur ut præcidant mihi servi tui cedros de Libano, et servi mei sint cum servis tuis : mercedem autem servorum tuorum dabo tibi quamcumque petieris : scis enim quomodo non est in populo meo vir qui noverit ligna cædere sicut Sidonii.
text_pt: Dá ordem, pois, agora, que do Líbano me cortem cedros, e os meus servos estarão com os teus servos, e eu te darei o salário dos teus servos, conforme a tudo o que disseres; porque bem sabes tu que entre nós ninguém há que saiba cortar a madeira como os sidônios.
text_el: καὶ νῦν ἔντειλαι καὶ κοψάτωσάν μοι ξύλα ἐκ τοῦ Λιβάνου καὶ ἰδοὺ οἱ δοῦλοί μου μετὰ τῶν δούλων σου καὶ τὸν μισθὸν δουλείας σου δώσω σοι κατὰ πάντα ὅσα ἐὰν εἴπῃς ὅτι σὺ οἶδας ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν ἡμῖν εἰδὼς ξύλα κόπτειν καθὼς οἱ Σιδώνιοι

text_en: Now when Hiram had heard the words of Solomon , he rejoiced exceedingly, and said: Blessed be the Lord God this day, who has given to David a very wise son over this numerous people.
text_la: Cum ergo audisset Hiram verba Salomonis, lætatus est valde, et ait : Benedictus Dominus Deus hodie, qui dedit David filium sapientissimum super populum hunc plurimum.
text_pt: E aconteceu que, ouvindo Hirão as palavras de Salomão, muito se alegrou, e disse: Bendito seja hoje o Senhor, que deu a Davi um filho sábio sobre este tão grande povo.
text_el: καὶ ἐγενήθη καθὼς ἤκουσεν Χιραμ τῶν λόγων Σαλωμων ἐχάρη σφόδρα καὶ εἶπεν εὐλογητὸς ὁ θεὸς σήμερον ὃς ἔδωκεν τῷ Δαυιδ υἱὸν φρόνιμον ἐπὶ τὸν λαὸν τὸν πολὺν τοῦτον

text_en: And Hiram sent to Solomon , saying: I have heard all you have desired of me; and I will do all your desire concerning cedar trees , and fir trees.
text_la: Et misit Hiram ad Salomonem, dicens : Audivi quæcumque mandasti mihi : ego faciam omnem voluntatem tuam in lignis cedrinis et abiegnis.
text_pt: E enviou Hirão a Salomão, dizendo: Ouvi o que me mandaste dizer. Eu farei toda a tua vontade acerca das madeiras de cedro e de cipreste.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν πρὸς Σαλωμων λέγων ἀκήκοα περὶ πάντων ὧν ἀπέσταλκας πρός με ἐγὼ ποιήσω πᾶν θέλημά σου ξύλα κέδρινα καὶ πεύκινα

text_en: My servants shall bring them down from Libanus to the sea: and I will put them together in floats, on the sea, and convey them to the place, which you shall signify to me, and will land them there, and you shall receive them: and you shall allow me necessaries to furnish food for my household.
text_la: Servi mei deponent ea de Libano ad mare, et ego componam ea in ratibus in mari usque ad locum quem significaveris mihi : et applicabo ea ibi, et tu tolles ea : præbebisque necessaria mihi, ut detur cibus domui meæ.
text_pt: Os meus servos as levarão desde o Líbano até ao mar, e eu as farei conduzir em jangadas pelo mar até ao lugar que me designares, e ali as desamarrarei; e tu as tomarás; tu também farás a minha vontade, dando sustento à minha casa.
text_el: οἱ δοῦλοί μου κατάξουσιν αὐτὰ ἐκ τοῦ Λιβάνου εἰς τὴν θάλασσαν ἐγὼ θήσομαι αὐτὰ σχεδίας ἕως τοῦ τόπου οὗ ἐὰν ἀποστείλῃς πρός με καὶ ἐκτινάξω αὐτὰ ἐκεῖ καὶ σὺ ἀρεῖς καὶ ποιήσεις τὸ θέλημά μου τοῦ δοῦναι ἄρτους τῷ οἴκῳ μου

text_en: So Hiram gave Solomon cedar trees , and fir trees, according to all his desire.
text_la: Itaque Hiram dabat Salomoni ligna cedrina, et ligna abiegna, juxta omnem voluntatem ejus.
text_pt: Assim deu Hirão a Salomão madeira de cedro e madeira de cipreste, conforme a toda a sua vontade.
text_el: καὶ ἦν Χιραμ διδοὺς τῷ Σαλωμων κέδρους καὶ πᾶν θέλημα αὐτοῦ

text_en: And Solomon allowed Hiram twenty thousand measures of wheat, for provision for his house, and twenty measures of the purest oil: thus gave Solomon to Hiram every year.
text_la: Salomon autem præbebat Hiram coros tritici viginti millia in cibum domui ejus, et viginti coros purissimi olei : hæc tribuebat Salomon Hiram per singulos annos.
text_pt: E Salomão deu a Hirão vinte mil coros de trigo, para sustento da sua casa, e vinte coros de azeite batido; isto dava Salomão a Hirão anualmente.
text_el: καὶ Σαλωμων ἔδωκεν τῷ Χιραμ εἴκοσι χιλιάδας κόρους πυροῦ καὶ μαχιρ τῷ οἴκῳ αὐτοῦ καὶ εἴκοσι χιλιάδας βεθ ἐλαίου κεκομμένου κατὰ τοῦτο ἐδίδου Σαλωμων τῷ Χιραμ κατ' ἐνιαυτόν

text_en: And the Lord gave wisdom to Solomon , as he promised him: and there was peace between Hiram and Solomon , and they two made a league together.
text_la: Dedit quoque Dominus sapientiam Salomoni, sicut locutus est ei : et erat pax inter Hiram et Salomonem, et percusserunt ambo fœdus.
text_pt: Deu, pois, o Senhor a Salomão sabedoria, como lhe tinha falado; e houve paz entre Hirão e Salomão, e ambos fizeram acordo.
text_el: καὶ κύριος ἔδωκεν σοφίαν τῷ Σαλωμων καθὼς ἐλάλησεν αὐτῷ καὶ ἦν εἰρήνη ἀνὰ μέσον Χιραμ καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον Σαλωμων καὶ διέθεντο διαθήκην ἀνὰ μέσον ἑαυτῶν

text_en: And King Solomon chose workmen out of all Israel , and the levy was of thirty thousand men .
text_la: Elegitque rex Salomon operarios de omni Israël, et erat indictio triginta millia virorum.
text_pt: E o rei Salomão fez subir uma leva de gente dentre todo o Israel, e foi a leva de gente trinta mil homens;
text_el: καὶ ἀνήνεγκεν ὁ βασιλεὺς φόρον ἐκ παντὸς Ισραηλ καὶ ἦν ὁ φόρος τριάκοντα χιλιάδες ἀνδρῶν

text_en: And he sent them to Libanus, ten thousand every month, by turns, so that two months they were at home: and Adoniram was over this levy.
text_la: Mittebatque eos in Libanum, decem millia per menses singulos vicissim, ita ut duobus mensibus essent in domibus suis : et Adoniram erat super hujuscemodi indictione.
text_pt: E os enviava ao Líbano, cada mês, dez mil por turno; um mês estavam no Líbano, e dois meses cada um em sua casa; e Adonirão estava sobre a leva de gente.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν αὐτοὺς εἰς τὸν Λίβανον δέκα χιλιάδες ἐν τῷ μηνί ἀλλασσόμενοι μῆνα ἦσαν ἐν τῷ Λιβάνῳ καὶ δύο μῆνας ἐν οἴκῳ αὐτῶν καὶ Αδωνιραμ ἐπὶ τοῦ φόρου

text_en: And Solomon had seventy thousand to carry burdens, and eighty thousand to hew stones in the mountain:
text_la: Fueruntque Salomoni septuaginta millia eorum qui onera portabant, et octoginta millia latomorum in monte,
text_pt: Tinha também Salomão setenta mil que levavam as cargas, e oitenta mil que talhavam pedras nas montanhas,
text_el: καὶ ἦν τῷ Σαλωμων ἑβδομήκοντα χιλιάδες αἴροντες ἄρσιν καὶ ὀγδοήκοντα χιλιάδες λατόμων ἐν τῷ ὄρει

text_en: Besides the overseers who were over every work, in number three thousand and three hundred, that ruled over the people, and them that did the work.
text_la: absque præpositis qui præerant singulis operibus, numero trium millium et trecentorum, præcipientium populo et his qui faciebant opus.
text_pt: Afora os chefes dos oficiais de Salomão, que estavam sobre aquela obra, três mil e trezentos, os quais davam as ordens ao povo que fazia aquela obra.
text_el: χωρὶς ἀρχόντων τῶν καθεσταμένων ἐπὶ τῶν ἔργων τῶν Σαλωμων τρεῖς χιλιάδες καὶ ἑξακόσιοι ἐπιστάται οἱ ποιοῦντες τὰ ἔργα

text_en: And the king commanded that they should bring great stones, costly stones, for the foundation of the temple , and should square them:
text_la: Præcepitque rex ut tollerent lapides grandes, lapides pretiosos in fundamentum templi, et quadrarent eos:
text_pt: E mandou o rei que trouxessem pedras grandes, e pedras valiosas, pedras lavradas, para fundarem a casa.
text_el: καὶ ἡτοίμασαν τοὺς λίθους καὶ τὰ ξύλα τρία ἔτη

text_en: And the masons of Solomon , and the masons of Hiram, hewed them: and the Giblians prepared timber and stones to build the house.
text_la: quos dolaverunt cæmentarii Salomonis et cæmentarii Hiram: porro Giblii præparaverunt ligna et lapides ad ædificandam domum.
text_pt: E as lavraram os edificadores de Hirão, e os giblitas; e preparavam a madeira e as pedras para edificar a casa.

text_en: And it came to pass in the four hundred and eightieth year after the children of Israel came out of the land of Egypt , in the fourth year of the reign of Solomon over Israel , in the month Zio, (the same is the second month) he began to build a house to the Lord .
text_la: Factum est ergo quadringentesimo et octogesimo anno egressionis filiorum Israël de terra Ægypti, in anno quarto, mense Zio (ipse est mensis secundus), regni Salomonis super Israël, ædificari cœpit domus Domino.
text_pt: E sucedeu que no ano de quatrocentos e oitenta, depois de saírem os filhos de Israel do Egito, no ano quarto do reinado de Salomão sobre Israel, no mês de Zive (este é o mês segundo), começou a edificar a casa do SENHOR.
text_el: καὶ ἐγενήθη ἐν τῷ τεσσαρακοστῷ καὶ τετρακοσιοστῷ ἔτει τῆς ἐξόδου υἱῶν Ισραηλ ἐξ Αἰγύπτου τῷ ἔτει τῷ τετάρτῳ ἐν μηνὶ τῷ δευτέρῳ βασιλεύοντος τοῦ βασιλέως Σαλωμων ἐπὶ Ισραηλ

text_en: And the house, which King Solomon built to the Lord , was threescore cubits in length, and twenty cubits in breadth, and thirty cubits in height.
text_la: Domus autem quam ædificabat rex Salomon Domino, habebat sexaginta cubitos in longitudine, et viginti cubitos in latitudine, et triginta cubitos in altitudine.
text_pt: E a casa que o rei Salomão edificou ao Senhor era de sessenta côvados de comprimento, e de vinte côvados de largura, e de trinta côvados de altura.
text_el: καὶ ὁ οἶκος ὃν ᾠκοδόμησεν ὁ βασιλεὺς Σαλωμων τῷ κυρίῳ τεσσαράκοντα πήχεων μῆκος αὐτοῦ καὶ εἴκοσι ἐν πήχει πλάτος αὐτοῦ καὶ πέντε καὶ εἴκοσι ἐν πήχει τὸ ὕψος αὐτοῦ

text_en: And there was a porch before the temple , of twenty cubits in length, according to the measure of the breadth of the temple : and it was ten cubits in breadth, before the face of the temple .
text_la: Et porticus erat ante templum viginti cubitorum longitudinis, juxta mensuram latitudinis templi : et habebat decem cubitos latitudinis ante faciem templi.
text_pt: E o pórtico diante do templo da casa era de vinte côvados de comprimento, segundo a largura da casa, e de dez côvados de largura diante da casa.
text_el: καὶ τὸ αιλαμ κατὰ πρόσωπον τοῦ ναοῦ εἴκοσι ἐν πήχει μῆκος αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸ πλάτος τοῦ οἴκου καὶ δέκα ἐν πήχει τὸ πλάτος αὐτοῦ κατὰ πρόσωπον τοῦ οἴκου καὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν τὸν οἶκον καὶ συνετέλεσεν αὐτόν

text_en: And he made in the temple oblique windows.
text_la: Fecitque in templo fenestras obliquas.
text_pt: E fez para a casa janelas de gelósias fixas.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν τῷ οἴκῳ θυρίδας παρακυπτομένας κρυπτάς

text_en: And upon the wall of the temple , he built floors round about, in the walls of the house, round about the temple and the oracle, and he made chambers in the sides round about.
text_la: Et ædificavit super parietem templi tabulata per gyrum, in parietibus domus per circuitum templi et oraculi, et fecit latera in circuitu.
text_pt: E edificou câmaras junto ao muro da casa, contra as paredes da casa, em redor, tanto do templo como do oráculo; e assim lhe fez câmaras laterais em redor.
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκεν ἐπὶ τὸν τοῖχον τοῦ οἴκου μέλαθρα κυκλόθεν τῷ ναῷ καὶ τῷ δαβιρ καὶ ἐποίησεν πλευρὰς κυκλόθεν

text_en: The floor that was underneath was five cubits in breadth, and the middle floor was six cubits in breadth, and the third floor was seven cubits in breadth. And he put beams in the house round about on the outside, that they might not be fastened in the walls of the temple .
text_la: Tabulatum quod subter erat, quinque cubitos habebat latitudinis, et medium tabulatum sex cubitorum latitudinis, et tertium tabulatum septem habens cubitos latitudinis. Trabes autem posuit in domo per circuitum forinsecus, ut non hærerent muris templi.
text_pt: A câmara de baixo era de cinco côvados de largura, e a do meio de seis côvados de largura, e a terceira de sete côvados de largura; porque pela parte de fora da casa, em redor, fizera encostos, para que as vigas não se apoiassem nas paredes da casa.
text_el: ἡ πλευρὰ ἡ ὑποκάτω πέντε πήχεων τὸ πλάτος αὐτῆς καὶ τὸ μέσον ἕξ καὶ ἡ τρίτη ἑπτὰ ἐν πήχει τὸ πλάτος αὐτῆς ὅτι διάστημα ἔδωκεν τῷ οἴκῳ κυκλόθεν ἔξωθεν τοῦ οἴκου ὅπως μὴ ἐπιλαμβάνωνται τῶν τοίχων τοῦ οἴκου

text_en: And the house, when it was in building, was built of stones, hewed and made ready: so that there was neither hammer nor axe, nor any tool of iron heard in the house when it was in building.
text_la: Domus autem cum ædificaretur, de lapidibus dolatis atque perfectis ædificata est : et malleus, et securis, et omne ferramentum non sunt audita in domo cum ædificaretur.
text_pt: E edificava-se a casa com pedras preparadas, como as traziam se edificava; de maneira que nem martelo, nem machado, nem nenhum outro instrumento de ferro se ouviu na casa quando a edificavam.
text_el: καὶ ὁ οἶκος ἐν τῷ οἰκοδομεῖσθαι αὐτὸν λίθοις ἀκροτόμοις ἀργοῖς ᾠκοδομήθη καὶ σφῦρα καὶ πέλεκυς καὶ πᾶν σκεῦος σιδηροῦν οὐκ ἠκούσθη ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ ἐν τῷ οἰκοδομεῖσθαι αὐτόν

text_en: The door, for the middle side, was on the right hand of the house: and by winding stairs they went up to the middle room, and from the middle to the third.
text_la: Ostium lateris medii in parte erat domus dextræ : et per cochleam ascendebant in medium cœnaculum, et a medio in tertium.
text_pt: A porta da câmara do meio estava ao lado direito da casa, e por caracóis se subia à do meio, e da do meio à terceira.
text_el: καὶ ὁ πυλὼν τῆς πλευρᾶς τῆς ὑποκάτωθεν ὑπὸ τὴν ὠμίαν τοῦ οἴκου τὴν δεξιάν καὶ ἑλικτὴ ἀνάβασις εἰς τὸ μέσον καὶ ἐκ τῆς μέσης ἐπὶ τὰ τριώροφα

text_en: So he built the house, and finished it: and he covered the house with roofs of cedar .
text_la: Et ædificavit domum, et consummavit eam : texit quoque domum laquearibus cedrinis.
text_pt: Assim, pois, edificou a casa, e a acabou; e cobriu a casa com pranchões e tabuados de cedro.
text_el: καὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν τὸν οἶκον καὶ συνετέλεσεν αὐτόν καὶ ἐκοιλοστάθμησεν τὸν οἶκον κέδροις

text_en: And he built a floor over all the house, five cubits in height, and he covered the house with timber of cedar .
text_la: Et ædificavit tabulatum super omnem domum quinque cubitis altitudinis, et operuit domum lignis cedrinis.
text_pt: Também edificou as câmaras em volta de toda a casa, de cinco côvados de altura, e as ligou à casa com madeira de cedro.
text_el: καὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν τοὺς ἐνδέσμους δι' ὅλου τοῦ οἴκου πέντε ἐν πήχει τὸ ὕψος αὐτοῦ καὶ συνέσχεν τὸν ἔνδεσμον ἐν ξύλοις κεδρίνοις

text_en: And the word of the Lord came to Solomon ,
text_la: Et factus est sermo Domini ad Salomonem, dicens:
text_pt: Então veio a palavra do Senhor a Salomão, dizendo:

text_en: as for this house, which you are building, if you will walk in my statutes, and execute my judgments, and keep all my commandments, walking in them, I will fulfil my word to you, which I spoke to David your father.
text_la: Domus hæc, quam ædificas, si ambulaveris in præceptis meis, et judicia mea feceris, et custodieris omnia mandata mea, gradiens per ea, firmabo sermonem meum tibi, quem locutus sum ad David patrem tuum:
text_pt: Quanto a esta casa que tu edificas, se andares nos meus estatutos, e fizeres os meus juízos, e guardares todos os meus mandamentos, andando neles, confirmarei para contigo a minha palavra, a qual falei a Davi, teu pai;

text_en: And I will dwell in the midst of the children of Israel , and I will not forsake my people Israel .
text_la: et habitabo in medio filiorum Israël, et non derelinquam populum meum Israël.
text_pt: E habitarei no meio dos filhos de Israel, e não desampararei o meu povo de Israel.

text_en: So Solomon built the house, and finished it.
text_la: Igitur ædificavit Salomon domum, et consummavit eam.
text_pt: Assim edificou Salomão aquela casa, e a acabou.

text_en: And he built the walls of the house on the inside, with boards of cedar , from the floor of the house to the top of the walls, and to the roofs, he covered it with boards of cedar on the inside: and he covered the floor of the house with planks of fir.
text_la: Et ædificavit parietes domus intrinsecus tabulatis cedrinis : a pavimento domus usque ad summitatem parietum, et usque ad laquearia, operuit lignis cedrinis intrinsecus : et texit pavimentum domus tabulis abiegnis.
text_pt: Também cobriu as paredes da casa por dentro com tábuas de cedro; desde o soalho da casa até ao teto tudo cobriu com madeira por dentro; e cobriu o soalho da casa com tábuas de cipreste.
text_el: καὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν τοὺς τοίχους τοῦ οἴκου διὰ ξύλων κεδρίνων ἀπὸ τοῦ ἐδάφους τοῦ οἴκου καὶ ἕως τῶν δοκῶν καὶ ἕως τῶν τοίχων ἐκοιλοστάθμησεν συνεχόμενα ξύλοις ἔσωθεν καὶ περιέσχεν τὸ ἔσω τοῦ οἴκου ἐν πλευραῖς πευκίναις

text_en: And he built up twenty cubits with boards of cedar at the hinder part of the temple , from the floor to the top: and made the inner house of the oracle to be the holy of holies.
text_la: Ædificavitque viginti cubitorum ad posteriorem partem templi tabulata cedrina, a pavimento usque ad superiora : et fecit interiorem domum oraculi in Sanctum sanctorum.
text_pt: Edificou mais vinte côvados de tábuas de cedro nos lados da casa, desde o soalho até às paredes; e por dentro lhas edificou para o oráculo, para o Santo dos Santos.
text_el: καὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν τοὺς εἴκοσι πήχεις ἀπ' ἄκρου τοῦ οἴκου τὸ πλευρὸν τὸ ἓν ἀπὸ τοῦ ἐδάφους ἕως τῶν δοκῶν καὶ ἐποίησεν ἐκ τοῦ δαβιρ εἰς τὸ ἅγιον τῶν ἁγίων

text_en: And the temple itself, before the doors of the oracle, was forty cubits long.
text_la: Porro quadraginta cubitorum erat ipsum templum pro foribus oraculi.
text_pt: A casa, isto é, o templo anterior tinha quarenta côvados.
text_el: καὶ τεσσαράκοντα πηχῶν ἦν ὁ ναὸς κατὰ πρόσωπον

text_en: And all the house was covered within with cedar , having the turnings, and the joints thereof artfully wrought, and carvings projecting out: all was covered with boards of cedar : and no stone could be seen in the wall at all.
text_la: Et cedro omnis domus intrinsecus vestiebatur, habens tornaturas et juncturas suas fabrefactas, et cælaturas eminentes : omnia cedrinis tabulis vestiebantur : nec omnino lapis apparere poterat in pariete.
text_pt: E o cedro da casa por dentro era lavrado de botões e flores abertas; tudo era cedro, pedra nenhuma se via.

text_en: And he made the oracle in the midst of the house, in the inner part, to set there the ark of the covenant of the Lord .
text_la: Oraculum autem in medio domus, in interiori parte fecerat, ut poneret ibi arcam fœderis Domini.
text_pt: E por dentro da casa, na parte mais interior, preparou o oráculo, para pôr ali a arca da aliança do Senhor.
text_el: τοῦ δαβιρ ἐν μέσῳ τοῦ οἴκου ἔσωθεν δοῦναι ἐκεῖ τὴν κιβωτὸν διαθήκης κυρίου

text_en: Now the oracle was twenty cubits in length, and twenty cubits in breadth, and twenty cubits in height. And he covered it, and overlaid it with most pure gold. And the altar also he covered with cedar .
text_la: Porro oraculum habebat viginti cubitos longitudinis, et viginti cubitos latitudinis, et viginti cubitos altitudinis : et operuit illud atque vestivit auro purissimo : sed et altare vestivit cedro.
text_pt: E o oráculo no interior era de vinte côvados de comprimento, e de vinte côvados de largura, e de vinte côvados de altura; e o revestiu de ouro puro; também revestiu de cedro o altar.
text_el: εἴκοσι πήχεις μῆκος καὶ εἴκοσι πήχεις πλάτος καὶ εἴκοσι πήχεις τὸ ὕψος αὐτοῦ καὶ περιέσχεν αὐτὸν χρυσίῳ συγκεκλεισμένῳ καὶ ἐποίησεν θυσιαστήριον

text_en: And the house before the oracle he overlaid with most pure gold, and fastened on the plates with nails of gold.
text_la: Domum quoque ante oraculum operuit auro purissimo, et affixit laminas clavis aureis.
text_pt: E revestiu Salomão a casa por dentro de ouro puro; e com cadeias de ouro pôs uma cortina diante do oráculo, e o revestiu com ouro.
text_el: κατὰ πρόσωπον τοῦ δαβιρ καὶ περιέσχεν αὐτὸ χρυσίῳ

text_en: And there was nothing in the temple that was not covered with gold: the whole altar of the oracle he covered also with gold.
text_la: Nihilque erat in templo quod non auro tegeretur : sed et totum altare oraculi texit auro.
text_pt: Assim cobriu de ouro toda a casa, inteiramente; também cobriu de ouro todo o altar que estava diante do oráculo.
text_el: καὶ ὅλον τὸν οἶκον περιέσχεν χρυσίῳ ἕως συντελείας παντὸς τοῦ οἴκου

text_en: And he made in the oracle two cherubims of olive tree, of ten cubits in height.
text_la: Et fecit in oraculo duos cherubim de lignis olivarum, decem cubitorum altitudinis.
text_pt: E no oráculo fez dois querubins de madeira de oliveira, cada um da altura de dez côvados.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν ἐν τῷ δαβιρ δύο χερουβιν δέκα πήχεων μέγεθος ἐσταθμωμένον

text_en: One wing of the cherub was five cubits, and the other wing of the cherub was five cubits: that is, in all ten cubits, from the extremity of one wing to the extremity of the other wing.
text_la: Quinque cubitorum ala cherub una, et quinque cubitorum ala cherub altera : id est, decem cubitos habentes, a summitate alæ unius usque ad alæ alterius summitatem.
text_pt: E uma asa de um querubim era de cinco côvados, e a outra asa do querubim de outros cinco côvados; dez côvados havia desde a extremidade de uma das suas asas até à extremidade da outra das suas asas.
text_el: καὶ πέντε πήχεων πτερύγιον τοῦ χερουβ τοῦ ἑνός καὶ πέντε πήχεων πτερύγιον αὐτοῦ τὸ δεύτερον ἐν πήχει δέκα ἀπὸ μέρους πτερυγίου αὐτοῦ εἰς μέρος πτερυγίου αὐτοῦ

text_en: The second cherub also was ten cubits: and the measure, and the work was the same in both the cherubims :
text_la: Decem quoque cubitorum erat cherub secundus : in mensura pari, et opus unum erat in duobus cherubim,
text_pt: Assim era também de dez côvados o outro querubim; ambos os querubins eram de uma mesma medida e de um mesmo talhe.
text_el: οὕτως τῷ χερουβ τῷ δευτέρῳ ἐν μέτρῳ ἑνὶ συντέλεια μία ἀμφοτέροις

text_en: That is to say, one cherub was ten cubits high, and in like manner the other cherub .
text_la: id est, altitudinem habebat unus cherub decem cubitorum, et similiter cherub secundus.
text_pt: A altura de um querubim era de dez côvados, e assim a do outro querubim.
text_el: καὶ τὸ ὕψος τοῦ χερουβ τοῦ ἑνὸς δέκα ἐν πήχει καὶ οὕτως τὸ χερουβ τὸ δεύτερον

text_en: And he set the cherubims in the midst of the inner temple : and the cherubims stretched forth their wings, and the wing of the one touched one wall, and the wing of the other cherub touched the other wall: and the other wings in the midst of the temple touched one another.
text_la: Posuitque cherubim in medio templi interioris : extendebant autem alas suas cherubim, et tangebat ala una parietem, et ala cherub secundi tangebat parietem alterum : alæ autem alteræ in media parte templi se invicem contingebant.
text_pt: E pôs a estes querubins no meio da casa de dentro; e os querubins estendiam as asas, de maneira que a asa de um tocava na parede, e a asa do outro querubim tocava na outra parede; e as suas asas no meio da casa tocavam uma na outra.
text_el: καὶ ἀμφότερα τὰ χερουβιν ἐν μέσῳ τοῦ οἴκου τοῦ ἐσωτάτου καὶ διεπέτασεν τὰς πτέρυγας αὐτῶν καὶ ἥπτετο πτέρυξ μία τοῦ τοίχου καὶ πτέρυξ ἥπτετο τοῦ τοίχου τοῦ δευτέρου καὶ αἱ πτέρυγες αὐτῶν αἱ ἐν μέσῳ τοῦ οἴκου ἥπτοντο πτέρυξ πτέρυγος

text_en: And he overlaid the cherubims with gold.
text_la: Texit quoque cherubim auro.
text_pt: E revestiu de ouro os querubins.
text_el: καὶ περιέσχεν τὰ χερουβιν χρυσίῳ

text_en: And all the walls of the temple round about he carved with divers figures and carvings: and he made in them cherubims and palm trees, and divers representations, as it were standing out, and coming forth from the wall.
text_la: Et omnes parietes templi per circuitum sculpsit variis cælaturis et torno : et fecit in eis cherubim, et palmas, et picturas varias, quasi prominentes de pariete, et egredientes.
text_pt: E todas as paredes da casa, em redor, lavrou de esculturas e entalhes de querubins, e de palmas, e de flores abertas, por dentro e por fora.
text_el: καὶ πάντας τοὺς τοίχους τοῦ οἴκου κύκλῳ ἐγκολαπτὰ ἔγραψεν γραφίδι χερουβιν καὶ φοίνικες τῷ ἐσωτέρῳ καὶ τῷ ἐξωτέρῳ

text_en: And the floor of the house he also overlaid with gold within and without.
text_la: Sed et pavimentum domus texit auro intrinsecus et extrinsecus.
text_pt: Também revestiu de ouro o soalho da casa, por dentro e por fora.
text_el: καὶ τὸ ἔδαφος τοῦ οἴκου περιέσχεν χρυσίῳ τοῦ ἐσωτάτου καὶ τοῦ ἐξωτάτου

text_en: And in the entrance of the oracle, he made little doors of olive tree, and posts of five corners,
text_la: Et in ingressu oraculi fecit ostiola de lignis olivarum, postesque angulorum quinque.
text_pt: E à entrada do oráculo fez portas de madeira de oliveira; o umbral de cima com as ombreiras faziam a quinta parte da parede.
text_el: καὶ τῷ θυρώματι τοῦ δαβιρ ἐποίησεν θύρας ξύλων ἀρκευθίνων καὶ φλιὰς πενταπλᾶς

text_en: and two doors of olive tree: and he carved upon them figures of cherubims , and figures of palm trees, and carvings very much projecting; and he overlaid them with gold: and he covered both the cherubims and the palm trees, and the other things, with gold.
text_la: Et duo ostia de lignis olivarum : et sculpsit in eis picturam cherubim, et palmarum species, et anaglypha valde prominentia : et texit ea auro, et operuit tam cherubim quam palmas, et cetera, auro.
text_pt: Também as duas portas eram de madeira de oliveira; e lavrou nelas entalhes de querubins, e de palmas, e de flores abertas, os quais revestiu de ouro; também estendeu ouro sobre os querubins e sobre as palmas.
text_el: καὶ δύο θύρας ξύλων πευκίνων καὶ ἐγκολαπτὰ ἐπ' αὐτῶν ἐγκεκολαμμένα χερουβιν καὶ φοίνικας καὶ πέταλα διαπεπετασμένα καὶ περιέσχεν χρυσίῳ καὶ κατέβαινεν ἐπὶ τὰ χερουβιν καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς φοίνικας τὸ χρυσίον

text_en: And he made in the entrance of the temple posts of olive tree foursquare:
text_la: Fecitque in introitu templi postes de lignis olivarum quadrangulatos,
text_pt: E assim fez à porta do templo ombreiras de madeira de oliveira, da quarta parte da parede.
text_el: καὶ οὕτως ἐποίησεν τῷ πυλῶνι τοῦ ναοῦ φλιαὶ ξύλων ἀρκευθίνων στοαὶ τετραπλῶς

text_en: And two doors of fir tree, one of each side: and each door was double, and so opened with folding leaves.
text_la: et duo ostia de lignis abiegnis altrinsecus : et utrumque ostium duplex erat, et se invicem tenens aperiebatur.
text_pt: E eram as duas portas de madeira de cipreste; e as duas folhas de uma porta eram dobradiças, assim como eram também dobradiças as duas folhas entalhadas das outras portas.
text_el: καὶ ἐν ἀμφοτέραις ταῖς θύραις ξύλα πεύκινα δύο πτυχαὶ ἡ θύρα ἡ μία καὶ στροφεῖς αὐτῶν καὶ δύο πτυχαὶ ἡ θύρα ἡ δευτέρα στρεφόμενα

text_en: And he carved cherubims , and palm trees, and carved work standing very much out: and he overlaid all with golden plates in square work by rule.
text_la: Et sculpsit cherubim, et palmas, et cælaturas valde eminentes : operuitque omnia laminis aureis opere quadro ad regulam.
text_pt: E as lavrou de querubins e de palmas, e de flores abertas, e as revestiu de ouro acomodado ao lavor.
text_el: ἐγκεκολαμμένα χερουβιν καὶ φοίνικες καὶ διαπεπετασμένα πέταλα καὶ περιεχόμενα χρυσίῳ καταγομένῳ ἐπὶ τὴν ἐκτύπωσιν

text_en: And he built the inner court with three rows of polished stones, and one row of beams of cedar .
text_la: Et ædificavit atrium interius tribus ordinibus lapidum politorum, et uno ordine lignorum cedri.
text_pt: Também edificou o pátio interior de três ordens de pedras lavradas e de uma ordem de vigas de cedro.
text_el: καὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν τὴν αὐλὴν τὴν ἐσωτάτην τρεῖς στίχους ἀπελεκήτων καὶ στίχος κατειργασμένης κέδρου κυκλόθεν

text_en: In the fourth year was the house of the Lord founded, in the month Zio:
text_la: Anno quarto fundata est domus Domini in mense Zio:
text_pt: No ano quarto se pôs o fundamento da casa do Senhor, no mês de Zive.

text_en: And in the eleventh year, in the month Bul. (which is the eighth month) the house was finished in all the works thereof, and in all the appurtenances thereof: and he was seven years in building it.
text_la: et in anno undecimo, mense Bul (ipse est mensis octavus), perfecta est domus in omni opere suo, et in universis utensilibus suis : ædificavitque eam annis septem.
text_pt: E no ano undécimo, no mês de Bul, que é o mês oitavo, se acabou esta casa com todas as suas coisas, e com tudo o que lhe convinha; e a edificou em sete anos.

text_en: And Solomon built his own house in thirteen years, and brought it to perfection.
text_la: Domum autem suam ædificavit Salomon tredecim annis, et ad perfectum usque perduxit.
text_pt: Porém a sua casa edificou Salomão em treze anos; e acabou toda a sua casa.

text_en: He built also the house of the forest of Libanus; the length of it was a hundred cubits, and the breadth fifty cubits, and the height thirty cubits: and four galleries between pillars of cedar : for he had cut cedar trees into pillars.
text_la: Ædificavit quoque domum saltus Libani centum cubitorum longitudinis, et quinquaginta cubitorum latitudinis, et triginta cubitorum altitudinis : et quatuor deambulacra inter columnas cedrinas : ligna quippe cedrina exciderat in columnas.
text_pt: Também edificou a casa do bosque do Líbano de cem côvados de comprimento, e de cinqüenta côvados de largura, e de trinta côvados de altura, sobre quatro ordens de colunas de cedro, e vigas de cedro sobre as colunas.

text_en: And he covered the whole vault with boards of cedar , and it was held up with five and forty pillars. And one row had fifteen pillars,
text_la: Et tabulatis cedrinis vestivit totam cameram, quæ quadraginta quinque columnis sustentabatur. Unus autem ordo habebat columnas quindecim
text_pt: E por cima estava coberta de cedro sobre as vigas, que estavam sobre quarenta e cinco colunas, quinze em cada ordem.

text_en: set one against another,
text_la: contra se invicem positas,
text_pt: E havia três ordens de janelas; e uma janela estava defronte da outra janela, em três ordens.

text_en: and looking one upon another, with equal space between the pillars, and over the pillars were square beams in all things equal.
text_la: et e regione se respicientes, æquali spatio inter columnas, et super columnas quadrangulata ligna in cunctis æqualia.
text_pt: Também todas as portas e ombreiras quadradas eram de uma mesma vista; e uma janela estava defronte da outra, em três ordens.

text_en: And he made a porch of pillars of fifty cubits in length, and thirty cubits in breadth: and another porch before the greater porch, and pillars, and chapiters upon the pillars.
text_la: Et porticum columnarum fecit quinquaginta cubitorum longitudinis, et triginta cubitorum latitudinis : et alteram porticum in facie majoris porticus : et columnas, et epistylia super columnas.
text_pt: Depois fez um pórtico de colunas de cinqüenta côvados de comprimento e de trinta côvados de largura; e o pórtico estava defronte delas, e as colunas com as grossas vigas defronte delas.

text_en: He made also the porch of the throne wherein is the seat of judgment; and covered it with cedar wood from the floor to the top.
text_la: Porticum quoque solii, in qua tribunal est, fecit : et texit lignis cedrinis a pavimento usque ad summitatem.
text_pt: Também fez o pórtico para o trono onde julgava, isto é, o pórtico do juízo, que estava revestido de cedro de soalho a soalho.

text_en: And in the midst of the porch, was a small house, where he sat in judgment of the like work. He made also a house for the daughter of Pharao (whom Solomon had taken to wife) of the same work, as this porch;
text_la: Et domuncula, in qua sedebatur ad judicandum, erat in media porticu simili opere. Domum quoque fecit filiæ Pharaonis (quam uxorem duxerat Salomon) tali opere, quali et hanc porticum.
text_pt: E em sua casa, em que morava, havia outro pátio, por dentro do pórtico, de obra semelhante à deste; também para a filha de Faraó, que Salomão tomara por mulher, fez uma casa semelhante àquele pórtico.

text_en: all of costly stones, which were sawed by a certain rule and measure, both within and without: from the foundation to the top of the walls, and without, unto the great court .
text_la: Omnia lapidibus pretiosis, qui ad normam quamdam atque mensuram tam intrinsecus quam extrinsecus serrati erant : a fundamento usque ad summitatem parietum, et extrinsecus usque ad atrium majus.
text_pt: Todas estas coisas eram de pedras de grande valor, cortadas à medida, serradas à serra por dentro e por fora; e isto desde o fundamento até às beiras do teto, e por fora até ao grande pátio.

text_en: And the foundations were of costly stones, great stones of ten cubits or eight cubits.
text_la: Fundamenta autem de lapidibus pretiosis, lapidibus magnis, decem sive octo cubitorum.
text_pt: Também estava fundado sobre pedras finas, pedras grandes; sobre pedras de dez côvados e pedras de oito côvados.

text_en: And above there were costly stones of equal measure hewed, and in like manner planks of cedar .
text_la: Et desuper lapides pretiosi æqualis mensuræ secti erant, similiterque de cedro.
text_pt: E em cima delas pedras de grande valor, lavradas segundo as medidas, e madeira de cedro.

text_en: And the great court was made round with three rows of hewed stones, and one row of planks of cedar , which also was observed in the inner court of the house of the Lord , and in the porch of the house.
text_la: Et atrium majus rotundum trium ordinum de lapidibus sectis, et unius ordinis de dolata cedro : necnon et in atrio domus Domini interiori, et in porticu domus.
text_pt: Havia três ordens de pedras lavradas, com uma ordem de vigas de cedro; assim era também o pátio interior da casa do Senhor e o pórtico daquela casa.

text_en: And King Solomon sent, and brought Hiram from Tyre ,
text_la: Misit quoque rex Salomon, et tulit Hiram de Tyro,
text_pt: E enviou o rei Salomão um mensageiro e mandou trazer a Hirão de Tiro.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν ὁ βασιλεὺς Σαλωμων καὶ ἔλαβεν τὸν Χιραμ ἐκ Τύρου

text_en: the son of a widow woman , of the tribe of Nephthali , whose father was a Tyrian, an artificer in brass, and full of wisdom, and understanding, and skill to work all work in brass. And when he had come to King Solomon , he wrought all his work.
text_la: filium mulieris viduæ de tribu Nephthali, patre Tyrio, artificem ærarium, et plenum sapientia, et intelligentia, et doctrina, ad faciendum omne opus ex ære. Qui cum venisset ad regem Salomonem, fecit omne opus ejus.
text_pt: Era ele filho de uma mulher viúva, da tribo de Naftali, e fora seu pai um homem de Tiro, que trabalhava em cobre; e era cheio de sabedoria, e de entendimento, e de ciência para fazer toda a obra de cobre; este veio ao rei Salomão, e fez toda a sua obra.
text_el: υἱὸν γυναικὸς χήρας καὶ οὗτος ἀπὸ τῆς φυλῆς Νεφθαλι καὶ ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ ἀνὴρ Τύριος τέκτων χαλκοῦ καὶ πεπληρωμένος τῆς τέχνης καὶ συνέσεως καὶ ἐπιγνώσεως τοῦ ποιεῖν πᾶν ἔργον ἐν χαλκῷ καὶ εἰσήχθη πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα Σαλωμων καὶ ἐποίησεν πάντα τὰ ἔργα

text_en: And he cast two pillars in brass, each pillar was eighteen cubits high: and a line of twelve cubits compassed both the pillars.
text_la: Et finxit duas columnas æreas, decem et octo cubitorum altitudinis columnam unam : et linea duodecim cubitorum ambiebat columnam utramque.
text_pt: E formou duas colunas de cobre; a altura de cada coluna era de dezoito côvados, e um fio de doze côvados cercava cada uma das colunas.
text_el: καὶ ἐχώνευσεν τοὺς δύο στύλους τῷ αιλαμ τοῦ οἴκου ὀκτωκαίδεκα πήχεις ὕψος τοῦ στύλου καὶ περίμετρον τέσσαρες καὶ δέκα πήχεις ἐκύκλου αὐτόν καὶ τὸ πάχος τοῦ στύλου τεσσάρων δακτύλων τὰ κοιλώματα καὶ οὕτως ὁ στῦλος ὁ δεύτερος

text_en: He made also two chapiters of molten brass, to be set upon the tops of the pillars: the height of one chapiter was five cubits, and the height of the other chapiter was five cubits:
text_la: Duo quoque capitella fecit, quæ ponerentur super capita columnarum, fusilia ex ære : quinque cubitorum altitudinis capitellum unum, et quinque cubitorum altitudinis capitellum alterum:
text_pt: Também fez dois capitéis de fundição de cobre para pôr sobre as cabeças das colunas; de cinco côvados era a altura de um capitel, e de cinco côvados a altura do outro capitel.
text_el: καὶ δύο ἐπιθέματα ἐποίησεν δοῦναι ἐπὶ τὰς κεφαλὰς τῶν στύλων χωνευτὰ χαλκᾶ πέντε πήχεις τὸ ὕψος τοῦ ἐπιθέματος τοῦ ἑνός καὶ πέντε πήχεις τὸ ὕψος τοῦ ἐπιθέματος τοῦ δευτέρου

text_en: And a kind of network, and chain work wreathed together with wonderful art. Both the chapiters of the pillars were cast: seven rows of nets were on one chapiter, and seven nets on the other chapiter.
text_la: et quasi in modum retis, et catenarum sibi invicem miro opere contextarum. Utrumque capitellum columnarum fusile erat : septena versuum retiacula in capitello uno, et septena retiacula in capitello altero.
text_pt: As redes eram de malhas, as ligas de obra de cadeia para os capitéis que estavam sobre a cabeça das colunas, sete para um capitel e sete para o outro capitel.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν δύο δίκτυα περικαλύψαι τὸ ἐπίθεμα τῶν στύλων καὶ δίκτυον τῷ ἐπιθέματι τῷ ἑνί καὶ δίκτυον τῷ ἐπιθέματι τῷ δευτέρῳ

text_en: And he made the pillars, and two rows round about each network to cover the chapiters, that were upon the top, with pomegranates: and in like manner did he to the other chapiter.
text_la: Et perfecit columnas, et duos ordines per circuitum retiaculorum singulorum, ut tegerent capitella quæ erant super summitatem, malogranatorum : eodem modo fecit et capitello secundo.
text_pt: Assim fez as colunas, juntamente com duas fileiras em redor sobre uma rede, para cobrir os capitéis que estavam sobre a cabeça das romãs, assim também fez com o outro capitel.
text_el: καὶ ἔργον κρεμαστόν δύο στίχοι ῥοῶν χαλκῶν δεδικτυωμένοι ἔργον κρεμαστόν στίχος ἐπὶ στίχον καὶ οὕτως ἐποίησεν τῷ ἐπιθέματι τῷ δευτέρῳ

text_en: And the chapiters that were upon the top of the pillars, were of lily work, in the porch of four cubits.
text_la: Capitella autem quæ erant super capita columnarum, quasi opere lilii fabricata erant in porticu quatuor cubitorum.
text_pt: E os capitéis que estavam sobre a cabeça das colunas eram de obra de lírios no pórtico, de quatro côvados.

text_en: And again there were other chapiters on the top of the pillars above, according to the measure of the pillar over against the network: and of pomegranates there were two hundred, in rows round about the other chapiter.
text_la: Et rursum alia capitella in summitate columnarum desuper juxta mensuram columnæ contra retiacula: malogranatorum autem ducenti ordines erant in circuitu capitelli secundi.
text_pt: Os capitéis, pois, sobre as duas colunas estavam também defronte, em cima da parte globular que estava junto à rede; e duzentas romãs, em fileiras em redor, estavam também sobre o outro capitel.

text_en: And he set up the two pillars in the porch of the temple : and when he had set up the pillar on the right hand, he called the name thereof Jachin: in like manner he set up the second pillar, and called the name thereof Booz.
text_la: Et statuit duas columnas in porticu templi : cumque statuisset columnam dexteram, vocavit eam nomine Jachin : similiter erexit columnam secundam, et vocavit nomen ejus Booz.
text_pt: Depois levantou as colunas no pórtico do templo; e levantando a coluna direita, pôs-lhe o nome de Jaquim; e levantando a coluna esquerda, pôs-lhe o nome de Boaz.
text_el: καὶ ἔστησεν τοὺς στύλους τοῦ αιλαμ τοῦ ναοῦ καὶ ἔστησεν τὸν στῦλον τὸν ἕνα καὶ ἐπεκάλεσεν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Ιαχουμ καὶ ἔστησεν τὸν στῦλον τὸν δεύτερον καὶ ἐπεκάλεσεν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Βααζ

text_en: And upon the tops of the pillars he made lily work: so the work of the pillars was finished.
text_la: Et super capita columnarum opus in modum lilii posuit : perfectumque est opus columnarum.
text_pt: E sobre a cabeça das colunas estava a obra de lírios; e assim se acabou a obra das colunas.
text_el: καὶ ἐπὶ τῶν κεφαλῶν τῶν στύλων ἔργον κρίνου κατὰ τὸ αιλαμ τεσσάρων πηχῶν

text_en: He made also a molten sea, of ten cubits, from brim to brim, round all about; the height of it was five cubits, and a line of thirty cubits compassed it round about.
text_la: Fecit quoque mare fusile decem cubitorum a labio usque ad labium, rotundum in circuitu : quinque cubitorum altitudo ejus, et resticula triginta cubitorum cingebat illud per circuitum.
text_pt: Fez mais o mar de fundição, de dez côvados de uma borda até à outra borda, perfeitamente redondo, e de cinco côvados de alto; e um cordão de trinta côvados o cingia em redor.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν τὴν θάλασσαν δέκα ἐν πήχει ἀπὸ τοῦ χείλους αὐτῆς ἕως τοῦ χείλους αὐτῆς στρογγύλον κύκλῳ τὸ αὐτό πέντε ἐν πήχει τὸ ὕψος αὐτῆς καὶ συνηγμένοι τρεῖς καὶ τριάκοντα ἐν πήχει ἐκύκλουν αὐτήν

text_en: And a graven work, under the brim of it, compassed it for ten cubits going about the sea: there were two rows cast of chamfered sculptures.
text_la: Et sculptura subter labium circuibat illud decem cubitis ambiens mare: duo ordines sculpturarum striatarum erant fusiles.
text_pt: E por baixo da sua borda em redor havia botões que o cingiam; por dez côvados cercavam aquele mar em redor; duas ordens destes botões foram fundidas quando o mar foi fundido.
text_el: καὶ ὑποστηρίγματα ὑποκάτωθεν τοῦ χείλους αὐτῆς κυκλόθεν ἐκύκλουν αὐτήν δέκα ἐν πήχει κυκλόθεν ἀνιστᾶν τὴν θάλασσαν

text_en: And it stood upon twelve oxen, of which three looked towards the north, and three towards the west, and three towards the south, and three towards the east: and the sea was above upon them, and their hinder parts were all hid within.
text_la: Et stabat super duodecim boves, e quibus tres respiciebant ad aquilonem, et tres ad occidentem, et tres ad meridiem, et tres ad orientem : et mare super eos desuper erat : quorum posteriora universa intrinsecus latitabant.
text_pt: E firmava-se sobre doze bois, três que olhavam para o norte, e três que olhavam para o ocidente, e três que olhavam para o sul, e três que olhavam para o oriente; e o mar estava em cima deles, e todas as suas partes posteriores para o lado de dentro.
text_el: καὶ δώδεκα βόες ὑποκάτω τῆς θαλάσσης οἱ τρεῖς ἐπιβλέποντες βορρᾶν καὶ οἱ τρεῖς ἐπιβλέποντες θάλασσαν καὶ οἱ τρεῖς ἐπιβλέποντες νότον καὶ οἱ τρεῖς ἐπιβλέποντες ἀνατολήν καὶ πάντα τὰ ὀπίσθια εἰς τὸν οἶκον καὶ ἡ θάλασσα ἐπ' αὐτῶν ἐπάνωθεν

text_en: And the laver was a hand breadth thick: and the brim thereof was like the brim of a cup, or the leaf of a crisped lily: it contained two thousand bates.
text_la: Grossitudo autem luteris, trium unciarum erat : labiumque ejus quasi labium calicis, et folium repandi lilii : duo millia batos capiebat.
text_pt: E a grossura era de um palmo, e a sua borda era como a de um copo, como de flor de lírios; ele levava dois mil batos.

text_en: And he made ten bases of brass, every base was four cubits in length, and four cubits in breadth, and three cubits high.
text_la: Et fecit decem bases æneas, quatuor cubitorum longitudinis bases singulas, et quatuor cubitorum latitudinis, et trium cubitorum altitudinis.
text_pt: Fez também as dez bases de cobre; o comprimento de uma base de quatro côvados, e de quatro côvados a sua largura, e três côvados a sua altura.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν δέκα μεχωνωθ χαλκᾶς πέντε πήχεις μῆκος τῆς μεχωνωθ τῆς μιᾶς καὶ τέσσαρες πήχεις πλάτος αὐτῆς καὶ ἓξ ἐν πήχει ὕψος αὐτῆς

text_en: And the work itself of the bases, was intergraven: and there were gravings between the joinings.
text_la: Et ipsum opus basium, interrasile erat : et sculpturæ inter juncturas.
text_pt: E esta era a obra das bases; tinham cintas, e as cintas estavam entre as molduras.
text_el: καὶ τοῦτο τὸ ἔργον τῶν μεχωνωθ σύγκλειστον αὐτοῖς καὶ σύγκλειστον ἀνὰ μέσον τῶν ἐξεχομένων

text_en: And between the little crowns and the ledges, were lions, and oxen, and cherubims ; and in the joinings likewise above: and under the lions and oxen, as it were bands of brass hanging down.
text_la: Et inter coronulas et plectas, leones et boves et cherubim, et in juncturis similiter desuper : et subter leones et boves, quasi lora ex ære dependentia.
text_pt: E sobre as cintas que estavam entre as molduras havia leões, bois, e querubins, e sobre as molduras uma base por cima; e debaixo dos leões e dos bois junturas de obra estendida.
text_el: καὶ ἐπὶ τὰ συγκλείσματα αὐτῶν ἀνὰ μέσον τῶν ἐξεχομένων λέοντες καὶ βόες καὶ χερουβιν καὶ ἐπὶ τῶν ἐξεχομένων οὕτως καὶ ἐπάνωθεν καὶ ὑποκάτωθεν τῶν λεόντων καὶ τῶν βοῶν χῶραι ἔργον καταβάσεως

text_en: And every base had four wheels, and axletrees of brass: and at the four sides were undersetters, under the laver molten, looking one against another.
text_la: Et quatuor rotæ per bases singulas, et axes ærei : et per quatuor partes quasi humeruli subter luterem fusiles, contra se invicem respectantes.
text_pt: E uma base tinha quatro rodas de metal, e lâminas de cobre; e os seus quatro cantos tinham suportes; debaixo da pia estavam estes suportes fundidos, do lado de cada uma das junturas.
text_el: καὶ τέσσαρες τροχοὶ χαλκοῖ τῇ μεχωνωθ τῇ μιᾷ καὶ τὰ προσέχοντα χαλκᾶ καὶ τέσσαρα μέρη αὐτῶν ὠμίαι ὑποκάτω τῶν λουτήρων

text_en: The mouth also of the laver within, was in the top of the chapiter: and that which appeared without, was of one cubit all round, and together it was one cubit and a half: and in the corners of the pillars were divers engravings: and the spaces between the pillars were square, not round.
text_la: Os quoque luteris intrinsecus erat in capitis summitate : et quod forinsecus apparebat, unius cubiti erat totum rotundum, pariterque habebat unum cubitum et dimidium : in angulis autem columnarum variæ cælaturæ erant : et media intercolumnia, quadrata non rotunda.
text_pt: E a boca da pia estava dentro da coroa, e de um côvado por cima; e era a sua boca redonda segundo a obra da base, de côvado e meio; e também sobre a sua boca havia entalhes, e as suas cintas eram quadradas, não redondas.

text_en: And the four wheels, which were at the four corners of the base, were joined one to another under the base: the height of a wheel was a cubit and a half.
text_la: Quatuor quoque rotæ quæ per quatuor angulos basis erant, cohærebant sibi subter basim : una rota habebat altitudinis cubitum et semis.
text_pt: E as quatro rodas estavam debaixo das cintas, e os eixos das rodas na base; e era a altura de cada roda de côvado e meio.
text_el: καὶ χεῖρες ἐν τοῖς τροχοῖς ἐν τῇ μεχωνωθ καὶ τὸ ὕψος τοῦ τροχοῦ τοῦ ἑνὸς πήχεος καὶ ἡμίσους

text_en: And they were such wheels as are used to be made in a chariot: and their axletrees, and spokes, and strakes, and naves, were all cast.
text_la: Tales autem rotæ erant quales solent in curru fieri : et axes earum, et radii, et canthi, et modioli, omnia fusilia.
text_pt: E era a obra das rodas como a obra da roda de carro; seus eixos, e suas cambas e seus cubos, e seus raios, todos eram fundidos.
text_el: καὶ τὸ ἔργον τῶν τροχῶν ἔργον τροχῶν ἅρματος αἱ χεῖρες αὐτῶν καὶ οἱ νῶτοι αὐτῶν καὶ ἡ πραγματεία αὐτῶν τὰ πάντα χωνευτά

text_en: And the four undersetters, that were at every corner of each base, were of the base itself, cast and joined together.
text_la: Nam et humeruli illi quatuor per singulos angulos basis unius, ex ipsa basi fusiles et conjuncti erant.
text_pt: E havia quatro suportes aos quatro cantos de cada base; seus suportes saíam da base.
text_el: αἱ τέσσαρες ὠμίαι ἐπὶ τῶν τεσσάρων γωνιῶν τῆς μεχωνωθ τῆς μιᾶς ἐκ τῆς μεχωνωθ οἱ ὦμοι αὐτῆς

text_en: And on the top of the base, there was a round compass of half a cubit, so wrought that the laver might be set thereon, having its gravings, and divers sculptures of itself.
text_la: In summitate autem basis erat quædam rotunditas dimidii cubiti, ita fabrefacta ut luter desuper posset imponi, habens cælaturas suas, variasque sculpturas ex semetipsa.
text_pt: E no alto de cada base havia uma peça redonda de meio côvado de altura; também sobre o alto de cada base havia asas e cintas, que saíam delas.
text_el: καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς κεφαλῆς τῆς μεχωνωθ ἥμισυ τοῦ πήχεος μέγεθος στρογγύλον κύκλῳ ἐπὶ τῆς κεφαλῆς τῆς μεχωνωθ καὶ ἀρχὴ χειρῶν αὐτῆς καὶ τὰ συγκλείσματα αὐτῆς καὶ ἠνοίγετο ἐπὶ τὰς ἀρχὰς τῶν χειρῶν αὐτῆς

text_en: He engraved also in those plates, which were of brass, and in the corners, cherubims , and lions, and palm trees, in likeness of a man standing, so that they seemed not to be engraven, but added round about.
text_la: Sculpsit quoque in tabulatis illis quæ erant ex ære, et in angulis, cherubim, et leones, et palmas, quasi in similitudinem hominis stantis, ut non cælata, sed apposita per circuitum viderentur.
text_pt: E nas placas de seus esteios e nas suas cintas lavrou querubins, leões, e palmas, segundo o espaço de cada uma, e outros adornos em redor.
text_el: καὶ τὰ συγκλείσματα αὐτῆς χερουβιν καὶ λέοντες καὶ φοίνικες ἑστῶτα ἐχόμενον ἕκαστον κατὰ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ ἔσω καὶ τὰ κυκλόθεν

text_en: After this manner, he made ten bases, of one casting and measure, and the like graving.
text_la: In hunc modum fecit decem bases, fusura una, et mensura, sculpturaque consimili.
text_pt: Conforme a esta fez as dez bases; todas tinham uma mesma fundição, uma mesma medida, e um mesmo entalhe.
text_el: κατ' αὐτὴν ἐποίησεν πάσας τὰς δέκα μεχωνωθ τάξιν μίαν καὶ μέτρον ἓν πάσαις

text_en: He made also ten lavers of brass: one laver contained four bates, and was of four cubits: and upon every base, in all ten, he put as many lavers.
text_la: Fecit quoque decem luteres æneos : quadraginta batos capiebat luter unus, eratque quatuor cubitorum : singulos quoque luteres per singulas, id est, decem bases, posuit.
text_pt: Também fez dez pias de cobre; em cada pia cabiam quarenta batos, e cada pia era de quatro côvados, e sobre cada uma das dez bases estava uma pia.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν δέκα χυτροκαύλους χαλκοῦς τεσσαράκοντα χοεῖς χωροῦντα τὸν χυτρόκαυλον τὸν ἕνα μετρήσει ὁ χυτρόκαυλος ὁ εἷς ἐπὶ τῆς μεχωνωθ τῆς μιᾶς ταῖς δέκα μεχωνωθ

text_en: And he set the ten bases, five on the right side of the temple , and five on the left: and the sea he put on the right side of the temple , over against the east southward.
text_la: Et constituit decem bases, quinque ad dexteram partem templi, et quinque ad sinistram : mare autem posuit ad dexteram partem templi contra orientem ad meridiem.
text_pt: E pôs cinco bases à direita da casa, e cinco à esquerda da casa; porém o mar pôs ao lado direito da casa para o lado do oriente, da parte do sul.
text_el: καὶ ἔθετο τὰς δέκα μεχωνωθ πέντε ἀπὸ τῆς ὠμίας τοῦ οἴκου ἐκ δεξιῶν καὶ πέντε ἀπὸ τῆς ὠμίας τοῦ οἴκου ἐξ ἀριστερῶν καὶ ἡ θάλασσα ἀπὸ τῆς ὠμίας τοῦ οἴκου ἐκ δεξιῶν κατ' ἀνατολὰς ἀπὸ τοῦ κλίτους τοῦ νότου

text_en: And Hiram made cauldrons, and shovels, and basins, and finished all the work of King Solomon in the temple of the Lord .
text_la: Fecit ergo Hiram lebetes, et scutras, et hamulas, et perfecit omne opus regis Salomonis in templo Domini.
text_pt: Depois fez Hirão as pias, e as pás, e as bacias; e acabou Hirão de fazer toda a obra que fez para o rei Salomão, para a casa do Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν Χιραμ τοὺς λέβητας καὶ τὰς θερμάστρεις καὶ τὰς φιάλας καὶ συνετέλεσεν Χιραμ ποιῶν πάντα τὰ ἔργα ἃ ἐποίησεν τῷ βασιλεῖ Σαλωμων ἐν οἴκῳ κυρίου

text_en: The two pillars and the two cords of the chapiters, upon the chapiters of the pillars: and the two networks, to cover the two cords, that were upon the top of the pillars.
text_la: Columnas duas, et funiculos capitellorum super capitella columnarum duos : et retiacula duo, ut operirent duos funiculos qui erant super capita columnarum.
text_pt: A saber: as duas colunas, e os globos dos capitéis que estavam sobre a cabeça das duas colunas; e as duas redes, para cobrir os dois globos dos capitéis que estavam sobre a cabeça das colunas.
text_el: στύλους δύο καὶ τὰ στρεπτὰ τῶν στύλων ἐπὶ τῶν κεφαλῶν τῶν στύλων δύο καὶ τὰ δίκτυα δύο τοῦ καλύπτειν ἀμφότερα τὰ στρεπτὰ τῶν γλυφῶν τὰ ὄντα ἐπὶ τῶν στύλων

text_en: And four hundred pomegranates for the two networks: two rows of pomegranates for each network, to cover the cords of the chapiters, which were upon the tops of the pillars.
text_la: Et malogranata quadringenta in duobus retiaculis : duos versus malogranatorum in retiaculis singulis, ad operiendos funiculos capitellorum qui erant super capita columnarum.
text_pt: E as quatrocentas romãs para as duas redes, a saber: duas carreiras de romãs para cada rede, para cobrirem os dois globos dos capitéis que estavam em cima das colunas.
text_el: τὰς ῥόας τετρακοσίας ἀμφοτέροις τοῖς δικτύοις δύο στίχοι ῥοῶν τῷ δικτύῳ τῷ ἑνὶ περικαλύπτειν ἀμφότερα τὰ στρεπτὰ ἐπ' ἀμφοτέροις τοῖς στύλοις

text_en: And the ten bases, and the ten lavers on the bases.
text_la: Et bases decem, et luteres decem super bases.
text_pt: Juntamente com as dez bases, e as dez pias sobre as bases;
text_el: καὶ τὰς μεχωνωθ δέκα καὶ τοὺς χυτροκαύλους δέκα ἐπὶ τῶν μεχωνωθ

text_en: And one sea, and twelve oxen under the sea.
text_la: Et mare unum, et boves duodecim subter mare.
text_pt: Como também um mar, e os doze bois debaixo daquele mar;
text_el: καὶ τὴν θάλασσαν μίαν καὶ τοὺς βόας δώδεκα ὑποκάτω τῆς θαλάσσης

text_en: And the cauldrons, and the shovels, and the basins. All the vessels that Hiram made for King Solomon , for the house of the Lord , were of fine brass.
text_la: Et lebetes, et scutras, et hamulas, omnia vasa quæ fecit Hiram regi Salomoni in domo Domini, de auricalco erant.
text_pt: E os caldeirões, e as pás, e as bacias, e todos estes objetos que fez Hirão para o rei Salomão, para a casa do Senhor, todos eram de cobre polido.
text_el: καὶ τοὺς λέβητας καὶ τὰς θερμάστρεις καὶ τὰς φιάλας καὶ πάντα τὰ σκεύη ἃ ἐποίησεν Χιραμ τῷ βασιλεῖ Σαλωμων τῷ οἴκῳ κυρίου καὶ οἱ στῦλοι τεσσαράκοντα καὶ ὀκτὼ τοῦ οἴκου τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ τοῦ οἴκου κυρίου πάντα τὰ ἔργα τοῦ βασιλέως ἃ ἐποίησεν Χιραμ χαλκᾶ ἄρδην

text_en: In the plains of the Jordan , did the king cast them in a clay ground, between Socoth and Sartham.
text_la: In campestri regione Jordanis fudit ea rex in argillosa terra, inter Sochoth et Sarthan.
text_pt: Na planície do Jordão, o rei os fundiu em terra barrenta; entre Sucote e Zaretã.
text_el: ἐν τῷ περιοίκῳ τοῦ Ιορδάνου ἐχώνευσεν αὐτὰ ὁ βασιλεὺς ἐν τῷ πάχει τῆς γῆς ἀνὰ μέσον Σοκχωθ καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον Σιρα

text_en: And Solomon placed all the vessels: but for its exceeding great multitude the brass could not be weighed.
text_la: Et posuit Salomon omnia vasa : propter multitudinem autem nimiam non erat pondus æris.
text_pt: E deixou Salomão de pesar todos os objetos, pelo seu excessivo número; nem se averiguou o peso do cobre.

text_en: And Solomon made all the vessels for the house of the Lord : the altar of gold, and the table of gold, upon which the loaves of proposition should be set:
text_la: Fecitque Salomon omnia vasa in domo Domini : altare aureum, et mensam super quam ponerentur panes propositionis, auream:
text_pt: Também fez Salomão todos os objetos que convinham à casa do Senhor; o altar de ouro, e a mesa de ouro, sobre a qual estavam os pães da proposição.
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκεν ὁ βασιλεὺς Σαλωμων τὰ σκεύη ἃ ἐποίησεν ἐν οἴκῳ κυρίου τὸ θυσιαστήριον τὸ χρυσοῦν καὶ τὴν τράπεζαν ἐφ' ἧς οἱ ἄρτοι τῆς προσφορᾶς χρυσῆν

text_en: And the golden candlesticks, five on the right hand, and five on the left, over against the oracle, of pure gold: and the flowers like lilies, and the lamps over them of gold: and golden snuffers,
text_la: et candelabra aurea, quinque ad dexteram, et quinque ad sinistram contra oraculum, ex auro puro : et quasi lilii flores, et lucernas desuper aureas : et forcipes aureos,
text_pt: E os castiçais, cinco à direita e cinco à esquerda, diante do oráculo, de ouro finíssimo; e as flores, e as lâmpadas, e os espevitadores, também de ouro.
text_el: καὶ τὰς λυχνίας πέντε ἐκ δεξιῶν καὶ πέντε ἐξ ἀριστερῶν κατὰ πρόσωπον τοῦ δαβιρ χρυσᾶς συγκλειομένας καὶ τὰ λαμπάδια καὶ τοὺς λύχνους καὶ τὰς ἐπαρυστρίδας χρυσᾶς

text_en: and pots, and fleshhooks, and bowls, and mortars, and censers , of most pure gold: and the hinges for the doors of the inner house of the holy of holies, and for the doors of the house of the temple , were of gold.
text_la: et hydrias, et fuscinulas, et phialas, et mortariola, et thuribula, de auro purissimo : et cardines ostiorum domus interioris Sancti sanctorum, et ostiorum domus templi, ex auro erant.
text_pt: Como também os vasos, e os apagadores, e as bacias, e as colheres, e os perfumadores, de ouro finíssimo; e as dobradiças para as portas da casa interior para o lugar santíssimo, e as das portas da casa do templo, também de ouro.
text_el: καὶ τὰ πρόθυρα καὶ οἱ ἧλοι καὶ αἱ φιάλαι καὶ τὰ τρύβλια καὶ αἱ θυίσκαι χρυσαῖ σύγκλειστα καὶ τὰ θυρώματα τῶν θυρῶν τοῦ οἴκου τοῦ ἐσωτάτου ἁγίου τῶν ἁγίων καὶ τὰς θύρας τοῦ οἴκου τοῦ ναοῦ χρυσᾶς

text_en: And Solomon finished all the work that he made in the house of the Lord , and brought in the things that David , his father, had dedicated , the silver and the gold, and the vessels, and laid them up in the treasures of the house of the Lord .
text_la: Et perfecit omne opus quod faciebat Salomon in domo Domini, et intulit quæ sanctificaverat David pater suus, argentum, et aurum, et vasa, reposuitque in thesauris domus Domini.
text_pt: Assim se acabou toda a obra que fez o rei Salomão para a casa do Senhor; então trouxe Salomão as coisas que seu pai Davi havia consagrado; a prata, e o ouro, e os objetos pôs entre os tesouros da casa do Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἀνεπληρώθη πᾶν τὸ ἔργον ὃ ἐποίησεν Σαλωμων οἴκου κυρίου καὶ εἰσήνεγκεν Σαλωμων τὰ ἅγια Δαυιδ τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ πάντα τὰ ἅγια Σαλωμων τὸ ἀργύριον καὶ τὸ χρυσίον καὶ τὰ σκεύη ἔδωκεν εἰς τοὺς θησαυροὺς οἴκου κυρίου

text_en: Then all the ancients of Israel , with the princes of the tribes, and the heads of the families of the children of Israel , were assembled to King Solomon , in Jerusalem : that they might carry the ark of the covenant of the Lord , out of the city of David, that is, out of Sion.
text_la: Tunc congregati sunt omnes majores natu Israël cum principibus tribuum, et duces familiarum filiorum Israël, ad regem Salomonem in Jerusalem, ut deferrent arcam fœderis Domini de civitate David, id est, de Sion.
text_pt: Então congregou Salomão os anciãos de Israel, e todos os cabeças das tribos, os chefes dos pais dos filhos de Israel, diante de si em Jerusalém; para fazerem subir a arca da aliança do SENHOR da cidade de Davi, que é Sião.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ συντελέσαι Σαλωμων τοῦ οἰκοδομῆσαι τὸν οἶκον κυρίου καὶ τὸν οἶκον ἑαυτοῦ μετὰ εἴκοσι ἔτη τότε ἐξεκκλησίασεν ὁ βασιλεὺς Σαλωμων πάντας τοὺς πρεσβυτέρους Ισραηλ ἐν Σιων τοῦ ἀνενεγκεῖν τὴν κιβωτὸν διαθήκης κυρίου ἐκ πόλεως Δαυιδ αὕτη ἐστὶν Σιων

text_en: And all Israel assembled themselves to King Solomon , on the festival day, in the month of Ethanim, the same is the seventh month.
text_la: Convenitque ad regem Salomonem universus Israël in mense Ethanim, in solemni die : ipse est mensis septimus.
text_pt: E todos os homens de Israel se congregaram ao rei Salomão, na ocasião da festa, no mês de Etanim, que é o sétimo mês.
text_el: ἐν μηνὶ Αθανιν

text_en: And all the ancients of Israel came, and the priests took up the ark ,
text_la: Veneruntque cuncti senes de Israël, et tulerunt arcam sacerdotes,
text_pt: E vieram todos os anciãos de Israel; e os sacerdotes alçaram a arca.
text_el: καὶ ἦραν οἱ ἱερεῖς τὴν κιβωτὸν

text_en: and carried the ark of the Lord , and the tabernacle of the covenant , and all the vessels of the sanctuary, that were in the tabernacle : and the priests and the Levites carried them.
text_la: et portaverunt arcam Domini, et tabernaculum fœderis, et omnia vasa sanctuarii quæ erant in tabernaculo : et ferebant ea sacerdotes et Levitæ.
text_pt: E trouxeram a arca do Senhor para cima, e o tabernáculo da congregação, juntamente com todos os objetos sagrados que havia no tabernáculo; assim os trouxeram para cima os sacerdotes e os levitas.
text_el: καὶ τὸ σκήνωμα τοῦ μαρτυρίου καὶ πάντα τὰ σκεύη τὰ ἅγια τὰ ἐν τῷ σκηνώματι τοῦ μαρτυρίου

text_en: And King Solomon , and all the multitude of Israel , that were assembled unto him, went with him before the ark , and they sacrificed sheep and oxen, that could not be counted or numbered.
text_la: Rex autem Salomon, et omnis multitudo Israël quæ convenerat ad eum, gradiebatur cum illo ante arcam, et immolabant oves et boves absque æstimatione et numero.
text_pt: E o rei Salomão, e toda a congregação de Israel que se congregara a ele, estava com ele diante da arca, sacrificando ovelhas e vacas, que não se podiam contar nem numerar pela sua quantidade.
text_el: καὶ ὁ βασιλεὺς καὶ πᾶς Ισραηλ ἔμπροσθεν τῆς κιβωτοῦ θύοντες πρόβατα καὶ βόας ἀναρίθμητα

text_en: And the priests brought in the ark of the covenant of the Lord into its place, into the oracle of the temple , into the holy of holies, under the wings of the cherubims .
text_la: Et intulerunt sacerdotes arcam fœderis Domini in locum suum, in oraculum templi, in Sanctum sanctorum, subter alas cherubim.
text_pt: Assim trouxeram os sacerdotes a arca da aliança do Senhor ao seu lugar, ao oráculo da casa, ao lugar santíssimo, até debaixo das asas dos querubins.
text_el: καὶ εἰσφέρουσιν οἱ ἱερεῖς τὴν κιβωτὸν εἰς τὸν τόπον αὐτῆς εἰς τὸ δαβιρ τοῦ οἴκου εἰς τὰ ἅγια τῶν ἁγίων ὑπὸ τὰς πτέρυγας τῶν χερουβιν

text_en: For the cherubims spread forth their wings over the place of the ark , and covered the ark , and the staves thereof above.
text_la: Siquidem cherubim expandebant alas super locum arcæ, et protegebant arcam, et vectes ejus desuper.
text_pt: Porque os querubins estendiam ambas as asas sobre o lugar da arca; e os querubins cobriam, por cima, a arca e os seus varais.
text_el: ὅτι τὰ χερουβιν διαπεπετασμένα ταῖς πτέρυξιν ἐπὶ τὸν τόπον τῆς κιβωτοῦ καὶ περιεκάλυπτον τὰ χερουβιν ἐπὶ τὴν κιβωτὸν καὶ ἐπὶ τὰ ἅγια αὐτῆς ἐπάνωθεν

text_en: And whereas the staves stood out, the ends of them were seen without, in the sanctuary before the oracle, but were not seen farther out, and there they have been unto this day.
text_la: Cumque eminerent vectes, et apparerent summitates eorum foris sanctuarium ante oraculum, non apparebant ultra extrinsecus, qui et fuerunt ibi usque in præsentem diem.
text_pt: E os varais sobressaíram tanto, que as pontas dos varais se viam desde o santuário diante do oráculo, porém de fora não se viam; e ficaram ali até ao dia de hoje.
text_el: καὶ ὑπερεῖχον τὰ ἡγιασμένα καὶ ἐνεβλέποντο αἱ κεφαλαὶ τῶν ἡγιασμένων ἐκ τῶν ἁγίων εἰς πρόσωπον τοῦ δαβιρ καὶ οὐκ ὠπτάνοντο ἔξω

text_en: Now in the ark there was nothing else but the two tables of stone, which Moses put there at Horeb , when the Lord made a covenant with the children of Israel , when they came out of the land of Egypt .
text_la: In arca autem non erat aliud nisi duæ tabulæ lapideæ quas posuerat in ea Moyses in Horeb, quando pepigit Dominus fœdus cum filiis Israël, cum egrederentur de terra Ægypti.
text_pt: Na arca nada havia, senão só as duas tábuas de pedra, que Moisés ali pusera junto a Horebe, quando o Senhor fez a aliança com os filhos de Israel, saindo eles da terra do Egito.
text_el: οὐκ ἦν ἐν τῇ κιβωτῷ πλὴν δύο πλάκες λίθιναι πλάκες τῆς διαθήκης ἃς ἔθηκεν ἐκεῖ Μωυσῆς ἐν Χωρηβ ἃ διέθετο κύριος μετὰ τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ ἐν τῷ ἐκπορεύεσθαι αὐτοὺς ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου

text_en: And it came to pass, when the priests had come out of the sanctuary, that a cloud filled the house of the Lord ,
text_la: Factum est autem cum exissent sacerdotes de sanctuario, nebula implevit domum Domini,
text_pt: E sucedeu que, saindo os sacerdotes do santuário, uma nuvem encheu a casa do Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς ἐξῆλθον οἱ ἱερεῖς ἐκ τοῦ ἁγίου καὶ ἡ νεφέλη ἔπλησεν τὸν οἶκον
