text_pt: Então Jezabel mandou um mensageiro a Elias, a dizer-lhe: Assim me façam os deuses, e outro tanto, se de certo amanhã a estas horas não puser a tua vida como a de um deles.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν Ιεζαβελ πρὸς Ηλιου καὶ εἶπεν εἰ σὺ εἶ Ηλιου καὶ ἐγὼ Ιεζαβελ τάδε ποιήσαι μοι ὁ θεὸς καὶ τάδε προσθείη ὅτι ταύτην τὴν ὥραν αὔριον θήσομαι τὴν ψυχήν σου καθὼς ψυχὴν ἑνὸς ἐξ αὐτῶν

text_en: Then Elias was afraid, and rising up, he went wherever he had a mind: and he came to Bersabee of Juda , and left his servant there,
text_la: Timuit ergo Elias, et surgens abiit quocumque eum ferebat voluntas : venitque in Bersabee Juda, et dimisit ibi puerum suum,
text_pt: O que vendo ele, se levantou e, para escapar com vida, se foi, e chegando a Berseba, que é de Judá, deixou ali o seu servo.
text_el: καὶ ἐφοβήθη Ηλιου καὶ ἀνέστη καὶ ἀπῆλθεν κατὰ τὴν ψυχὴν ἑαυτοῦ καὶ ἔρχεται εἰς Βηρσαβεε τὴν Ιουδα καὶ ἀφῆκεν τὸ παιδάριον αὐτοῦ ἐκεῖ

text_en: and he went forward, one day's journey into the desert . And when he was there, and sat under a juniper tree, he requested for his soul that he might die, and said: It is enough for me, Lord ; take away my soul : for I am no better than my fathers.
text_la: et perrexit in desertum, viam unius diei. Cumque venisset, et sederet subter unam juniperum, petivit animæ suæ ut moreretur, et ait : Sufficit mihi, Domine : tolle animam meam : neque enim melior sum quam patres mei.
text_pt: Ele, porém, foi ao deserto, caminho de um dia, e foi sentar-se debaixo de um zimbro; e pediu para si a morte, e disse: Já basta, ó Senhor; toma agora a minha vida, pois não sou melhor do que meus pais.
text_el: καὶ αὐτὸς ἐπορεύθη ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ ὁδὸν ἡμέρας καὶ ἦλθεν καὶ ἐκάθισεν ὑπὸ ραθμ ἓν καὶ ᾐτήσατο τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ ἀποθανεῖν καὶ εἶπεν ἱκανούσθω νῦν λαβὲ δὴ τὴν ψυχήν μου ἀπ' ἐμοῦ κύριε ὅτι οὐ κρείσσων ἐγώ εἰμι ὑπὲρ τοὺς πατέρας μου

text_en: And he cast himself down, and slept in the shadow of the juniper tree: and behold an angel of the Lord touched him, and said to him: Arise and eat.
text_la: Projecitque se, et obdormivit in umbra juniperi : et ecce angelus Domini tetigit eum, et dixit illi : Surge, et comede.
text_pt: E deitou-se, e dormiu debaixo do zimbro; e eis que então um anjo o tocou, e lhe disse: Levanta-te, come.
text_el: καὶ ἐκοιμήθη καὶ ὕπνωσεν ἐκεῖ ὑπὸ φυτόν καὶ ἰδού τις ἥψατο αὐτοῦ καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ ἀνάστηθι καὶ φάγε

text_en: He looked, and behold there was at his head a hearth cake, and a vessel of water: and he ate and drank, and he fell asleep again.
text_la: Respexit, et ecce ad caput suum subcinericius panis, et vas aquæ : comedit ergo, et bibit, et rursum obdormivit.
text_pt: E olhou, e eis que à sua cabeceira estava um pão cozido sobre as brasas, e uma botija de água; e comeu, e bebeu, e tornou a deitar-se.
text_el: καὶ ἐπέβλεψεν Ηλιου καὶ ἰδοὺ πρὸς κεφαλῆς αὐτοῦ ἐγκρυφίας ὀλυρίτης καὶ καψάκης ὕδατος καὶ ἀνέστη καὶ ἔφαγεν καὶ ἔπιεν καὶ ἐπιστρέψας ἐκοιμήθη

text_en: And the angel of the Lord came again the second time, and touched him, and said to him: Arise, eat: for you have yet a great way to go.
text_la: Reversusque est angelus Domini secundo, et tetigit eum, dixitque illi : Surge, comede : grandis enim tibi restat via.
text_pt: E o anjo do Senhor tornou segunda vez, e o tocou, e disse: Levanta-te e come, porque te será muito longo o caminho.
text_el: καὶ ἐπέστρεψεν ὁ ἄγγελος κυρίου ἐκ δευτέρου καὶ ἥψατο αὐτοῦ καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ ἀνάστα φάγε ὅτι πολλὴ ἀπὸ σοῦ ἡ ὁδός

text_en: And he arose, and ate and drank, and walked in the strength of that food forty days and forty nights, unto the mount of God , Horeb .
text_la: Qui cum surrexisset, comedit et bibit, et ambulavit in fortitudine cibi illius quadraginta diebus et quadraginta noctibus usque ad montem Dei Horeb.
text_pt: Levantou-se, pois, e comeu e bebeu; e com a força daquela comida caminhou quarenta dias e quarenta noites até Horebe, o monte de Deus.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέστη καὶ ἔφαγεν καὶ ἔπιεν καὶ ἐπορεύθη ἐν τῇ ἰσχύι τῆς βρώσεως ἐκείνης τεσσαράκοντα ἡμέρας καὶ τεσσαράκοντα νύκτας ἕως ὄρους Χωρηβ

text_en: And when he had come thither, he abode in a cave and behold the word of the Lord came unto him, and he said to him: What do you here, Elias ?
text_la: Cumque venisset illuc, mansit in spelunca : et ecce sermo Domini ad eum, dixitque illi : Quid hic agis, Elia?
text_pt: E ali entrou numa caverna e passou ali a noite; e eis que a palavra do Senhor veio a ele, e lhe disse: Que fazes aqui Elias?
text_el: καὶ εἰσῆλθεν ἐκεῖ εἰς τὸ σπήλαιον καὶ κατέλυσεν ἐκεῖ καὶ ἰδοὺ ῥῆμα κυρίου πρὸς αὐτὸν καὶ εἶπεν τί σὺ ἐνταῦθα Ηλιου

text_en: And he answered: With zeal have I been zealous for the Lord God of hosts : for the children of Israel have forsaken your covenant: they have thrown down your altars , they have slain your prophets with the sword, and I alone am left, and they seek my life to take it away.
text_la: At ille respondit : Zelo zelatus sum pro Domino Deo exercituum, quia dereliquerunt pactum tuum filii Israël : altaria tua destruxerunt, prophetas tuos occiderunt gladio, derelictus sum ego solus, et quærunt animam meam ut auferant eam.
text_pt: E ele disse: Tenho sido muito zeloso pelo Senhor Deus dos Exércitos, porque os filhos de Israel deixaram a tua aliança, derrubaram os teus altares, e mataram os teus profetas à espada, e só eu fiquei, e buscam a minha vida para ma tirarem.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ηλιου ζηλῶν ἐζήλωκα τῷ κυρίῳ παντοκράτορι ὅτι ἐγκατέλιπόν σε οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ τὰ θυσιαστήριά σου κατέσκαψαν καὶ τοὺς προφήτας σου ἀπέκτειναν ἐν ῥομφαίᾳ καὶ ὑπολέλειμμαι ἐγὼ μονώτατος καὶ ζητοῦσι τὴν ψυχήν μου λαβεῖν αὐτήν

text_en: And he said to him: Go forth, and stand upon the mount before the Lord : and behold the Lord passes, and a great and strong wind before the Lord , overthrowing the mountains, and breaking the rocks in pieces: but the Lord is not in the wind. And after the wind, an earthquake: but the Lord is not in the earthquake.
text_la: Et ait ei : Egredere, et sta in monte coram Domino : et ecce Dominus transit. Et spiritus grandis et fortis subvertens montes, et conterens petras, ante Dominum : non in spiritu Dominus. Et post spiritum commotio : non in commotione Dominus.
text_pt: E Deus lhe disse: Sai para fora, e põe-te neste monte perante o Senhor. E eis que passava o Senhor, como também um grande e forte vento que fendia os montes e quebrava as penhas diante do Senhor; porém o Senhor não estava no vento; e depois do vento um terremoto; também o Senhor não estava no terremoto;
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ἐξελεύσῃ αὔριον καὶ στήσῃ ἐνώπιον κυρίου ἐν τῷ ὄρει ἰδοὺ παρελεύσεται κύριος καὶ πνεῦμα μέγα κραταιὸν διαλῦον ὄρη καὶ συντρῖβον πέτρας ἐνώπιον κυρίου οὐκ ἐν τῷ πνεύματι κύριος καὶ μετὰ τὸ πνεῦμα συσσεισμός οὐκ ἐν τῷ συσσεισμῷ κύριος

text_en: And after the earthquake, a fire: but the Lord is not in the fire. And after the fire, a whistling of a gentle air.
text_la: Et post commotionem ignis : non in igne Dominus. Et post ignem sibilus auræ tenuis.
text_pt: E depois do terremoto um fogo; porém também o Senhor não estava no fogo; e depois do fogo uma voz mansa e delicada.
text_el: καὶ μετὰ τὸν συσσεισμὸν πῦρ οὐκ ἐν τῷ πυρὶ κύριος καὶ μετὰ τὸ πῦρ φωνὴ αὔρας λεπτῆς κἀκεῖ κύριος

text_en: And when Elias heard it, he covered his face with his mantle, and coming forth, stood in the entering in of the cave, and behold a voice unto him, saying: What do you here, Elias ? And he answered:
text_la: Quod cum audisset Elias, operuit vultum suum pallio, et egressus stetit in ostio speluncæ. Et ecce vox ad eum dicens : Quid hic agis, Elia? Et ille respondit:
text_pt: E sucedeu que, ouvindo-a Elias, envolveu o seu rosto na sua capa, e saiu para fora, e pôs-se à entrada da caverna; e eis que veio a ele uma voz, que dizia: Que fazes aqui, Elias?
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς ἤκουσεν Ηλιου καὶ ἐπεκάλυψεν τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ ἐν τῇ μηλωτῇ ἑαυτοῦ καὶ ἐξῆλθεν καὶ ἔστη ὑπὸ τὸ σπήλαιον καὶ ἰδοὺ πρὸς αὐτὸν φωνὴ καὶ εἶπεν τί σὺ ἐνταῦθα Ηλιου

text_en: With zeal have I been zealous for the Lord God of hosts : because the children of Israel have forsaken your covenant: they have destroyed your altars , they have slain your prophets with the sword; and I alone am left, and they seek my life to take it away.
text_la: Zelo zelatus sum pro Domino Deo exercituum, quia dereliquerunt pactum tuum filii Israël : altaria tua destruxerunt, prophetas tuos occiderunt gladio, derelictus sum ego solus, et quærunt animam meam ut auferant eam.
text_pt: E ele disse: Eu tenho sido em extremo zeloso pelo Senhor Deus dos Exércitos, porque os filhos de Israel deixaram a tua aliança, derrubaram os teus altares, e mataram os teus profetas à espada, e só eu fiquei; e buscam a minha vida para ma tirarem.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ηλιου ζηλῶν ἐζήλωκα τῷ κυρίῳ παντοκράτορι ὅτι ἐγκατέλιπον τὴν διαθήκην σου οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ τὰ θυσιαστήριά σου καθεῖλαν καὶ τοὺς προφήτας σου ἀπέκτειναν ἐν ῥομφαίᾳ καὶ ὑπολέλειμμαι ἐγὼ μονώτατος καὶ ζητοῦσι τὴν ψυχήν μου λαβεῖν αὐτήν

text_en: And the Lord said to him: Go, and return on your way, through the desert , to Damascus : and when you have come thither, you shall anoint Hazael to be king over Syria ;
text_la: Et ait Dominus ad eum : Vade, et revertere in viam tuam per desertum in Damascum : cumque perveneris illuc, unges Hazaël regem super Syriam,
text_pt: E o Senhor lhe disse: Vai, volta pelo teu caminho para o deserto de Damasco; e, chegando lá, unge a Hazael rei sobre a Síria.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς αὐτόν πορεύου ἀνάστρεφε εἰς τὴν ὁδόν σου καὶ ἥξεις εἰς τὴν ὁδὸν ἐρήμου Δαμασκοῦ καὶ χρίσεις τὸν Αζαηλ εἰς βασιλέα τῆς Συρίας

text_en: and you shall anoint Jehu , the son of Namsi, to be king over Israel : and Eliseus , the son of Saphat, of Abelmeula , you shall anoint to be prophet in your room.
text_la: et Jehu filium Namsi unges regem super Israël : Eliseum autem filium Saphat, qui est de Abelmehula, unges prophetam pro te.
text_pt: Também a Jeú, filho de Ninsi, ungirás rei de Israel; e também a Eliseu, filho de Safate de Abel-Meolá, ungirás profeta em teu lugar.
text_el: καὶ τὸν Ιου υἱὸν Ναμεσσι χρίσεις εἰς βασιλέα ἐπὶ Ισραηλ καὶ τὸν Ελισαιε υἱὸν Σαφατ ἀπὸ Αβελμαουλα χρίσεις εἰς προφήτην ἀντὶ σοῦ

text_en: And it shall come to pass, that whosoever shall escape the sword of Hazael, shall be slain by Jehu : and whosoever shall escape the sword of Jehu , shall be slain by Eliseus .
text_la: Et erit : quicumque fugerit gladium Hazaël, occidet eum Jehu : et quicumque fugerit gladium Jehu, interficiet eum Eliseus.
text_pt: E há de ser que o que escapar da espada de Hazael, matá-lo-á Jeú; e o que escapar da espada de Jeú, matá-lo-á Eliseu.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται τὸν σῳζόμενον ἐκ ῥομφαίας Αζαηλ θανατώσει Ιου καὶ τὸν σῳζόμενον ἐκ ῥομφαίας Ιου θανατώσει Ελισαιε

text_en: And I will leave me seven thousand men in Israel , whose knees have not been bowed before Baal , and every mouth that has not worshipped him, kissing the hands.
text_la: Et derelinquam mihi in Israël septem millia virorum, quorum genua non sunt incurvata ante Baal, et omne os quod non adoravit eum osculans manus.
text_pt: Também deixei ficar em Israel sete mil: todos os joelhos que não se dobraram a Baal, e toda a boca que não o beijou.
text_el: καὶ καταλείψεις ἐν Ισραηλ ἑπτὰ χιλιάδας ἀνδρῶν πάντα γόνατα ἃ οὐκ ὤκλασαν γόνυ τῷ Βααλ καὶ πᾶν στόμα ὃ οὐ προσεκύνησεν αὐτῷ

text_en: And Elias departing from thence, found Eliseus , the son of Saphat, ploughing with twelve yoke of oxen: and he was one of them that were ploughing with, twelve yoke of oxen: and when Elias came up to him, he cast his mantle upon him.
text_la: Profectus ergo inde Elias, reperit Eliseum filium Saphat, arantem in duodecim jugis boum. Et ipse in duodecim jugis boum arantibus unus erat : cumque venisset Elias ad eum, misit pallium suum super illum.
text_pt: Partiu, pois, Elias dali, e achou a Eliseu, filho de Safate, que andava lavrando com doze juntas de bois adiante dele, e ele estava com a duodécima; e Elias passou por ele, e lançou a sua capa sobre ele.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆλθεν ἐκεῖθεν καὶ εὑρίσκει τὸν Ελισαιε υἱὸν Σαφατ καὶ αὐτὸς ἠροτρία ἐν βουσίν δώδεκα ζεύγη βοῶν ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ καὶ αὐτὸς ἐν τοῖς δώδεκα καὶ ἐπῆλθεν ἐπ' αὐτὸν καὶ ἐπέρριψε τὴν μηλωτὴν αὐτοῦ ἐπ' αὐτόν

text_en: And he forthwith left the oxen, and run after Elias , and said: Let me, I pray you, kiss my father and my mother, and then I will follow you. And he said to him: Go, and return back: for that which was my part, I have done to you.
text_la: Qui statim relictis bobus cucurrit post Eliam, et ait : Osculer, oro, patrem meum, et matrem meam, et sic sequar te. Dixitque ei : Vade, et revertere : quod enim meum erat, feci tibi.
text_pt: Então deixou ele os bois, e correu após Elias; e disse: Deixa-me beijar a meu pai e a minha mãe, e então te seguirei. E ele lhe disse: Vai, e volta; pois, que te fiz eu?
text_el: καὶ κατέλιπεν Ελισαιε τὰς βόας καὶ κατέδραμεν ὀπίσω Ηλιου καὶ εἶπεν καταφιλήσω τὸν πατέρα μου καὶ ἀκολουθήσω ὀπίσω σου καὶ εἶπεν Ηλιου ἀνάστρεφε ὅτι πεποίηκά σοι

text_en: And returning back from him, he took a yoke of oxen, and killed them, and boiled the flesh with the plough of the oxen, and gave to the people, and they ate: and rising up, he went away, and followed Elias , and ministered to him.
text_la: Reversus autem ab eo, tulit par boum, et mactavit illud, et in aratro boum coxit carnes, et dedit populo, et comederunt : consurgensque abiit, et secutus est Eliam, et ministrabat ei.
text_pt: Voltou, pois, de o seguir, e tomou a junta de bois, e os matou, e com os aparelhos dos bois cozeu as carnes, e as deu ao povo, e comeram; então se levantou e seguiu a Elias, e o servia.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέστρεψεν ἐξόπισθεν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔλαβεν τὰ ζεύγη τῶν βοῶν καὶ ἔθυσεν καὶ ἥψησεν αὐτὰ ἐν τοῖς σκεύεσι τῶν βοῶν καὶ ἔδωκεν τῷ λαῷ καὶ ἔφαγον καὶ ἀνέστη καὶ ἐπορεύθη ὀπίσω Ηλιου καὶ ἐλειτούργει αὐτῷ

text_en: And Benadad, king of Syria , gathered together all his host, and there were two and thirty kings with him, and horses, and chariots: and going up, he fought against Samaria , and besieged it.
text_la: Porro Benadad rex Syriæ congregavit omnem exercitum suum, et triginta duos reges secum, et equos, et currus : et ascendens pugnabat contra Samariam, et obsidebat eam.
text_pt: E Ben-Hadade, rei da Síria, ajuntou todo o seu exército; e havia com ele trinta e dois reis, e cavalos e carros; e subiu, e cercou a Samaria, e pelejou contra ela.
text_el: καὶ συνήθροισεν υἱὸς Αδερ πᾶσαν τὴν δύναμιν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀνέβη καὶ περιεκάθισεν ἐπὶ Σαμάρειαν καὶ τριάκοντα καὶ δύο βασιλεῖς μετ' αὐτοῦ καὶ πᾶς ἵππος καὶ ἅρμα καὶ ἀνέβησαν καὶ περιεκάθισαν ἐπὶ Σαμάρειαν καὶ ἐπολέμησαν ἐπ' αὐτήν

text_en: And sending messengers to Achab , king of Israel , into the city,
text_la: Mittensque nuntios ad Achab regem Israël in civitatem,
text_pt: E enviou à cidade mensageiros, a Acabe, rei de Israel,
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν πρὸς Αχααβ βασιλέα Ισραηλ εἰς τὴν πόλιν

text_en: he said: Thus says Benadad: Your silver and your gold is mine: and your wives and your goodliest children are mine.
text_la: ait : Hæc dicit Benadad : Argentum tuum, et aurum tuum meum est : et uxores tuæ, et filii tui optimi, mei sunt.
text_pt: Que lhe disseram: Assim diz Ben-Hadade: A tua prata e o teu ouro são meus; e tuas mulheres e os melhores de teus filhos são meus.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτόν τάδε λέγει υἱὸς Αδερ τὸ ἀργύριόν σου καὶ τὸ χρυσίον σου ἐμόν ἐστιν καὶ αἱ γυναῖκές σου καὶ τὰ τέκνα σου ἐμά ἐστιν

text_en: And the king of Israel answered: According to your word, my lord, O king, I am yours, and all that I have.
text_la: Responditque rex Israël : Juxta verbum tuum, domine mi rex, tuus sum ego, et omnia mea.
text_pt: E respondeu o rei de Israel, e disse: Conforme a tua palavra, ó rei meu senhor, eu sou teu, e tudo quanto tenho.
text_el: καὶ ἀπεκρίθη ὁ βασιλεὺς Ισραηλ καὶ εἶπεν καθὼς ἐλάλησας κύριε βασιλεῦ σὸς ἐγώ εἰμι καὶ πάντα τὰ ἐμά

text_en: And the messengers came again, and said: Thus says Benadad, who sent us unto you: Your silver and your gold, and your wives and your children, you shall deliver up to me.
text_la: Revertentesque nuntii, dixerunt : Hæc dicit Benadad, qui misit nos ad te : Argentum tuum, et aurum tuum, et uxores tuas, et filios tuos, dabis mihi.
text_pt: E tornaram a vir os mensageiros, e disseram: Assim diz Ben-Hadade: Enviei-te, na verdade, mensageiros que dissessem: Tu me hás de dar a tua prata, e o teu ouro, e as tuas mulheres e os teus filhos;
text_el: καὶ ἀνέστρεψαν οἱ ἄγγελοι καὶ εἶπον τάδε λέγει υἱὸς Αδερ ἐγὼ ἀπέσταλκα πρὸς σὲ λέγων τὸ ἀργύριόν σου καὶ τὸ χρυσίον σου καὶ τὰς γυναῖκάς σου καὶ τὰ τέκνα σου δώσεις ἐμοί

text_en: Tomorrow, therefore, at this same hour, I will send my servants to you, and they shall search your house, and the houses of your servants: and all that pleases them, they shall put in their hands, and take away.
text_la: Cras igitur hac eadem hora mittam servos meos ad te, et scrutabuntur domum tuam, et domum servorum tuorum : et omne quod eis placuerit, ponent in manibus suis, et auferent.
text_pt: Todavia amanhã a estas horas enviarei os meus servos a ti, e esquadrinharão a tua casa, e as casas dos teus servos; e há de ser que tudo o que de precioso tiveres, eles tomarão consigo, e o levarão.
text_el: ὅτι ταύτην τὴν ὥραν αὔριον ἀποστελῶ τοὺς παῖδάς μου πρὸς σέ καὶ ἐρευνήσουσιν τὸν οἶκόν σου καὶ τοὺς οἴκους τῶν παίδων σου καὶ ἔσται τὰ ἐπιθυμήματα ὀφθαλμῶν αὐτῶν ἐφ' ἃ ἂν ἐπιβάλωσι τὰς χεῖρας αὐτῶν καὶ λήμψονται

text_en: And the king of Israel called all the ancients of the land, and said: Mark, and see that he lays snares for us. For he sent to me for my wives, and for my children, and for my silver and gold: and I said not nay.
text_la: Vocavit autem rex Israël omnes seniores terræ, et ait : Animadvertite, et videte quoniam insidietur nobis : misit enim ad me pro uxoribus meis, et filiis, et pro argento et auro : et non abnui.
text_pt: Então o rei de Israel chamou a todos os anciãos da terra, e disse: Notai agora, e vede como este homem procura o mal; pois mandou pedir-me as mulheres, os meus filhos, a minha prata e o meu ouro, e não lhos neguei.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάλεσεν ὁ βασιλεὺς Ισραηλ πάντας τοὺς πρεσβυτέρους καὶ εἶπεν γνῶτε δὴ καὶ ἴδετε ὅτι κακίαν οὗτος ζητεῖ ὅτι ἀπέσταλκεν πρός με περὶ τῶν γυναικῶν μου καὶ περὶ τῶν υἱῶν μου καὶ περὶ τῶν θυγατέρων μου τὸ ἀργύριόν μου καὶ τὸ χρυσίον μου οὐκ ἀπεκώλυσα ἀπ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: And all the ancients, and all the people said to him: Hearken not to him, nor consent to him.
text_la: Dixeruntque omnes majores natu, et universus populus, ad eum : Non audias, neque acquiescas illi.
text_pt: E todos os anciãos e todo o povo lhe disseram: Não lhe dês ouvidos, nem consintas.
text_el: καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ οἱ πρεσβύτεροι καὶ πᾶς ὁ λαός μὴ ἀκούσῃς καὶ μὴ θελήσῃς

text_en: Wherefore he answered the messengers of Benadad: Tell my lord, the king: All that you sent for to me, your servant at first, I will do: but this thing I cannot do.
text_la: Respondit itaque nuntiis Benadad : Dicite domino meo regi : Omnia propter quæ misisti ad me servum tuum in initio, faciam : hanc autem rem facere non possum.
text_pt: Por isso disse aos mensageiros de Ben-Hadade: Dizei ao rei, meu senhor: Tudo o que primeiro mandaste pedir a teu servo, farei, porém isto não posso fazer. E voltaram os mensageiros, e lhe levaram a resposta.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν τοῖς ἀγγέλοις υἱοῦ Αδερ λέγετε τῷ κυρίῳ ὑμῶν πάντα ὅσα ἀπέσταλκας πρὸς τὸν δοῦλόν σου ἐν πρώτοις ποιήσω τὸ δὲ ῥῆμα τοῦτο οὐ δυνήσομαι ποιῆσαι καὶ ἀπῆραν οἱ ἄνδρες καὶ ἐπέστρεψαν αὐτῷ λόγον

text_en: And the messengers returning brought him word. And he sent again, and said: Such and such things may the gods do to me, and more may they add, if the dust of Samaria shall suffice for handfuls for all the people that follow me.
text_la: Reversique nuntii retulerunt ei. Qui remisit, et ait : Hæc faciant mihi dii, et hæc addant, si suffecerit pulvis Samariæ pugillis omnis populi qui sequitur me.
text_pt: E Ben-Hadade enviou a ele mensageiros dizendo: Assim me façam os deuses, e outro tanto, que o pó de Samaria não bastará para encher as mãos de todo o povo que me segue.
text_el: καὶ ἀνταπέστειλεν πρὸς αὐτὸν υἱὸς Αδερ λέγων τάδε ποιήσαι μοι ὁ θεὸς καὶ τάδε προσθείη εἰ ἐκποιήσει ὁ χοῦς Σαμαρείας ταῖς ἀλώπεξιν παντὶ τῷ λαῷ τοῖς πεζοῖς μου

text_en: And the king of Israel answering, said: Tell him: Let not the girded boast himself as the ungirded.
text_la: Et respondens rex Israël, ait : Dicite ei : Ne glorietur, accinctus æque ut discinctus.
text_pt: Porém o rei de Israel respondeu: Dizei-lhe: Não se gabe quem se cinge das armas, como aquele que as descinge.
text_el: καὶ ἀπεκρίθη ὁ βασιλεὺς Ισραηλ καὶ εἶπεν ἱκανούσθω μὴ καυχάσθω ὁ κυρτὸς ὡς ὁ ὀρθός

text_en: And it came to pass, when Benadad heard this word, that he and the kings were drinking in pavilions, and he said to his servants: Beset the city. And they beset it.
text_la: Factum est autem cum audisset Benadad verbum istud, bibebat ipse et reges in umbraculis : et ait servis suis : Circumdate civitatem. Et circumdederunt eam.
text_pt: E sucedeu que, ouvindo ele esta palavra, estando a beber com os reis nas tendas, disse aos seus servos: Ponde-vos em ordem contra a cidade.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ὅτε ἀπεκρίθη αὐτῷ τὸν λόγον τοῦτον πίνων ἦν αὐτὸς καὶ πάντες οἱ βασιλεῖς μετ' αὐτοῦ ἐν σκηναῖς καὶ εἶπεν τοῖς παισὶν αὐτοῦ οἰκοδομήσατε χάρακα καὶ ἔθεντο χάρακα ἐπὶ τὴν πόλιν

text_en: And behold a prophet coming to Achab , king of Israel , said to him: Thus says the Lord : Have you seen all this exceeding great multitude? Behold I will deliver them into your hand this day: that you may know that I am the Lord .
text_la: Et ecce propheta unus accedens ad Achab regem Israël, ait ei : Hæc dicit Dominus : Certe vidisti omnem multitudinem hanc nimiam? ecce ego tradam eam in manu tua hodie, ut scias quia ego sum Dominus.
text_pt: E eis que um profeta se chegou a Acabe rei de Israel, e lhe disse: Assim diz o Senhor: Viste toda esta grande multidão? Eis que hoje ta entregarei nas tuas mãos, para que saibas que eu sou o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἰδοὺ προφήτης εἷς προσῆλθεν τῷ βασιλεῖ Ισραηλ καὶ εἶπεν τάδε λέγει κύριος εἰ ἑόρακας πάντα τὸν ὄχλον τὸν μέγαν τοῦτον ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ δίδωμι αὐτὸν σήμερον εἰς χεῖρας σάς καὶ γνώσῃ ὅτι ἐγὼ κύριος

text_en: And Achab said: By whom? And he said to him: Thus says the Lord : By the servants of the princes of the provinces. And he said: Who shall begin to fight? And he said: You.
text_la: Et ait Achab : Per quem? Dixitque ei : Hæc dicit Dominus : Per pedissequos principum provinciarum. Et ait : Quis incipiet præliari? Et ille dixit : Tu.
text_pt: E disse Acabe: Por quem? E ele disse: Assim diz o Senhor: Pelos moços dos príncipes das províncias. E disse: Quem começará a peleja? E disse: Tu.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Αχααβ ἐν τίνι καὶ εἶπεν τάδε λέγει κύριος ἐν τοῖς παιδαρίοις τῶν ἀρχόντων τῶν χωρῶν καὶ εἶπεν Αχααβ τίς συνάψει τὸν πόλεμον καὶ εἶπεν σύ

text_en: So he mustered the servants of the princes of the provinces, and he found the number of two hundred and thirty-two: and he mustered after them the people, all the children of Israel , seven thousand:
text_la: Recensuit ergo pueros principum provinciarum, et reperit numerum ducentorum triginta duorum : et recensuit post eos populum, omnes filios Israël, septem millia.
text_pt: Então contou os moços dos príncipes das províncias, e foram duzentos e trinta e dois; e depois deles contou a todo o povo, todos os filhos de Israel, sete mil.
text_el: καὶ ἐπεσκέψατο Αχααβ τὰ παιδάρια τῶν ἀρχόντων τῶν χωρῶν καὶ ἐγένοντο διακόσιοι καὶ τριάκοντα καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα ἐπεσκέψατο τὸν λαόν πᾶν υἱὸν δυνάμεως ἑξήκοντα χιλιάδας

text_en: And they went out at noon. But Benadad was drinking himself drunk in his pavilion, and the two and thirty kings with him, who had come to help him.
text_la: Et egressi sunt meridie. Benadad autem bibebat temulentus in umbraculo suo, et reges triginta duo cum eo, qui ad auxilium ejus venerant.
text_pt: E saíram ao meio-dia; e Ben-Hadade estava bebendo e embriagando-se nas tendas, ele e os reis, os trinta e dois reis, que o ajudavam.
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν μεσημβρίας καὶ υἱὸς Αδερ πίνων μεθύων ἐν Σοκχωθ αὐτὸς καὶ οἱ βασιλεῖς τριάκοντα καὶ δύο βασιλεῖς συμβοηθοὶ μετ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: And the servants of the princes of the provinces went out first. And Benadad sent. And they told him, saying: There are men come out of Samaria .
text_la: Egressi sunt autem pueri principum provinciarum in prima fronte. Misit itaque Benadad : qui nuntiaverunt ei, dicentes : Viri egressi sunt de Samaria.
text_pt: E os moços dos príncipes das províncias saíram primeiro; e Ben-Hadade enviou espias, que lhe deram avisos, dizendo: Saíram de Samaria uns homens.
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆλθον παιδάρια ἀρχόντων τῶν χωρῶν ἐν πρώτοις καὶ ἀποστέλλουσιν καὶ ἀπαγγέλλουσιν τῷ βασιλεῖ Συρίας λέγοντες ἄνδρες ἐξεληλύθασιν ἐκ Σαμαρείας

text_en: And he said: Whether they come for peace, take them alive: or whether they come to fight, take them alive.
text_la: Et ille ait : Sive pro pace veniunt, apprehendite eos vivos : sive ut prælientur, vivos eos capite.
text_pt: E ele disse: Ainda que para paz saíssem, tomai-os vivos; e ainda que à peleja saíssem, tomai-os vivos.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς εἰ εἰς εἰρήνην οὗτοι ἐκπορεύονται συλλάβετε αὐτοὺς ζῶντας καὶ εἰ εἰς πόλεμον ζῶντας συλλάβετε αὐτούς

text_en: So the servants of the princes of the provinces went out, and the rest of the army followed:
text_la: Egressi sunt ergo pueri principum provinciarum, ac reliquus exercitus sequebatur:
text_pt: Saíram, pois, da cidade os moços dos príncipes das províncias, e o exército que os seguia.
text_el: καὶ μὴ ἐξελθάτωσαν ἐκ τῆς πόλεως τὰ παιδάρια ἀρχόντων τῶν χωρῶν καὶ ἡ δύναμις ὀπίσω αὐτῶν

text_en: And every one slew the man that came against him: and the Syrians fled, and Israel pursued after them. And Benadad, king of Syria , fled away on horseback with his horsemen.
text_la: et percussit unusquisque virum qui contra se veniebat : fugeruntque Syri, et persecutus est eos Israël. Fugit quoque Benadad rex Syriæ in equo cum equitibus suis.
text_pt: E eles feriram cada um o seu adversário, e os sírios fugiram, e Israel os perseguiu; porém Ben-Hadade, rei da Síria, escapou a cavalo, com alguns cavaleiros.
text_el: ἐπάταξεν ἕκαστος τὸν παρ' αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐδευτέρωσεν ἕκαστος τὸν παρ' αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔφυγεν Συρία καὶ κατεδίωξεν αὐτοὺς Ισραηλ καὶ σῴζεται υἱὸς Αδερ βασιλεὺς Συρίας ἐφ' ἵππου ἱππέως

text_en: But the king of Israel going out overthrew the horses and chariots, and slew the Syrians with a great slaughter.
text_la: Necnon egressus rex Israël percussit equos et currus, et percussit Syriam plaga magna.
text_pt: E saiu o rei de Israel, e feriu os cavalos e os carros; e feriu os sírios com grande estrago.
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν βασιλεὺς Ισραηλ καὶ ἔλαβεν πάντας τοὺς ἵππους καὶ τὰ ἅρματα καὶ ἐπάταξεν πληγὴν μεγάλην ἐν Συρίᾳ

text_en: (And a prophet coming to the king of Israel , said to him: Go, and strengthen yourself, and know, and see what you do: for the next year the king of Syria will come up against you.)
text_la: Accedens autem propheta ad regem Israël, dixit ei : Vade, et confortare, et scito, et vide quid facias : sequenti enim anno rex Syriæ ascendet contra te.
text_pt: Então o profeta chegou-se ao rei de Israel e lhe disse: Vai, esforça-te, e atenta, e olha o que hás de fazer; porque no decurso de um ano o rei da Síria subirá contra ti.
text_el: καὶ προσῆλθεν ὁ προφήτης πρὸς βασιλέα Ισραηλ καὶ εἶπεν κραταιοῦ καὶ γνῶθι καὶ ἰδὲ τί ποιήσεις ὅτι ἐπιστρέφοντος τοῦ ἐνιαυτοῦ υἱὸς Αδερ βασιλεὺς Συρίας ἀναβαίνει ἐπὶ σέ

text_en: But the servants of the king of Syria said to him: Their gods are gods of the hills, therefore they have overcome us: but it is better that we should fight against them in the plains, and we shall overcome them.
text_la: Servi vero regis Syriæ dixerunt ei : Dii montium sunt dii eorum, ideo superaverunt nos : sed melius est ut pugnemus contra eos in campestribus, et obtinebimus eos.
text_pt: Porque os servos do rei da Síria lhe disseram: Seus deuses são deuses dos montes, por isso foram mais fortes do que nós; mas pelejemos com eles em campo raso, e por certo veremos, se não somos mais fortes do que eles!
text_el: καὶ οἱ παῖδες βασιλέως Συρίας εἶπον θεὸς ὀρέων θεὸς Ισραηλ καὶ οὐ θεὸς κοιλάδων διὰ τοῦτο ἐκραταίωσεν ὑπὲρ ἡμᾶς ἐὰν δὲ πολεμήσωμεν αὐτοὺς κατ' εὐθύ εἰ μὴ κραταιώσομεν ὑπὲρ αὐτούς

text_en: Do, therefore, this thing: Remove all the kings from your army, and put captains in their stead:
text_la: Tu ergo verbum hoc fac : amove reges singulos ab exercitu tuo, et pone principes pro eis:
text_pt: Faze, pois, isto: tira os reis, cada um do seu lugar, e substitui-os por capitães;
text_el: καὶ τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦτο ποίησον ἀπόστησον τοὺς βασιλεῖς ἕκαστον εἰς τὸν τόπον αὐτῶν καὶ θοῦ ἀντ' αὐτῶν σατράπας

text_en: And make up the number of soldiers that have been slain of yours, and horses, according to the former horses, and chariots, according to the chariots which you had before: and we will fight against them in the plains, and you shall see that we shall overcome them. He believed their counsel, and did so.
text_la: et instaura numerum militum qui ceciderunt de tuis, et equos secundum equos pristinos, et currus secundum currus quos ante habuisti : et pugnabimus contra eos in campestribus, et videbis quod obtinebimus eos. Credidit consilio eorum, et fecit ita.
text_pt: E forma outro exército, igual ao exército que perdeste, cavalo por cavalo, e carro por carro, e pelejemos com eles em campo raso, e veremos se não somos mais fortes do que eles! E deu ouvidos à sua voz, e assim fez.
text_el: καὶ ἀλλάξομέν σοι δύναμιν κατὰ τὴν δύναμιν τὴν πεσοῦσαν ἀπὸ σοῦ καὶ ἵππον κατὰ τὴν ἵππον καὶ ἅρματα κατὰ τὰ ἅρματα καὶ πολεμήσομεν πρὸς αὐτοὺς κατ' εὐθὺ καὶ κραταιώσομεν ὑπὲρ αὐτούς καὶ ἤκουσεν τῆς φωνῆς αὐτῶν καὶ ἐποίησεν οὕτως

text_en: Wherefore, at the return of the year, Benadad mustered the Syrians , and went up to Aphec, to fight against Israel .
text_la: Igitur postquam annus transierat, recensuit Benadad Syros, et ascendit in Aphec ut pugnaret contra Israël.
text_pt: E sucedeu que, passado um ano, Ben-Hadade passou revista aos sírios, e subiu a Afeque, para pelejar contra Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐπιστρέψαντος τοῦ ἐνιαυτοῦ καὶ ἐπεσκέψατο υἱὸς Αδερ τὴν Συρίαν καὶ ἀνέβη εἰς Αφεκα εἰς πόλεμον ἐπὶ Ισραηλ

text_en: And the children of Israel were mustered, and taking victuals, went out on the other side, and encamped over against them, like two little flocks of goats: but the Syrians filled the land.
text_la: Porro filii Israël recensiti sunt, et acceptis cibariis profecti ex adverso, castraque metati sunt contra eos, quasi duo parvi greges caprarum : Syri autem repleverunt terram.
text_pt: Também aos filhos de Israel se passou revista, e providos de víveres marcharam contra eles; e os filhos de Israel acamparam-se defronte deles, como dois pequenos rebanhos de cabras; mas os sírios enchiam a terra.
text_el: καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ ἐπεσκέπησαν καὶ παρεγένοντο εἰς ἀπαντὴν αὐτῶν καὶ παρενέβαλεν Ισραηλ ἐξ ἐναντίας αὐτῶν ὡσεὶ δύο ποίμνια αἰγῶν καὶ Συρία ἔπλησεν τὴν γῆν

text_en: (And a man of God coming, said to the king of Israel : Thus says the Lord : Because the Syrians have said: The Lord is God of the hills, but is not God of the valleys: I will deliver all this great multitude into your hand, and you shall know that I am the Lord .)
text_la: (Et accedens unus vir Dei, dixit ad regem Israël : Hæc dicit Dominus : Quia dixerunt Syri : Deus montium est Dominus, et non est Deus vallium : dabo omnem multitudinem hanc grandem in manu tua, et scietis quia ego sum Dominus.)
text_pt: E chegou o homem de Deus, e falou ao rei de Israel, e disse: Assim diz o Senhor: Porquanto os sírios disseram: O Senhor é Deus dos montes, e não Deus dos vales; toda esta grande multidão entregarei nas tuas mãos; para que saibas que eu sou o Senhor.
text_el: καὶ προσῆλθεν ὁ ἄνθρωπος τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ εἶπεν τῷ βασιλεῖ Ισραηλ τάδε λέγει κύριος ἀνθ' ὧν εἶπεν Συρία θεὸς ὀρέων κύριος ὁ θεὸς Ισραηλ καὶ οὐ θεὸς κοιλάδων αὐτός καὶ δώσω τὴν δύναμιν τὴν μεγάλην ταύτην εἰς χεῖρα σήν καὶ γνώσῃ ὅτι ἐγὼ κύριος

text_en: And both sides set their armies in array one against the other seven days, and on the seventh day the battle was fought: and the children of Israel slew, of the Syrians , a hundred thousand footmen in one day.
text_la: Dirigebantque septem diebus ex adverso hi atque illi acies, septima autem die commissum est bellum : percusseruntque filii Israël de Syris centum millia peditum in die una.
text_pt: E sete dias estiveram acampados uns defronte dos outros; e sucedeu ao sétimo dia que a peleja começou, e os filhos de Israel feriram dos sírios cem mil homens de pé, num dia.
text_el: καὶ παρεμβάλλουσιν οὗτοι ἀπέναντι τούτων ἑπτὰ ἡμέρας καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ἑβδόμῃ καὶ προσήγαγεν ὁ πόλεμος καὶ ἐπάταξεν Ισραηλ τὴν Συρίαν ἑκατὸν χιλιάδας πεζῶν μιᾷ ἡμέρᾳ

text_en: And they that remained fled to Aphec, into the city: and the wall fell upon seven and twenty thousand men , that were left. And Benadad fleeing, went into the city, into a chamber that was within a chamber.
text_la: Fugerunt autem qui remanserant in Aphec, in civitatem : et cecidit murus super viginti septem millia hominum qui remanserant. Porro Benadad fugiens ingressus est civitatem, in cubiculum quod erat intra cubiculum.
text_pt: E os restantes fugiram a Afeque, à cidade; e caiu o muro sobre vinte e sete mil homens, que restaram; Ben-Hadade, porém, fugiu, e veio à cidade, escondendo-se de câmara em câmara.
text_el: καὶ ἔφυγον οἱ κατάλοιποι εἰς Αφεκα εἰς τὴν πόλιν καὶ ἔπεσεν τὸ τεῖχος ἐπὶ εἴκοσι καὶ ἑπτὰ χιλιάδας ἀνδρῶν τῶν καταλοίπων καὶ υἱὸς Αδερ ἔφυγεν καὶ εἰσῆλθεν εἰς τὸν οἶκον τοῦ κοιτῶνος εἰς τὸ ταμίειον

text_en: And his servants said to him: Behold, we have heard that the kings of the house of Israel are merciful; so let us put sackcloths on our loins, and ropes on our heads, and go out to the king of Israel : perhaps he will save our lives.
text_la: Dixeruntque ei servi sui : Ecce, audivimus quod reges domus Israël clementes sint : ponamus itaque saccos in lumbis nostris, et funiculos in capitibus nostris, et egrediamur ad regem Israël : forsitan salvabit animas nostras.
text_pt: Então lhe disseram os seus servos: Eis que já temos ouvido que os reis da casa de Israel são reis clementes; ponhamos, pois, sacos aos lombos, e cordas às cabeças, e saiamos ao rei de Israel; pode ser que ele te poupe a vida.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν τοῖς παισὶν αὐτοῦ οἶδα ὅτι βασιλεῖς Ισραηλ βασιλεῖς ἐλέους εἰσίν ἐπιθώμεθα δὴ σάκκους ἐπὶ τὰς ὀσφύας ἡμῶν καὶ σχοινία ἐπὶ τὰς κεφαλὰς ἡμῶν καὶ ἐξέλθωμεν πρὸς βασιλέα Ισραηλ εἴ πως ζωογονήσει τὰς ψυχὰς ἡμῶν

text_en: So they girded sackcloths on their loins, and put ropes on their heads, and came to the king of Israel , and said to him: Your servant, Benadad, says: I beseech you let me have my life. And he said: If he be yet alive, he is my brother.
text_la: Accinxerunt saccis lumbos suos, et posuerunt funiculos in capitibus suis, veneruntque ad regem Israël, et dixerunt ei : Servus tuus Benadad dicit : Vivat, oro te, anima mea. Et ille ait : Si adhuc vivit, frater meus est.
text_pt: Então cingiram sacos aos lombos e cordas às cabeças, e foram ao rei de Israel, e disseram: Diz o teu servo Ben-Hadade: Deixa-me viver. E disse Acabe: Pois ainda vive? É meu irmão.
text_el: καὶ περιεζώσαντο σάκκους ἐπὶ τὰς ὀσφύας αὐτῶν καὶ ἔθεσαν σχοινία ἐπὶ τὰς κεφαλὰς αὐτῶν καὶ εἶπον τῷ βασιλεῖ Ισραηλ δοῦλός σου υἱὸς Αδερ λέγει ζησάτω δὴ ἡ ψυχή μου καὶ εἶπεν εἰ ἔτι ζῇ ἀδελφός μού ἐστιν

text_en: The men took this for good luck: and in haste caught the word out of his mouth, and said: Your brother Benadad. And he said to them: Go, and bring him to me. Then Benadad came out to him, and he lifted him up into his chariot.
text_la: Quod acceperunt viri pro omine : et festinantes rapuerunt verbum ex ore ejus, atque dixerunt : Frater tuus Benadad. Et dixit eis : Ite, et adducite eum ad me. Egressus est ergo ad eum Benadad, et levavit eum in currum suum.
text_pt: E aqueles homens tomaram isto por bom presságio, e apressaram-se em apanhar a sua palavra, e disseram: Teu irmão Ben-Hadade vive. E ele disse: Vinde, trazei-mo. Então Ben-Hadade foi a ele, e ele o fez subir ao carro.
text_el: καὶ οἱ ἄνδρες οἰωνίσαντο καὶ ἔσπευσαν καὶ ἀνέλεξαν τὸν λόγον ἐκ τοῦ στόματος αὐτοῦ καὶ εἶπον ἀδελφός σου υἱὸς Αδερ καὶ εἶπεν εἰσέλθατε καὶ λάβετε αὐτόν καὶ ἐξῆλθεν πρὸς αὐτὸν υἱὸς Αδερ καὶ ἀναβιβάζουσιν αὐτὸν πρὸς αὐτὸν ἐπὶ τὸ ἅρμα

text_en: And he said to him: The cities which my father took from your father, I will restore: and make you streets in Damascus , as my father made in Samaria and having made a league, I will depart from you. So he made a league with him, and let him go.
text_la: Qui dixit ei : Civitates quas tulit pater meus a patre tuo, reddam : et plateas fac tibi in Damasco, sicut fecit pater meus in Samaria, et ego fœderatus recedam a te. Pepigit ergo fœdus, et dimisit eum.
text_pt: E disse ele: As cidades que meu pai tomou de teu pai tas restituirei, e faze para ti ruas em Damasco, como meu pai as fez em Samaria. E eu, respondeu Acabe, te deixarei ir com esta aliança. E fez com ele aliança e o deixou ir.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτόν τὰς πόλεις ἃς ἔλαβεν ὁ πατήρ μου παρὰ τοῦ πατρός σου ἀποδώσω σοι καὶ ἐξόδους θήσεις σαυτῷ ἐν Δαμασκῷ καθὼς ἔθετο ὁ πατήρ μου ἐν Σαμαρείᾳ καὶ ἐγὼ ἐν διαθήκῃ ἐξαποστελῶ σε καὶ διέθετο αὐτῷ διαθήκην καὶ ἐξαπέστειλεν αὐτόν

text_en: Then a certain man of the sons of the prophets , said to his companion, in the word of the Lord : Strike me. But he would not strike.
text_la: Tunc vir quidam de filiis prophetarum dixit ad socium suum in sermone Domini : Percute me. At ille noluit percutere.
text_pt: Então um dos homens dos filhos dos profetas disse ao seu companheiro, pela palavra do Senhor: Ora fere-me. E o homem recusou feri-lo.
text_el: καὶ ἄνθρωπος εἷς ἐκ τῶν υἱῶν τῶν προφητῶν εἶπεν πρὸς τὸν πλησίον αὐτοῦ ἐν λόγῳ κυρίου πάταξον δή με καὶ οὐκ ἠθέλησεν ὁ ἄνθρωπος πατάξαι αὐτόν

text_en: Then he said to him: Because you would not hearken to the word of the Lord , behold you shall depart from me, and a lion shall slay you. And when he had gone a little from him, a lion found him, and slew him.
text_la: Cui ait : Quia noluisti audire vocem Domini, ecce recedes a me, et percutiet te leo. Cumque paululum recessisset ab eo, invenit eum leo, atque percussit.
text_pt: E ele lhe disse: Porque não obedeceste à voz do Senhor, eis que, em te apartando de mim, um leão te ferirá. E como dele se apartou, um leão o encontrou e o feriu.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτόν ἀνθ' ὧν οὐκ ἤκουσας τῆς φωνῆς κυρίου ἰδοὺ σὺ ἀποτρέχεις ἀπ' ἐμοῦ καὶ πατάξει σε λέων καὶ ἀπῆλθεν ἀπ' αὐτοῦ καὶ εὑρίσκει αὐτὸν λέων καὶ ἐπάταξεν αὐτόν

text_en: Then he found another man , and said to him: Strike me. And he struck him and wounded him.
text_la: Sed et alterum inveniens virum, dixit ad eum : Percute me. Qui percussit eum, et vulneravit.
text_pt: Depois encontrou outro homem, e disse-lhe: Ora fere-me. E aquele homem deu-lhe um golpe, ferindo-o.
text_el: καὶ εὑρίσκει ἄνθρωπον ἄλλον καὶ εἶπεν πάταξόν με δή καὶ ἐπάταξεν αὐτὸν ὁ ἄνθρωπος πατάξας καὶ συνέτριψεν

text_en: So the prophet went, and met the king in the way, and disguised himself by sprinkling dust on his face and his eyes.
text_la: Abiit ergo propheta, et occurrit regi in via, et mutavit aspersione pulveris os et oculos suos.
text_pt: Então foi o profeta, e pôs-se perante o rei no caminho; e disfarçou-se com cinza sobre os seus olhos.
text_el: καὶ ἐπορεύθη ὁ προφήτης καὶ ἔστη τῷ βασιλεῖ Ισραηλ ἐπὶ τῆς ὁδοῦ καὶ κατεδήσατο τελαμῶνι τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτοῦ

text_en: And as the king passed by, he cried to the king, and said: Your servant went out to fight hand to hand: and when a certain man was run away, one brought him to me, and said: Keep this man : and if he shall slip away, your life shall be for his life, or you shall pay a talent of silver.
text_la: Cumque rex transisset, clamavit ad regem, et ait : Servus tuus egressus est ad præliandum cominus : cumque fugisset vir unus, adduxit eum quidam ad me, et ait : Custodi virum istum : qui si lapsus fuerit, erit anima tua pro anima ejus, aut talentum argenti appendes.
text_pt: E sucedeu que, passando o rei, clamou ele ao rei, dizendo: Teu servo estava no meio da peleja, e eis que, desviando-se um homem, trouxe-me outro homem, e disse: Guarda-me este homem; se vier a faltar, será a tua vida em lugar da vida dele, ou pagarás um talento de prata.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς ὁ βασιλεὺς παρεπορεύετο καὶ οὗτος ἐβόα πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα καὶ εἶπεν ὁ δοῦλός σου ἐξῆλθεν ἐπὶ τὴν στρατιὰν τοῦ πολέμου καὶ ἰδοὺ ἀνὴρ εἰσήγαγεν πρός με ἄνδρα καὶ εἶπεν πρός με φύλαξον τοῦτον τὸν ἄνδρα ἐὰν δὲ ἐκπηδῶν ἐκπηδήσῃ καὶ ἔσται ἡ ψυχή σου ἀντὶ τῆς ψυχῆς αὐτοῦ ἢ τάλαντον ἀργυρίου στήσεις

text_en: And whilst I, in the hurry, turned this way and that, on a sudden he was not to be seen. And the king of Israel said to him: This is your judgment, which yourself have decreed.
text_la: Dum autem ego turbatus huc illucque me verterem, subito non comparuit. Et ait rex Israël ad eum : Hoc est judicium tuum, quod ipse decrevisti.
text_pt: Sucedeu, pois, que, estando o teu servo ocupado de uma e de outra parte, eis que o homem desapareceu. Então o rei de Israel lhe disse: Esta é a tua sentença; tu mesmo a pronunciaste.
text_el: καὶ ἐγενήθη περιεβλέψατο ὁ δοῦλός σου ὧδε καὶ ὧδε καὶ οὗτος οὐκ ἦν καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτὸν ὁ βασιλεὺς Ισραηλ ἰδοὺ καὶ τὰ ἔνεδρα παρ' ἐμοὶ ἐφόνευσας

text_en: But he forthwith wiped off the dust from his face, and the king of Israel knew him, that he was one of the prophets .
text_la: At ille statim abstersit pulverem de facie sua, et cognovit eum rex Israël, quod esset de prophetis.
text_pt: Então ele se apressou, e tirou a cinza de sobre os seus olhos; e o rei de Israel o reconheceu, que era um dos profetas.
text_el: καὶ ἔσπευσεν καὶ ἀφεῖλεν τὸν τελαμῶνα ἀπὸ τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπέγνω αὐτὸν ὁ βασιλεὺς Ισραηλ ὅτι ἐκ τῶν προφητῶν οὗτος

text_en: And he said to him: Thus says the Lord . Because you have let go out of your hand a man worthy of death, your life shall be for his life, and your people for his people.
text_la: Qui ait ad eum : Hæc dicit Dominus : Quia dimisisti virum dignum morte de manu tua, erit anima tua pro anima ejus, et populus tuus pro populo ejus.
text_pt: E disse-lhe: Assim diz o Senhor: Porquanto soltaste da mão o homem que eu havia posto para destruição, a tua vida será em lugar da sua vida, e o teu povo em lugar do seu povo.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτόν τάδε λέγει κύριος διότι ἐξήνεγκας σὺ ἄνδρα ὀλέθριον ἐκ χειρός σου καὶ ἔσται ἡ ψυχή σου ἀντὶ τῆς ψυχῆς αὐτοῦ καὶ ὁ λαός σου ἀντὶ τοῦ λαοῦ αὐτοῦ

text_en: And the king of Israel returned to his house, slighting to hear, and raging came into Samaria .
text_la: Reversus est igitur rex Israël in domum suam, audire contemnens, et furibundus venit in Samariam.
text_pt: E foi o rei de Israel para a sua casa, desgostoso e indignado; e chegou a Samaria.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆλθεν ὁ βασιλεὺς Ισραηλ συγκεχυμένος καὶ ἐκλελυμένος καὶ ἔρχεται εἰς Σαμάρειαν

text_en: And after these things, Naboth the Jezrahelite, who was in Jezrahel, had at that time a vineyard, near the palace of Achab , king of Samaria .
text_la: Post verba autem hæc, tempore illo vinea erat Naboth Jezrahelitæ, quæ erat in Jezrahel, juxta palatium Achab regis Samariæ.
text_pt: E sucedeu depois destas coisas que, Nabote, o jizreelita, tinha uma vinha em Jizreel junto ao palácio de Acabe, rei de Samaria.
text_el: καὶ ἀμπελὼν εἷς ἦν τῷ Ναβουθαι τῷ Ιεζραηλίτῃ παρὰ τῷ ἅλῳ Αχααβ βασιλέως Σαμαρείας

text_en: And Achab spoke to Naboth, saying: Give me your vineyard, that I may make me a garden of herbs, because it is near, and adjoining to my house; and I will give you for it a better vineyard: or if you think it more convenient for you, I will give you the worth of it in money.
text_la: Locutus est ergo Achab ad Naboth, dicens : Da mihi vineam tuam, ut faciam mihi hortum olerum, quia vicina est, et prope domum meam : daboque tibi pro ea vineam meliorem, aut si commodius tibi putas, argenti pretium, quanto digna est.
text_pt: Então Acabe falou a Nabote, dizendo: Dá-me a tua vinha, para que me sirva de horta, pois está vizinha ao lado da minha casa; e te darei por ela outra vinha melhor: ou, se for do teu agrado, dar-te-ei o seu valor em dinheiro.
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν Αχααβ πρὸς Ναβουθαι λέγων δός μοι τὸν ἀμπελῶνά σου καὶ ἔσται μοι εἰς κῆπον λαχάνων ὅτι ἐγγίων οὗτος τῷ οἴκῳ μου καὶ δώσω σοι ἀμπελῶνα ἄλλον ἀγαθὸν ὑπὲρ αὐτόν εἰ δὲ ἀρέσκει ἐνώπιόν σου δώσω σοι ἀργύριον ἀντάλλαγμα τοῦ ἀμπελῶνός σου τούτου καὶ ἔσται μοι εἰς κῆπον λαχάνων

text_en: Naboth answered him: The Lord be merciful to me, and not let me give you the inheritance of my fathers.
text_la: Cui respondit Naboth : Propitius sit mihi Dominus, ne dem hæreditatem patrum meorum tibi.
text_pt: Porém Nabote disse a Acabe: Guarde-me o Senhor de que eu te dê a herança de meus pais.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ναβουθαι πρὸς Αχααβ μή μοι γένοιτο παρὰ θεοῦ μου δοῦναι κληρονομίαν πατέρων μου σοί

text_en: And Achab came into his house angry and fretting, because of the word that Naboth, the Jezrahelite, had spoken to him, saying: I will not give you the inheritance of my fathers. And casting himself upon his bed, he turned away his face to the wall, and would eat no bread.
text_la: Venit ergo Achab in domum suam indignans, et frendens super verbo quod locutus fuerat ad eum Naboth Jezrahelites, dicens : Non dabo tibi hæreditatem patrum meorum. Et projiciens se in lectulum suum, avertit faciem suam ad parietem, et non comedit panem.
text_pt: Então Acabe veio desgostoso e indignado à sua casa, por causa da palavra que Nabote, o jizreelita, lhe falara, quando disse: Não te darei a herança de meus pais. E deitou-se na sua cama, e voltou o rosto, e não comeu pão.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο τὸ πνεῦμα Αχααβ τεταραγμένον καὶ ἐκοιμήθη ἐπὶ τῆς κλίνης αὐτοῦ καὶ συνεκάλυψεν τὸ πρώσωπον αὐτοῦ καὶ οὐκ ἔφαγεν ἄρτον

text_en: And Jezabel , his wife, went in to him, and said to him: What is the matter that your soul is so grieved? And why do you eat no bread?
text_la: Ingressa est autem ad eum Jezabel uxor sua, dixitque ei : Quid est hoc, unde anima tua contristata est? et quare non comedis panem?
text_pt: Porém, vindo a ele Jezabel, sua mulher, lhe disse: Que há, que está tão desgostoso o teu espírito, e não comes pão?
text_el: καὶ εἰσῆλθεν Ιεζαβελ ἡ γυνὴ αὐτοῦ πρὸς αὐτὸν καὶ ἐλάλησεν πρὸς αὐτόν τί τὸ πνεῦμά σου τεταραγμένον καὶ οὐκ εἶ σὺ ἐσθίων ἄρτον

text_en: And he answered her: I spoke to Naboth, the Jezrahelite, and said to him: Give me your vineyard, and take money for it: or if it please you, I will give you a better vineyard for it. And he said: I will not give you my vineyard.
text_la: Qui respondit ei : Locutus sum Naboth Jezrahelitæ, et dixi ei : Da mihi vineam tuam, accepta pecunia : aut, si tibi placet, dabo tibi vineam meliorem pro ea. Et ille ait : Non dabo tibi vineam meam.
text_pt: E ele lhe disse: Porque falei a Nabote, o jizreelita, e lhe disse: Dá-me a tua vinha por dinheiro; ou, se te apraz, te darei outra vinha em seu lugar. Porém ele disse: Não te darei a minha vinha.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτήν ὅτι ἐλάλησα πρὸς Ναβουθαι τὸν Ιεζραηλίτην λέγων δός μοι τὸν ἀμπελῶνά σου ἀργυρίου εἰ δὲ βούλει δώσω σοι ἀμπελῶνα ἄλλον ἀντ' αὐτοῦ καὶ εἶπεν οὐ δώσω σοι κληρονομίαν πατέρων μου

text_en: Then Jezabel , his wife, said to him. You are of great authority indeed, and govern well the kingdom of Israel . Arise, and eat bread, and be of good cheer; I will give you the vineyard of Naboth, the Jezrahelite.
text_la: Dixit ergo ad eum Jezabel uxor ejus : Grandis auctoritatis es, et bene regis regnum Israël. Surge, et comede panem, et æquo animo esto : ego dabo tibi vineam Naboth Jezrahelitæ.
text_pt: Então Jezabel, sua mulher lhe disse: Governas tu agora no reino de Israel? Levanta-te, come pão, e alegre-se o teu coração; eu te darei a vinha de Nabote, o jizreelita.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτὸν Ιεζαβελ ἡ γυνὴ αὐτοῦ σὺ νῦν οὕτως ποιεῖς βασιλέα ἐπὶ Ισραηλ ἀνάστηθι φάγε ἄρτον καὶ σαυτοῦ γενοῦ ἐγὼ δώσω σοι τὸν ἀμπελῶνα Ναβουθαι τοῦ Ιεζραηλίτου

text_en: So she wrote letters in Achab's name , and sealed them with his ring, and sent them to the ancients, and the chief men that were in his city, and that dwelt with Naboth.
text_la: Scripsit itaque litteras ex nomine Achab, et signavit eas annulo ejus, et misit ad majores natu, et optimates, qui erant in civitate ejus, et habitabant cum Naboth.
text_pt: Então escreveu cartas em nome de Acabe, e as selou com o seu sinete; e mandou as cartas aos anciãos e aos nobres que havia na sua cidade e habitavam com Nabote.
text_el: καὶ ἔγραψεν βιβλίον ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματι Αχααβ καὶ ἐσφραγίσατο τῇ σφραγῖδι αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀπέστειλεν τὸ βιβλίον πρὸς τοὺς πρεσβυτέρους καὶ τοὺς ἐλευθέρους τοὺς κατοικοῦντας μετὰ Ναβουθαι

text_en: And this was the tenor of the letters : Proclaim a fast , and make Naboth sit among the chief of the people;
text_la: Litterarum autem hæc erat sententia : Prædicate jejunium, et sedere facite Naboth inter primos populi:
text_pt: E escreveu nas cartas, dizendo: Apregoai um jejum, e ponde Nabote diante do povo.
text_el: καὶ ἐγέγραπτο ἐν τοῖς βιβλίοις λέγων νηστεύσατε νηστείαν καὶ καθίσατε τὸν Ναβουθαι ἐν ἀρχῇ τοῦ λαοῦ

text_en: and suborn two men , sons of Belial , against him and let them bear false witness; that he has blasphemed God and the king: and then carry him out, and stone him, and so let him die.
text_la: et submittite duos viros filios Belial contra eum, et falsum testimonium dicant : Benedixit Deum et regem : et educite eum, et lapidate, sicque moriatur.
text_pt: E ponde defronte dele dois filhos de Belial, que testemunhem contra ele, dizendo: Blasfemaste contra Deus e contra o rei; e trazei-o fora, e apedrejai-o para que morra.
text_el: καὶ ἐγκαθίσατε δύο ἄνδρας υἱοὺς παρανόμων ἐξ ἐναντίας αὐτοῦ καὶ καταμαρτυρησάτωσαν αὐτοῦ λέγοντες ηὐλόγησεν θεὸν καὶ βασιλέα καὶ ἐξαγαγέτωσαν αὐτὸν καὶ λιθοβολησάτωσαν αὐτόν καὶ ἀποθανέτω

text_en: And the men of his city, the ancients and nobles, that dwelt with him in the city, did as Jezabel had commanded them, and as it was written in the letters which she had sent to them;
text_la: Fecerunt ergo cives ejus majores natu et optimates, qui habitabant cum eo in urbe, sicut præceperat eis Jezabel, et sicut scriptum erat in litteris quas miserat ad eos:
text_pt: E os homens da sua cidade, os anciãos e os nobres que habitavam na sua cidade, fizeram como Jezabel lhes ordenara, conforme estava escrito nas cartas que lhes mandara.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησαν οἱ ἄνδρες τῆς πόλεως αὐτοῦ οἱ πρεσβύτεροι καὶ οἱ ἐλεύθεροι οἱ κατοικοῦντες ἐν τῇ πόλει αὐτοῦ καθὰ ἀπέστειλεν πρὸς αὐτοὺς Ιεζαβελ καθὰ γέγραπται ἐν τοῖς βιβλίοις οἷς ἀπέστειλεν πρὸς αὐτούς

text_en: they proclaimed a fast , and made Naboth sit among the chief of the people.
text_la: prædicaverunt jejunium, et sedere fecerunt Naboth inter primos populi.
text_pt: Apregoaram um jejum, e puseram a Nabote diante do povo.
text_el: ἐκάλεσαν νηστείαν καὶ ἐκάθισαν τὸν Ναβουθαι ἐν ἀρχῇ τοῦ λαοῦ

text_en: And bringing two men , sons of the devil , they made them sit against him: and they, like men of the devil , bore witness against him before the people: saying: Naboth has blasphemed God and the king. Wherefore they brought him forth without the city, and stoned him to death .
text_la: Et adductis duobus viris filiis diaboli, fecerunt eos sedere contra eum : at illi, scilicet ut viri diabolici, dixerunt contra eum testimonium coram multitudine : Benedixit Naboth Deum et regem : quam ob rem eduxerunt eum extra civitatem, et lapidibus interfecerunt.
text_pt: Então vieram dois homens, filhos de Belial, e puseram-se defronte dele; e os homens, filhos de Belial, testemunharam contra ele, contra Nabote, perante o povo, dizendo: Nabote blasfemou contra Deus e contra o rei. E o levaram para fora da cidade, e o apedrejaram, e morreu.
text_el: καὶ ἦλθον δύο ἄνδρες υἱοὶ παρανόμων καὶ ἐκάθισαν ἐξ ἐναντίας αὐτοῦ καὶ κατεμαρτύρησαν αὐτοῦ λέγοντες ηὐλόγηκας θεὸν καὶ βασιλέα καὶ ἐξήγαγον αὐτὸν ἔξω τῆς πόλεως καὶ ἐλιθοβόλησαν αὐτὸν λίθοις καὶ ἀπέθανεν

text_en: And they sent to Jezabel , saying: Naboth is stoned , and is dead.
text_la: Miseruntque ad Jezabel, dicentes : Lapidatus est Naboth, et mortuus est.
text_pt: Então mandaram dizer a Jezabel: Nabote foi apedrejado, e morreu.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλαν πρὸς Ιεζαβελ λέγοντες λελιθοβόληται Ναβουθαι καὶ τέθνηκεν

text_en: And it came to pass, when Jezabel heard that Naboth was stoned , and dead, that she said to Achab : Arise, and take possession of the vineyard of Naboth, the Jezrahelite, who would not agree with you, and give it you for money: for Naboth is not alive, but dead.
text_la: Factum est autem, cum audisset Jezabel lapidatum Naboth et mortuum, locuta est ad Achab : Surge, et posside vineam Naboth Jezrahelitæ, qui noluit tibi acquiescere, et dare eam accepta pecunia : non enim vivit Naboth, sed mortuus est.
text_pt: E sucedeu que, ouvindo Jezabel que já fora apedrejado Nabote, e morrera, disse a Acabe: Levanta-te, e possui a vinha de Nabote, o jizreelita, a qual te recusou dar por dinheiro; porque Nabote não vive, mas é morto.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς ἤκουσεν Ιεζαβελ καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς Αχααβ ἀνάστα κληρονόμει τὸν ἀμπελῶνα Ναβουθαι τοῦ Ιεζραηλίτου ὃς οὐκ ἔδωκέν σοι ἀργυρίου ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν Ναβουθαι ζῶν ὅτι τέθνηκεν

text_en: And when Achab heard this, to wit, that Naboth was dead, he arose, and went down into the vineyard of Naboth, the Jezrahelite, to take possession of it.
text_la: Quod cum audisset Achab, mortuum videlicet Naboth, surrexit, et descendebat in vineam Naboth Jezrahelitæ, ut possideret eam.
text_pt: E sucedeu que, ouvindo Acabe, que Nabote já era morto, levantou-se para descer para a vinha de Nabote, o jizreelita, para tomar posse dela.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς ἤκουσεν Αχααβ ὅτι τέθνηκεν Ναβουθαι ὁ Ιεζραηλίτης καὶ διέρρηξεν τὰ ἱμάτια ἑαυτοῦ καὶ περιεβάλετο σάκκον καὶ ἐγένετο μετὰ ταῦτα καὶ ἀνέστη καὶ κατέβη Αχααβ εἰς τὸν ἀμπελῶνα Ναβουθαι τοῦ Ιεζραηλίτου κληρονομῆσαι αὐτόν

text_en: And the word of the Lord came to Elias , the Thesbite, saying:
text_la: Factum est igitur sermo Domini ad Eliam Thesbiten, dicens:
text_pt: Então veio a palavra do Senhor a Elias, o tisbita, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς Ηλιου τὸν Θεσβίτην λέγων

text_en: Arise, and go down to meet Achab , king of Israel , who is in Samaria : behold he is going down to the vineyard of Naboth, to take possession of it:
text_la: Surge, et descende in occursum Achab regis Israël, qui est in Samaria : ecce ad vineam Naboth descendit, ut possideat eam.
text_pt: Levanta-te, desce para encontrar-te com Acabe, rei de Israel, que está em Samaria; eis que está na vinha de Nabote, aonde tem descido para possuí-la.
text_el: ἀνάστηθι καὶ κατάβηθι εἰς ἀπαντὴν Αχααβ βασιλέως Ισραηλ τοῦ ἐν Σαμαρείᾳ ἰδοὺ οὗτος ἐν ἀμπελῶνι Ναβουθαι ὅτι καταβέβηκεν ἐκεῖ κληρονομῆσαι αὐτόν

text_en: And you shall speak to him, saying: Thus says the Lord : You have slain: moreover also you have taken possession. And after these words you shall add: Thus says the Lord : In this place, wherein the dogs have licked the blood of Naboth, they shall lick your blood also.
text_la: Et loqueris ad eum, dicens : Hæc dicit Dominus : Occidisti, insuper et possedisti. Et post hæc addes : Hæc dicit Dominus : In loco hoc, in quo linxerunt canes sanguinem Naboth, lambent quoque sanguinem tuum.
text_pt: E falar-lhe-ás, dizendo: Assim diz o Senhor: Porventura não mataste e tomaste a herança? Falar-lhe-ás mais, dizendo: Assim diz o Senhor: No lugar em que os cães lamberam o sangue de Nabote lamberão também o teu próprio sangue.
text_el: καὶ λαλήσεις πρὸς αὐτὸν λέγων τάδε λέγει κύριος ὡς σὺ ἐφόνευσας καὶ ἐκληρονόμησας διὰ τοῦτο τάδε λέγει κύριος ἐν παντὶ τόπῳ ᾧ ἔλειξαν αἱ ὕες καὶ οἱ κύνες τὸ αἷμα Ναβουθαι ἐκεῖ λείξουσιν οἱ κύνες τὸ αἷμά σου καὶ αἱ πόρναι λούσονται ἐν τῷ αἵματί σου

text_en: And Achab said to Elias : Have you found me your enemy? He said: I have found you because you are sold, to do evil in the sight of the Lord .
text_la: Et ait Achab ad Eliam : Num invenisti me inimicum tibi? Qui dixit : Inveni, eo quod venundatus sis, ut faceres malum in conspectu Domini.
text_pt: E disse Acabe a Elias: Já me achaste, inimigo meu? E ele disse: Achei-te; porquanto já te vendeste para fazeres o que é mau aos olhos do Senhor.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Αχααβ πρὸς Ηλιου εἰ εὕρηκάς με ὁ ἐχθρός μου καὶ εἶπεν εὕρηκα διότι μάτην πέπρασαι ποιῆσαι τὸ πονηρὸν ἐνώπιον κυρίου παροργίσαι αὐτόν

text_en: Behold I will bring evil upon you, and I will cut down your posterity, and I will kill of Achab him that pisses against the wall, and him that is shut up, and the last in Israel .
text_la: Ecce ego inducam super te malum, et demetam posteriora tua, et interficiam de Achab mingentem ad parietem, et clausum et ultimum in Israël.
text_pt: Eis que trarei mal sobre ti, e arrancarei a tua posteridade, e arrancarei de Acabe a todo o homem, tanto o escravo como o livre em Israel;
text_el: τάδε λέγει κύριος ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἐπάγω ἐπὶ σὲ κακὰ καὶ ἐκκαύσω ὀπίσω σου καὶ ἐξολεθρεύσω τοῦ Αχααβ οὐροῦντα πρὸς τοῖχον καὶ συνεχόμενον καὶ ἐγκαταλελειμμένον ἐν Ισραηλ

text_en: And I will make your house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nabat, and like the house of Baasa the son of Ahias: for what you have done to provoke me to anger , and for making Israel to sin .
text_la: Et dabo domum tuam sicut domum Jeroboam filii Nabat, et sicut domum Baasa filii Ahia : quia egisti ut me ad iracundiam provocares, et peccare fecisti Israël.
text_pt: E farei a tua casa como a casa de Jeroboão, filho de Nebate, e como a casa de Baasa, filho de Aías; por causa da provocação, com que me provocaste e fizeste pecar a Israel.
text_el: καὶ δώσω τὸν οἶκόν σου ὡς τὸν οἶκον Ιεροβοαμ υἱοῦ Ναβατ καὶ ὡς τὸν οἶκον Βαασα υἱοῦ Αχια περὶ τῶν παροργισμάτων ὧν παρώργισας καὶ ἐξήμαρτες τὸν Ισραηλ

text_en: And of Jezabel also, the Lord spoke, saying: The dogs shall eat Jezabel in the field of Jezrahel.
text_la: Sed et de Jezabel locutus est Dominus, dicens : Canes comedent Jezabel in agro Jezrahel.
text_pt: E também acerca de Jezabel falou o Senhor, dizendo: Os cães comerão a Jezabel junto ao antemuro de Jizreel.
text_el: καὶ τῇ Ιεζαβελ ἐλάλησεν κύριος λέγων οἱ κύνες καταφάγονται αὐτὴν ἐν τῷ προτειχίσματι Ιεζραελ

text_en: If Achab die in the city, the dogs shall eat him: but if he die in the field, the birds of the air shall eat him.
text_la: Si mortuus fuerit Achab in civitate, comedent eum canes : si autem mortuus fuerit in agro, comedent eum volucres cæli.
text_pt: Aquele que morrer dos de Acabe, na cidade, os cães o comerão; e o que morrer no campo as aves do céu o comerão.
text_el: τὸν τεθνηκότα τοῦ Αχααβ ἐν τῇ πόλει φάγονται οἱ κύνες καὶ τὸν τεθνηκότα αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ πεδίῳ φάγονται τὰ πετεινὰ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ

text_en: Now, there was not such another as Achab , who was sold to do evil in the sight of the Lord : for his wife, Jezabel , set him on,
text_la: Igitur non fuit alter talis sicut Achab, qui venundatus est ut faceret malum in conspectu Domini : concitavit enim eum Jezabel uxor sua,
text_pt: Porém ninguém fora como Acabe, que se vendera para fazer o que era mau aos olhos do Senhor; porque Jezabel, sua mulher, o incitava.
text_el: πλὴν ματαίως Αχααβ ὡς ἐπράθη ποιῆσαι τὸ πονηρὸν ἐνώπιον κυρίου ὡς μετέθηκεν αὐτὸν Ιεζαβελ ἡ γυνὴ αὐτοῦ

text_en: and he became abominable, insomuch that he followed the idols which the Amorrhites had made, whom the Lord destroyed before the face of the children of Israel .
text_la: et abominabilis factus est, in tantum ut sequeretur idola quæ fecerant Amorrhæi, quos consumpsit Dominus a facie filiorum Israël.
text_pt: E fez grandes abominações, seguindo os ídolos, conforme a tudo o que fizeram os amorreus, os quais o Senhor lançou fora da sua possessão, de diante dos filhos de Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἐβδελύχθη σφόδρα πορεύεσθαι ὀπίσω τῶν βδελυγμάτων κατὰ πάντα ἃ ἐποίησεν ὁ Αμορραῖος ὃν ἐξωλέθρευσεν κύριος ἀπὸ προσώπου υἱῶν Ισραηλ

text_en: And when Achab had heard these words, he rent his garments, and put haircloth upon his flesh, and fasted , and slept in sackcloth , and walked with his head cast down.
text_la: Itaque cum audisset Achab sermones istos, scidit vestimenta sua, et operuit cilicio carnem suam, jejunavitque et dormivit in sacco, et ambulavit demisso capite.
text_pt: Sucedeu, pois, que Acabe, ouvindo estas palavras, rasgou as suas vestes, e cobriu a sua carne de saco, e jejuou; e jazia em saco, e andava mansamente.
text_el: καὶ ὑπὲρ τοῦ λόγου ὡς κατενύγη Αχααβ ἀπὸ προσώπου τοῦ κυρίου καὶ ἐπορεύετο κλαίων καὶ διέρρηξεν τὸν χιτῶνα αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐζώσατο σάκκον ἐπὶ τὸ σῶμα αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐνήστευσεν καὶ περιεβάλετο σάκκον ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ᾗ ἐπάταξεν Ναβουθαι τὸν Ιεζραηλίτην

text_en: And the word of the Lord came to Elias , the Thesbite, saying:
text_la: Et factus est sermo Domini ad Eliam Thesbiten, dicens:
text_pt: Então veio a palavra do Senhor a Elias tisbita, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ῥῆμα κυρίου ἐν χειρὶ δούλου αὐτοῦ Ηλιου περὶ Αχααβ καὶ εἶπεν κύριος

text_en: Have you not seen Achab humbled before me? Therefore, because he has humbled himself, for my sake, I will not bring the evil in his days, but in his son's days will I bring the evil upon his house.
text_la: Nonne vidisti humiliatum Achab coram me? quia igitur humiliatus est mei causa, non inducam malum in diebus ejus, sed in diebus filii sui inferam malum domui ejus.
text_pt: Não viste que Acabe se humilha perante mim? Por isso, porquanto se humilha perante mim, não trarei este mal nos seus dias, mas nos dias de seu filho o trarei sobre a sua casa.
text_el: ἑώρακας ὡς κατενύγη Αχααβ ἀπὸ προσώπου μου οὐκ ἐπάξω τὴν κακίαν ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις αὐτοῦ ἀλλ' ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις τοῦ υἱοῦ αὐτοῦ ἐπάξω τὴν κακίαν

text_en: And there passed three years without war between Syria and Israel .
text_la: Transierunt igitur tres anni absque bello inter Syriam et Israël.
text_pt: E estiveram quietos três anos, não havendo guerra entre a Síria e Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάθισεν τρία ἔτη καὶ οὐκ ἦν πόλεμος ἀνὰ μέσον Συρίας καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον Ισραηλ

text_en: And in the third year, Josaphat, king of Juda , came down to the king of Israel .
text_la: In anno autem tertio, descendit Josaphat rex Juda ad regem Israël.
text_pt: Porém no terceiro ano sucedeu que Jeosafá, rei de Judá, desceu para avistar-se com o rei de Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἐγενήθη ἐν τῷ ἐνιαυτῷ τῷ τρίτῳ καὶ κατέβη Ιωσαφατ βασιλεὺς Ιουδα πρὸς βασιλέα Ισραηλ

text_en: (And the king of Israel said to his servants: Do you not know that Ramoth Galaad is ours, and we neglect to take it out of the hand of the king of Syria ?)
text_la: (Dixitque rex Israël ad servos suos : Ignoratis quod nostra sit Ramoth Galaad, et negligimus tollere eam de manu regis Syriæ?)
text_pt: E o rei de Israel disse aos seus servos: Não sabeis vós que Ramote de Gileade é nossa, e nós estamos quietos, sem a tomar da mão do rei da Síria?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν βασιλεὺς Ισραηλ πρὸς τοὺς παῖδας αὐτοῦ εἰ οἴδατε ὅτι ἡμῖν Ρεμμαθ Γαλααδ καὶ ἡμεῖς σιωπῶμεν λαβεῖν αὐτὴν ἐκ χειρὸς βασιλέως Συρίας

text_en: And he said to Josaphat: Will you come with me to battle to Ramoth Galaad?
text_la: Et ait ad Josaphat : Veniesne mecum ad præliandum in Ramoth Galaad?
text_pt: Então perguntou a Jeosafá: Irás tu comigo à peleja a Ramote de Gileade? E disse Jeosafá ao rei de Israel: Serei como tu, e o meu povo como o teu povo, e os meus cavalos como os teus cavalos.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν βασιλεὺς Ισραηλ πρὸς Ιωσαφατ ἀναβήσῃ μεθ' ἡμῶν εἰς Ρεμμαθ Γαλααδ εἰς πόλεμον καὶ εἶπεν Ιωσαφατ καθὼς ἐγὼ οὕτως καὶ σύ καθὼς ὁ λαός μου ὁ λαός σου καθὼς οἱ ἵπποι μου οἱ ἵπποι σου

text_en: And Josaphat said to the king of Israel : As I am, so are you: my people and your people are one: and my horsemen are your horsemen. And Josaphat said to the king of Israel : Inquire, I beseech you, this day the word of the Lord .
text_la: Dixitque Josaphat ad regem Israël : Sicut ego sum, ita et tu : populus meus et populus tuus unum sunt : et equites mei, equites tui. Dixitque Josaphat ad regem Israël : Quære, oro te, hodie sermonem Domini.
text_pt: Disse mais Jeosafá ao rei de Israel: Peço-te, consulta hoje a palavra do Senhor.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ιωσαφατ βασιλεὺς Ιουδα πρὸς βασιλέα Ισραηλ ἐπερωτήσατε δὴ σήμερον τὸν κύριον

text_en: Then the king of Israel assembled the prophets , about four hundred men , and he said to them: Shall I go to Ramoth Galaad to fight, or shall I forbear? They answered: Go up, and the Lord will deliver it into the hand of the king.
text_la: Congregavit ergo rex Israël prophetas, quadringentos circiter viros, et ait ad eos : Ire debeo in Ramoth Galaad ad bellandum, an quiescere? Qui responderunt : Ascende, et dabit eam Dominus in manu regis.
text_pt: Então o rei de Israel reuniu os profetas até quase quatrocentos homens, e disse-lhes: Irei à peleja contra Ramote de Gileade, ou deixarei de ir? E eles disseram: Sobe, porque o Senhor a entregará na mão do rei.
text_el: καὶ συνήθροισεν ὁ βασιλεὺς Ισραηλ πάντας τοὺς προφήτας ὡς τετρακοσίους ἄνδρας καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ὁ βασιλεύς εἰ πορευθῶ εἰς Ρεμμαθ Γαλααδ εἰς πόλεμον ἢ ἐπίσχω καὶ εἶπαν ἀνάβαινε καὶ διδοὺς δώσει κύριος εἰς χεῖρας τοῦ βασιλέως

text_en: And Josaphat said: Is there not here some prophet of the Lord , that we may inquire by him?
text_la: Dixit autem Josaphat : Non est hic propheta Domini quispiam, ut interrogemus per eum?
text_pt: Disse, porém, Jeosafá: Não há aqui ainda algum profeta do Senhor, ao qual possamos consultar?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ιωσαφατ πρὸς βασιλέα Ισραηλ οὐκ ἔστιν ὧδε προφήτης τοῦ κυρίου καὶ ἐπερωτήσομεν τὸν κύριον δι' αὐτοῦ

text_en: And the king of Israel said to Josaphat. There is one man left, by whom we may inquire of the Lord ; Micah, the son of Jemla : but I hate him, for he does not prophecy good to me, but evil . And Josaphat said: Speak not so, O king.
text_la: Et ait rex Israël ad Josaphat : Remansit vir unus per quem possumus interrogare Dominum : sed ego odi eum, quia non prophetat mihi bonum, sed malum : Michæas filius Jemla. Cui Josaphat ait : Ne loquaris ita, rex.
text_pt: Então disse o rei de Israel a Jeosafá: Ainda há um homem por quem podemos consultar ao Senhor; porém eu o odeio, porque nunca profetiza de mim o que é bom, mas só o mal; este é Micaías, filho de Inlá. E disse Jeosafá: Não fale o rei assim.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ βασιλεὺς Ισραηλ πρὸς Ιωσαφατ ἔτι ἔστιν ἀνὴρ εἷς τοῦ ἐπερωτῆσαι τὸν κύριον δι' αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐγὼ μεμίσηκα αὐτόν ὅτι οὐ λαλεῖ περὶ ἐμοῦ καλά ἀλλ' ἢ κακά Μιχαιας υἱὸς Ιεμλα καὶ εἶπεν Ιωσαφατ βασιλεὺς Ιουδα μὴ λεγέτω ὁ βασιλεὺς οὕτως

text_en: Then the king of Israel called an eunuch, and said to him: Make haste, and bring hither Micah, the son of Jemla .
text_la: Vocavit ergo rex Israël eunuchum quemdam, et dixit ei : Festina adducere Michæam filium Jemla.
text_pt: Então o rei de Israel chamou um oficial, e disse: Traze-me depressa a Micaías, filho de Inlá.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάλεσεν ὁ βασιλεὺς Ισραηλ εὐνοῦχον ἕνα καὶ εἶπεν τάχος Μιχαιαν υἱὸν Ιεμλα

text_en: And the king of Israel , and Josaphat, king of Juda , sat each on his throne, clothed with royal robes, in a court , by the entrance of the gate of Samaria , and all the prophets prophesied before them.
text_la: Rex autem Israël, et Josaphat rex Juda, sedebant unusquisque in solio suo, vestiti cultu regio, in area juxta ostium portæ Samariæ : et universi prophetæ prophetabant in conspectu eorum.
text_pt: E o rei de Israel e Jeosafá, rei de Judá, estavam assentados cada um no seu trono, vestidos de trajes reais, na praça, à entrada da porta de Samaria; e todos os profetas profetizavam na sua presença.
text_el: καὶ ὁ βασιλεὺς Ισραηλ καὶ Ιωσαφατ βασιλεὺς Ιουδα ἐκάθηντο ἀνὴρ ἐπὶ τοῦ θρόνου αὐτοῦ ἔνοπλοι ἐν ταῖς πύλαις Σαμαρείας καὶ πάντες οἱ προφῆται ἐπροφήτευον ἐνώπιον αὐτῶν

text_en: And Sedecias, the son of Chanaana, made himself horns of iron, and said: Thus says the Lord : With these shall you push Syria , till you destroy it.
text_la: Fecit quoque sibi Sedecias filius Chanaana cornua ferrea, et ait : Hæc dicit Dominus : His ventilabis Syriam, donec deleas eam.
text_pt: E Zedequias, filho de Quenaaná, fez para si uns chifres de ferro, e disse: Assim diz o Senhor: Com estes ferirás aos sírios, até de todo os consumir.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν ἑαυτῷ Σεδεκιας υἱὸς Χανανα κέρατα σιδηρᾶ καὶ εἶπεν τάδε λέγει κύριος ἐν τούτοις κερατιεῖς τὴν Συρίαν ἕως συντελεσθῇ

text_en: And all the prophets prophesied in like manner, saying: Go up to Ramoth Galaad, and prosper, for the Lord will deliver it into the king's hands.
text_la: Omnesque prophetæ similiter prophetabant, dicentes : Ascende in Ramoth Galaad, et vade prospere, et tradet Dominus in manus regis.
text_pt: E todos os profetas profetizaram assim, dizendo: Sobe a Ramote de Gileade, e triunfarás, porque o Senhor a entregará na mão do rei.
text_el: καὶ πάντες οἱ προφῆται ἐπροφήτευον οὕτως λέγοντες ἀνάβαινε εἰς Ρεμμαθ Γαλααδ καὶ εὐοδώσει καὶ δώσει κύριος εἰς χεῖράς σου καὶ τὸν βασιλέα Συρίας

text_en: And the messenger that went to call Micah , spoke to him, saying: Behold the words of the prophets with one mouth declare good things to the king: let your word, therefore, be like to theirs, and speak that which is good .
text_la: Nuntius vero qui ierat ut vocaret Michæam, locutus est ad eum, dicens : Ecce sermones prophetarum ore uno regi bona prædicant : sit ergo sermo tuus similis eorum, et loquere bona.
text_pt: E o mensageiro que foi chamar a Micaías falou-lhe, dizendo: Vês aqui que as palavras dos profetas a uma voz predizem coisas boas para o rei; seja, pois, a tua palavra como a palavra de um deles, e fala bem.
text_el: καὶ ὁ ἄγγελος ὁ πορευθεὶς καλέσαι τὸν Μιχαιαν ἐλάλησεν αὐτῷ λέγων ἰδοὺ δὴ λαλοῦσιν πάντες οἱ προφῆται ἐν στόματι ἑνὶ καλὰ περὶ τοῦ βασιλέως γίνου δὴ καὶ σὺ εἰς λόγους σου κατὰ τοὺς λόγους ἑνὸς τούτων καὶ λάλησον καλά

text_en: But Micah said to him: As the Lord lives, whatsoever the Lord shall say to me, that will I speak.
text_la: Cui Michæas ait : Vivit Dominus, quia quodcumque dixerit mihi Dominus, hoc loquar.
text_pt: Porém Micaías disse: Vive o Senhor que o que o Senhor me disser isso falarei.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Μιχαιας ζῇ κύριος ὅτι ἃ ἂν εἴπῃ κύριος πρός με ταῦτα λαλήσω

text_en: So he came to the king, and the king said to him: Micah , shall we go to Ramoth Galaad to battle, or shall we forbear? He answered him: Go up, and prosper, and the Lord shall deliver it into the king's hands.
text_la: Venit itaque ad regem, et ait illi rex : Michæa, ire debemus in Ramoth Galaad ad præliandum, an cessare? Cui ille respondit : Ascende, et vade prospere, et tradet eam Dominus in manus regis.
text_pt: E, vindo ele ao rei, o rei lhe disse: Micaías, iremos a Ramote de Gileade à peleja, ou deixaremos de ir? E ele lhe disse: Sobe, e serás bem sucedido; porque o Senhor a entregará na mão do rei.
text_el: καὶ ἦλθεν πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὁ βασιλεύς Μιχαια εἰ ἀναβῶ εἰς Ρεμμαθ Γαλααδ εἰς πόλεμον ἢ ἐπίσχω καὶ εἶπεν ἀνάβαινε καὶ εὐοδώσει καὶ δώσει κύριος εἰς χεῖρα τοῦ βασιλέως

text_en: But the king said to him: I adjure you again and again, that you tell me nothing but that which is true , in the name of the Lord .
text_la: Dixit autem rex ad eum : Iterum atque iterum adjuro te, ut non loquaris mihi nisi quod verum est, in nomine Domini.
text_pt: E o rei lhe disse: Até quantas vezes te conjurarei, que não me fales senão a verdade em nome do Senhor?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὁ βασιλεύς ποσάκις ἐγὼ ὁρκίζω σε ὅπως λαλήσῃς πρός με ἀλήθειαν ἐν ὀνόματι κυρίου

text_en: And he said: I saw all Israel scattered upon the hills, like sheep that have no shepherd; and the Lord said: These have no master: let every man of them return to his house in peace.
text_la: Et ille ait : Vidi cunctum Israël dispersum in montibus, quasi oves non habentes pastorem. Et ait Dominus : Non habent isti dominum : revertatur unusquisque in domum suam in pace.
text_pt: Então disse ele: Vi a todo o Israel disperso pelos montes, como ovelhas que não tem pastor; e disse o Senhor: Estes não têm senhor; torne cada um em paz para sua casa.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Μιχαιας οὐχ οὕτως ἑώρακα πάντα τὸν Ισραηλ διεσπαρμένον ἐν τοῖς ὄρεσιν ὡς ποίμνιον ᾧ οὐκ ἔστιν ποιμήν καὶ εἶπεν κύριος οὐ κύριος τούτοις ἀναστρεφέτω ἕκαστος εἰς τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ ἐν εἰρήνῃ

text_en: (Then the king of Israel said to Josaphat: Did I not tell you, that he prophesies no good to me, but always evil ?)
text_la: (Dixit ergo rex Israël ad Josaphat : Numquid non dixi tibi, quia non prophetat mihi bonum, sed semper malum?)
text_pt: Então o rei de Israel disse a Jeosafá: Não te disse eu, que nunca profetizará de mim o que é bom, senão só o que é mal?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν βασιλεὺς Ισραηλ πρὸς Ιωσαφατ βασιλέα Ιουδα οὐκ εἶπα πρὸς σέ οὐ προφητεύει οὗτός μοι καλά διότι ἀλλ' ἢ κακά

text_en: And he added and said: Hear, therefore, the word of the Lord : I saw the Lord sitting on his throne, and all the army of heaven standing by him on the right hand and on the left:
text_la: Ille vero addens, ait : Propterea audi sermonem Domini : vidi Dominum sedentem super solium suum, et omnem exercitum cæli assistentem ei a dextris et a sinistris:
text_pt: Então ele disse: Ouve, pois, a palavra do Senhor: Vi ao Senhor assentado sobre o seu trono, e todo o exército do céu estava junto a ele, à sua mão direita e à sua esquerda.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Μιχαιας οὐχ οὕτως οὐκ ἐγώ ἄκουε ῥῆμα κυρίου οὐχ οὕτως εἶδον τὸν κύριον θεὸν Ισραηλ καθήμενον ἐπὶ θρόνου αὐτοῦ καὶ πᾶσα ἡ στρατιὰ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ εἱστήκει περὶ αὐτὸν ἐκ δεξιῶν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐξ εὐωνύμων αὐτοῦ

text_en: And the Lord said: Who shall deceive Achab , king of Israel , that he may go up, and fall at Ramoth Galaad? And one spoke words of this manner, and another otherwise.
text_la: et ait Dominus : Quis decipiet Achab regem Israël, ut ascendat, et cadat in Ramoth Galaad? Et dixit unus verba hujuscemodi, et alius aliter.
text_pt: E disse o Senhor: Quem induzirá Acabe, para que suba, e caia em Ramote de Gileade? E um dizia desta maneira e outro de outra.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος τίς ἀπατήσει τὸν Αχααβ βασιλέα Ισραηλ καὶ ἀναβήσεται καὶ πεσεῖται ἐν Ρεμμαθ Γαλααδ καὶ εἶπεν οὗτος οὕτως καὶ οὗτος οὕτως

text_en: And there came forth a spirit, and stood before the Lord , and said: I will deceive him. And the Lord said to him: By what means?
text_la: Egressus est autem spiritus, et stetit coram Domino, et ait : Ego decipiam illum. Cui locutus est Dominus : In quo?
text_pt: Então saiu um espírito, e se apresentou diante do Senhor, e disse: Eu o induzirei. E o Senhor lhe disse: Com quê?
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν πνεῦμα καὶ ἔστη ἐνώπιον κυρίου καὶ εἶπεν ἐγὼ ἀπατήσω αὐτόν καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτὸν κύριος ἐν τίνι

text_en: And he said: I will go forth, and be a lying spirit, in the mouth of all his prophets . And the Lord said: You shall deceive him, and shall prevail: go forth, and do so.
text_la: Et ille ait : Egrediar, et ero spiritus mendax in ore omnium prophetarum ejus. Et dixit Dominus : Decipies, et prævalebis : egredere, et fac ita.
text_pt: E disse ele: Eu sairei, e serei um espírito de mentira na boca de todos os seus profetas. E ele disse: Tu o induzirás, e ainda prevalecerás; sai e faze assim.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ἐξελεύσομαι καὶ ἔσομαι πνεῦμα ψευδὲς ἐν στόματι πάντων τῶν προφητῶν αὐτοῦ καὶ εἶπεν ἀπατήσεις καί γε δυνήσει ἔξελθε καὶ ποίησον οὕτως

text_en: Now, therefore, behold the Lord has given a lying spirit in the mouth of all your prophets that are here, and the Lord has spoken evil against you.
text_la: Nunc igitur ecce dedit Dominus spiritum mendacii in ore omnium prophetarum tuorum, qui hic sunt, et Dominus locutus est contra te malum.
text_pt: Agora, pois, eis que o Senhor pôs o espírito de mentira na boca de todos estes teus profetas, e o Senhor falou o mal contra ti.
text_el: καὶ νῦν ἰδοὺ ἔδωκεν κύριος πνεῦμα ψευδὲς ἐν στόματι πάντων τῶν προφητῶν σου τούτων καὶ κύριος ἐλάλησεν ἐπὶ σὲ κακά

text_en: And Sedecias, the son of Chanaana, came, and struck Micah on the cheek, and said: Hath then the spirit of the Lord left me, and spoken to you?
text_la: Accessit autem Sedecias filius Chanaana, et percussit Michæam in maxillam, et dixit : Mene ergo dimisit spiritus Domini, et locutus est tibi?
text_pt: Então Zedequias, filho de Quenaaná, chegou, e feriu a Micaías no queixo, e disse: Por onde saiu de mim o Espírito do Senhor para falar a ti?
text_el: καὶ προσῆλθεν Σεδεκιου υἱὸς Χανανα καὶ ἐπάταξεν τὸν Μιχαιαν ἐπὶ τὴν σιαγόνα καὶ εἶπεν ποῖον πνεῦμα κυρίου τὸ λαλῆσαν ἐν σοί

text_en: And Micah said: You shall see in the day when you shall go into a chamber within a chamber to hide yourself.
text_la: Et ait Michæas : Visurus es in die illa quando ingredieris cubiculum intra cubiculum ut abscondaris.
text_pt: E disse Micaías: Eis que o verás naquele mesmo dia, quando entrares de câmara em câmara para te esconderes.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Μιχαιας ἰδοὺ σὺ ὄψῃ ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ὅταν εἰσέλθῃς ταμίειον τοῦ ταμιείου τοῦ κρυβῆναι

text_en: And the king of Israel said: Take Micah and let him abide with Amon, the governor of the city, and with Joas, the son of Amalech;
text_la: Et ait rex Israël : Tollite Michæam, et maneat apud Amon principem civitatis, et apud Joas filium Amelech,
text_pt: Então disse o rei de Israel: Tomai a Micaías, e tornai a levá-lo a Amom, o governador da cidade e a Joás filho do rei.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ βασιλεὺς Ισραηλ λάβετε τὸν Μιχαιαν καὶ ἀποστρέψατε αὐτὸν πρὸς Εμηρ τὸν ἄρχοντα τῆς πόλεως καὶ τῷ Ιωας υἱῷ τοῦ βασιλέως

text_en: and tell them: Thus says the king: Put this man in prison, and feed him with bread of affliction, and water of distress till I return in peace.
text_la: et dicite eis : Hæc dicit rex : Mittite virum istum in carcerem, et sustentate eum pane tribulationis, et aqua angustiæ, donec revertar in pace.
text_pt: E direis: Assim diz o rei: Colocai este homem na casa do cárcere, e sustentai-o com o pão de angústia, e com água de amargura, até que eu venha em paz.
text_el: εἰπὸν θέσθαι τοῦτον ἐν φυλακῇ καὶ ἐσθίειν αὐτὸν ἄρτον θλίψεως καὶ ὕδωρ θλίψεως ἕως τοῦ ἐπιστρέψαι με ἐν εἰρήνῃ

text_en: And Micah said: If you return in peace, the Lord has not spoken by me. And he said: Hear, all you people.
text_la: Dixitque Michæas : Si reversus fueris in pace, non est locutus in me Dominus. Et ait : Audite, populi omnes.
text_pt: E disse Micaías: Se tu voltares em paz, o Senhor não tem falado por mim. Disse mais: Ouvi, povos todos!
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Μιχαιας ἐὰν ἐπιστρέφων ἐπιστρέψῃς ἐν εἰρήνῃ οὐκ ἐλάλησεν κύριος ἐν ἐμοί

text_en: So the king of Israel , and Josaphat, king of Juda , went up to Ramoth-Galaad.
text_la: Ascendit itaque rex Israël, et Josaphat rex Juda, in Ramoth Galaad.
text_pt: Assim o rei de Israel e Jeosafá, rei de Judá, subiram a Ramote de Gileade.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέβη βασιλεὺς Ισραηλ καὶ Ιωσαφατ βασιλεὺς Ιουδα μετ' αὐτοῦ εἰς Ρεμμαθ Γαλααδ

text_en: And the king of Israel said to Josaphat: Take your armour, and go into the battle, and put on your own garments. But the king of Israel changed his dress, and went into the battle.
text_la: Dixit itaque rex Israël ad Josaphat : Sume arma, et ingredere prælium, et induere vestibus tuis. Porro rex Israël mutavit habitum suum, et ingressus est bellum.
text_pt: E disse o rei de Israel a Jeosafá: Eu me disfarçarei, e entrarei na peleja; tu porém veste as tuas roupas. Disfarçou-se, pois o rei de Israel, e entrou na peleja.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν βασιλεὺς Ισραηλ πρὸς Ιωσαφατ βασιλέα Ιουδα συγκαλύψομαι καὶ εἰσελεύσομαι εἰς τὸν πόλεμον καὶ σὺ ἔνδυσαι τὸν ἱματισμόν μου καὶ συνεκαλύψατο ὁ βασιλεὺς Ισραηλ καὶ εἰσῆλθεν εἰς τὸν πόλεμον

text_en: And the king of Syria had commanded the two and thirty captains of the chariots, saying: You shall not fight against any, small or great, but against the king of Israel only.
text_la: Rex autem Syriæ præceperat principibus curruum triginta duobus, dicens : Non pugnabitis contra minorem et majorem quempiam, nisi contra regem Israël solum.
text_pt: E o rei da Síria dera ordem aos capitães dos carros, que eram trinta e dois, dizendo: Não pelejareis nem contra pequeno nem contra grande, mas só contra o rei de Israel.
