text_el: καὶ βασιλεὺς Συρίας ἐνετείλατο τοῖς ἄρχουσι τῶν ἁρμάτων αὐτοῦ τριάκοντα καὶ δυσὶν λέγων μὴ πολεμεῖτε μικρὸν καὶ μέγαν ἀλλ' ἢ τὸν βασιλέα Ισραηλ μονώτατον

text_en: So when the captains of the chariots saw Josaphat, they suspected that he was the king of Israel , and making a violent assault, they fought against him: and Josaphat cried out.
text_la: Cum ergo vidissent principes curruum Josaphat, suspicati sunt quod ipse esset rex Israël, et impetu facto pugnabant contra eum : et exclamavit Josaphat.
text_pt: Sucedeu que, vendo os capítães dos carros a Jeosafá, disseram eles: Certamente este é o rei de Israel. E chegaram-se a ele, para pelejar com ele; porém Jeosafá gritou.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς εἶδον οἱ ἄρχοντες τῶν ἁρμάτων τὸν Ιωσαφατ βασιλέα Ιουδα καὶ αὐτοὶ εἶπον φαίνεται βασιλεὺς Ισραηλ οὗτος καὶ ἐκύκλωσαν αὐτὸν πολεμῆσαι καὶ ἀνέκραξεν Ιωσαφατ

text_en: And the captains of the chariots perceived that he was not the king of Israel , and they turned away from him.
text_la: Intellexeruntque principes curruum quod non esset rex Israël, et cessaverunt ab eo.
text_pt: E sucedeu que, vendo os capitães dos carros que não era o rei de Israel, deixaram de segui-lo.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς εἶδον οἱ ἄρχοντες τῶν ἁρμάτων ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν βασιλεὺς Ισραηλ οὗτος καὶ ἀπέστρεψαν ἀπ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: And a certain man bent his bow, shooting at a venture, and chanced to strike the king of Israel , between the lungs and the stomach. But he said to the driver of his chariot: Turn your hand, and carry me out of the army, for I am grievously wounded.
text_la: Vir autem quidam tetendit arcum, in incertum sagittam dirigens, et casu percussit regem Israël inter pulmonem et stomachum. At ille dixit aurigæ suo : Verte manum tuam, et ejice me de exercitu, quia graviter vulneratus sum.
text_pt: Então um homem armou o arco, e atirou a esmo, e feriu o rei de Israel por entre as fivelas e as couraças; então ele disse ao seu carreteiro: Dá volta, e tira-me do exército, porque estou gravemente ferido.
text_el: καὶ ἐνέτεινεν εἷς τὸ τόξον εὐστόχως καὶ ἐπάταξεν τὸν βασιλέα Ισραηλ ἀνὰ μέσον τοῦ πνεύμονος καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον τοῦ θώρακος καὶ εἶπεν τῷ ἡνιόχῳ αὐτοῦ ἐπίστρεψον τὰς χεῖράς σου καὶ ἐξάγαγέ με ἐκ τοῦ πολέμου ὅτι τέτρωμαι

text_en: And the battle was fought that day, and the king of Israel stood in his chariot against the Syrians , and he died in the evening: and the blood ran out of the wound into the midst of the chariot.
text_la: Commissum est ergo prælium in die illa, et rex Israël stabat in curru suo contra Syros, et mortuus est vespere : fluebat autem sanguis plagæ in sinum currus,
text_pt: E a peleja foi crescendo nequele dia, e o rei foi sustentado no carro defronte dos sírios; porém ele morreu à tarde; e o sangue da ferida corria para o fundo do carro.
text_el: καὶ ἐτροπώθη ὁ πόλεμος ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ καὶ ὁ βασιλεὺς ἦν ἑστηκὼς ἐπὶ τοῦ ἅρματος ἐξ ἐναντίας Συρίας ἀπὸ πρωὶ ἕως ἑσπέρας καὶ ἀπέχυννε τὸ αἷμα ἐκ τῆς πληγῆς εἰς τὸν κόλπον τοῦ ἅρματος καὶ ἀπέθανεν ἑσπέρας καὶ ἐξεπορεύετο τὸ αἷμα τῆς τροπῆς ἕως τοῦ κόλπου τοῦ ἅρματος

text_en: And the herald proclaimed through all the army, before the sun set, saying: Let every man return to his own city, and to his own country.
text_la: et præco insonuit in universo exercitu antequam sol occumberet, dicens : Unusquisque revertatur in civitatem, et in terram suam.
text_pt: E depois do sol posto passou um pregão pelo exército, dizendo: Cada um para a sua cidade, e cada um para a sua terra!
text_el: καὶ ἔστη ὁ στρατοκῆρυξ δύνοντος τοῦ ἡλίου λέγων ἕκαστος εἰς τὴν ἑαυτοῦ πόλιν καὶ εἰς τὴν ἑαυτοῦ γῆν

text_en: And the king died, and was carried into Samaria : and they buried the king in Samaria .
text_la: Mortuus est autem rex, et perlatus est in Samariam : sepelieruntque regem in Samaria,
text_pt: E morreu o rei, e o levaram a Samaria; e sepultaram o rei em Samaria.
text_el: ὅτι τέθνηκεν ὁ βασιλεύς καὶ ἦλθον εἰς Σαμάρειαν καὶ ἔθαψαν τὸν βασιλέα ἐν Σαμαρείᾳ

text_en: And they washed his chariot in the pool of Samaria and the dogs licked up his blood, and they washed the reins according to the word of the Lord which he had spoken.
text_la: et laverunt currum ejus in piscina Samariæ : et linxerunt canes sanguinem ejus, et habenas laverunt, juxta verbum Domini quod locutus fuerat.
text_pt: E, lavando-se o carro no tanque de Samaria, os cães lamberam o seu sangue (ora as prostitutas se lavavam ali), conforme à palavra que o Senhor tinha falado.
text_el: καὶ ἀπένιψαν τὸ ἅρμα ἐπὶ τὴν κρήνην Σαμαρείας καὶ ἐξέλειξαν αἱ ὕες καὶ οἱ κύνες τὸ αἷμα καὶ αἱ πόρναι ἐλούσαντο ἐν τῷ αἵματι κατὰ τὸ ῥῆμα κυρίου ὃ ἐλάλησεν

text_en: But the rest of the acts of Achab , and all that he did, and the house of ivory that he made, and all the cities that he built, are they not written in the book of the words of the days of the kings of Israel ?
text_la: Reliqua autem sermonum Achab, et universa quæ fecit, et domus eburnea quam ædificavit, cunctarumque urbium quas exstruxit, nonne hæc scripta sunt in libro sermonum dierum regum Israël?
text_pt: Quanto ao mais dos atos de Acabe, e a tudo quanto fez, e à casa de marfim que edificou, porventura não está escrito no livro das crônicas dos reis de Israel?
text_el: καὶ τὰ λοιπὰ τῶν λόγων Αχααβ καὶ πάντα ἃ ἐποίησεν καὶ οἶκον ἐλεφάντινον ὃν ᾠκοδόμησεν καὶ πάσας τὰς πόλεις ἃς ἐποίησεν οὐκ ἰδοὺ ταῦτα γέγραπται ἐν βιβλίῳ λόγων τῶν ἡμερῶν τῶν βασιλέων Ισραηλ

text_en: So Achab slept with his fathers; and Ochozias, his son, reigned in his stead.
text_la: Dormivit ergo Achab cum patribus suis, et regnavit Ochozias filius ejus pro eo.
text_pt: Assim dormiu Acabe com seus pais; e Acazias, seu filho, reinou em seu lugar.
text_el: καὶ ἐκοιμήθη Αχααβ μετὰ τῶν πατέρων αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐβασίλευσεν Οχοζιας υἱὸς αὐτοῦ ἀντ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: But Josaphat, the son of Asa, began to reign over Juda , in the fourth year of Acbab, king of Israel .
text_la: Josaphat vero filius Asa regnare cœperat super Judam anno quarto Achab regis Israël.
text_pt: E Jeosafá, filho de Asa, começou a reinar sobre Judá no quarto ano de Acabe, rei de Israel.
text_el: καὶ Ιωσαφατ υἱὸς Ασα ἐβασίλευσεν ἐπὶ Ιουδα ἔτει τετάρτῳ τῷ Αχααβ βασιλέως Ισραηλ ἐβασίλευσεν

text_en: He was five and thirty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned five and twenty years in Jerusalem : the name of his mother was Azuba, the daughter of Salai.
text_la: Triginta quinque annorum erat cum regnare cœpisset, et viginti quinque annis regnavit in Jerusalem : nomen matris ejus Azuba filia Salai.
text_pt: E era Jeosafá da idade de trinta e cinco anos quando começou a reinar; e vinte e cinco anos reinou em Jerusalém; e era o nome de sua mãe Azuba, filha de Sili.
text_el: Ιωσαφατ υἱὸς τριάκοντα καὶ πέντε ἐτῶν ἐν τῷ βασιλεύειν αὐτὸν καὶ εἴκοσι καὶ πέντε ἔτη ἐβασίλευσεν ἐν Ιερουσαλημ καὶ ὄνομα τῇ μητρὶ αὐτοῦ Αζουβα θυγάτηρ Σελεϊ

text_en: And he walked in all the way of Asa, his father, and he declined not from it: and he did that which was right in the sight of the Lord .
text_la: Et ambulavit in omni via Asa patris sui, et non declinavit ex ea : fecitque quod rectum erat in conspectu Domini.
text_pt: E andou em todos os caminhos de seu pai Asa, não se desviou deles, fazendo o que era reto aos olhos do Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἐπορεύθη ἐν πάσῃ ὁδῷ Ασα τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἐξέκλινεν ἀπ' αὐτῆς τοῦ ποιῆσαι τὸ εὐθὲς ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς κυρίου

text_en: Nevertheless, he took not away the high places for as yet the people offered sacrifice , and burnt incense in the high places.
text_la: Verumtamen excelsa non abstulit : adhuc enim populus sacrificabat, et adolebat incensum in excelsis.
text_pt: Todavia os altos não se tiraram; ainda o povo sacrificava e queimava incenso nos altos.
text_el: πλὴν τῶν ὑψηλῶν οὐκ ἐξῆρεν ἔτι ὁ λαὸς ἐθυσίαζεν καὶ ἐθυμίων ἐν τοῖς ὑψηλοῖς

text_en: And Josaphat had peace with the king of Israel .
text_la: Pacemque habuit Josaphat cum rege Israël.
text_pt: E Jeosafá esteve em paz com o rei de Israel.
text_el: καὶ εἰρήνευσεν Ιωσαφατ μετὰ βασιλέως Ισραηλ

text_en: But the rest of the acts of Josaphat, and his works which he did, and his battles, are they not written in the book of the words of the days of the kings of Juda ?
text_la: Reliqua autem verborum Josaphat, et opera ejus quæ gessit, et prælia, nonne hæc scripta sunt in libro verborum dierum regum Juda?
text_pt: Quanto ao mais dos atos de Jeosafá, e ao poder que mostrou, e como guerreou, porventura não está escrito no livro das crônicas dos reis de Judá?
text_el: καὶ τὰ λοιπὰ τῶν λόγων Ιωσαφατ καὶ αἱ δυναστεῖαι αὐτοῦ ὅσα ἐποίησεν οὐκ ἰδοὺ ταῦτα γεγραμμένα ἐν βιβλίῳ λόγων τῶν ἡμερῶν τῶν βασιλέων Ιουδα

text_en: And the remnant also of the effeminate, who remained in the days of Asa, his father, he took out of the land.
text_la: Sed et reliquias effeminatorum qui remanserant in diebus Asa patris ejus, abstulit de terra.
text_pt: Também expulsou da terra o restante dos sodomitas, que ficaram nos dias de seu pai Asa.

text_en: And there was then no king appointed in Edom .
text_la: Nec erat tunc rex constitutus in Edom.
text_pt: Então não havia rei em Edom, porém um vice-rei.

text_en: But King Josaphat made navies on the sea, to sail into Ophir for gold: but they could not go, for the ships were broken in Asiongaber .
text_la: Rex vero Josaphat fecerat classes in mari, quæ navigarent in Ophir propter aurum : et ire non potuerunt, quia confractæ sunt in Asiongaber.
text_pt: E fez Jeosafá navios de Társis, para irem a Ofir por causa do ouro; porém não foram, porque os navios se quebraram em Eziom-Geber.

text_en: Then Ochozias, the son of Achab , said to Josaphat: Let my servants go with your servants in the ships. And Josaphat would not.
text_la: Tunc ait Ochozias filius Achab ad Josaphat : Vadant servi mei cum servis tuis in navibus. Et noluit Josaphat.
text_pt: Então Acazias, filho de Acabe, disse a Jeosafá: Vão os meus servos com os teus servos nos navios. Porém Jeosafá não quis.

text_en: And Josaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with them in the city of David, his father: and Joram, his son, reigned in his stead.
text_la: Dormivitque Josaphat cum patribus suis, et sepultus est cum eis in civitate David patris sui : regnavitque Joram filius ejus pro eo.
text_pt: E Jeosafá dormiu com seus pais, e foi sepultado junto a eles, na cidade de Davi, seu pai; e Jeorão, seu filho, reinou em seu lugar.
text_el: καὶ ἐκοιμήθη Ιωσαφατ μετὰ τῶν πατέρων αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐτάφη παρὰ τοῖς πατράσιν αὐτοῦ ἐν πόλει Δαυιδ τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐβασίλευσεν Ιωραμ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ ἀντ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: And Ochozias, the son of Achab , began to reign over Israel , in Samaria , in the seventeenth year of Josaphat, king of Juda , and he reigned over Israel two years.
text_la: Ochozias autem filius Achab regnare cœperat super Israël in Samaria, anno septimodecimo Josaphat regis Juda : regnavitque super Israël duobus annis.
text_pt: E Acazias, filho de Acabe, começou a reinar sobre Israel, em Samaria, no ano dezessete de Jeosafá, rei de Judá; e reinou dois anos sobre Israel.
text_el: καὶ Οχοζιας υἱὸς Αχααβ ἐβασίλευσεν ἐπὶ Ισραηλ ἐν Σαμαρείᾳ ἐν ἔτει ἑπτακαιδεκάτῳ Ιωσαφατ βασιλεῖ Ιουδα καὶ ἐβασίλευσεν ἐν Ισραηλ ἔτη δύο

text_en: And he did evil in the sight of the Lord , and walked in the way of his father and his mother, and in the way of Jeroboam , the son of Nabat, who made Israel to sin .
text_la: Et fecit malum in conspectu Domini, et ambulavit in via patris sui et matris suæ, et in via Jeroboam filii Nabat, qui peccare fecit Israël.
text_pt: E fez o que era mau aos olhos do Senhor; porque andou no caminho de seu pai, como também no caminho de sua mãe, e no caminho de Jeroboão, filho de Nebate, que fez pecar a Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν τὸ πονηρὸν ἐναντίον κυρίου καὶ ἐπορεύθη ἐν ὁδῷ Αχααβ τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐν ὁδῷ Ιεζαβελ τῆς μητρὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐν ταῖς ἁμαρτίαις οἴκου Ιεροβοαμ υἱοῦ Ναβατ ὃς ἐξήμαρτεν τὸν Ισραηλ

text_en: He served also Baal , and worshipped him, and provoked the Lord , the God of Israel , according to all that his father had done.
text_la: Servivit quoque Baal, et adoravit eum, et irritavit Dominum Deum Israël, juxta omnia quæ fecerat pater ejus.
text_pt: E serviu a Baal, e adorou-o, e provocou a ira do Senhor Deus de Israel, conforme a tudo quanto fizera seu pai.
text_el: καὶ ἐδούλευσεν τοῖς Βααλιμ καὶ προσεκύνησεν αὐτοῖς καὶ παρώργισεν τὸν κύριον θεὸν Ισραηλ κατὰ πάντα τὰ γενόμενα ἔμπροσθεν αὐτοῦ
